title.zh-TW: 即時插話快捷鍵送出佇列，雲端問答與 Vim 游標精準對齊
title.en: A Send-Now Key Flushes Queued Messages, Cloud Session Resume and Vim Cursor Get Precise

body.zh-TW: 當 Claude 正在輸出長篇回答時，你隨時能按下快捷鍵 `ctrl+enter`（或 `ctrl+x ctrl+s`）立即中斷當前輪次，並一次性送出所有排隊中的佇列訊息。這些送出與排隊中的文字會以灰色顯示，直到模型正式接收處理。在雲端工作階段（session）恢復執行時，被後續訊息取代的過期提問不再殘留在對話記錄中。在 Vim 模式下透過快速鍵或點號重複指令切換至 Shell 模式時，游標位置也不會再往右偏移一格。⟦急診室護理師插單遞交病歷板，將手邊最新整理的補充病況直接疊到醫師診療桌最上方。⟧
body.en: While Claude is streaming a long reply, you can now press `ctrl+enter` (or `ctrl+x ctrl+s`) at any time to interrupt the current turn and send every queued message at once. Sent and queued text shows in gray until the model actually receives it. When a cloud session resumes, a stale question that a later message had already superseded no longer lingers in the transcript. And in vim mode, switching to shell mode with a dot-repeated shortcut or command no longer nudges the cursor one character to the right. ⟦It's like an ER nurse cutting into the queue to hand over a chart, placing the latest patient update straight on top of the doctor's desk.⟧

items.original:
Added a send-now key (ctrl+enter, or ctrl+x ctrl+s) that interrupts the current turn and sends all queued messages at once; sent and queued messages show in gray until the model receives them
Fixed a resumed cloud session leaving an unanswered question open in the transcript after a queued message superseded it
Fixed vim mode placing the cursor one character right after a dot-repeated "!" or a fast-typed "i!" switched a non-empty prompt into shell mode

title.zh-TW: 應用程式網關支援登入確認，憑證安全註銷不留連線殘留
title.en: Apps Gateway Sign-In Adds a Confirmation Step, Logout Now Clears the Connection Cleanly

body.zh-TW: 當你透過 Claude 應用程式網關（gateway，負責轉發與管理企業連線的中繼伺服器）登入時，若網關指名了帳號名稱，系統會在儲存登入憑證前要求你確認，輸入 `/status` 也能隨時查看目前帳號。⟦跨國企業總部櫃檯換證，訪客進門前先核對名牌上的部門編號，離場時門禁系統同步註銷通行權限。⟧ 執行 `/logout` 登出時，若網關支援權杖註銷，系統會同步結束該工作階段（session）。此外，若企業網路網關在拒絕測試版標頭時改寫了 API 錯誤回應，終端機也不會再於每個輪次卡在 400 錯誤。
body.en: When you sign in through the Claude apps gateway (a relay server that forwards and manages enterprise connections), if the gateway names an account, the system now asks you to confirm it before the credential is saved, and `/status` shows the current account at any time. ⟦It's like swapping badges at a multinational HQ's front desk: the visitor's department number gets checked before they're let in, and the access system revokes it the moment they leave.⟧ Running `/logout` now also ends the session on gateways that advertise token revocation. And when a corporate network gateway rewrites API error responses while rejecting a beta header, the terminal no longer gets stuck with a `400` error on every turn.

items.original:
Added the signed-in account to Claude apps gateway sign-in: when the gateway names it, you confirm it before the credential is saved, and `/status` shows it
Fixed a terminal `API Error: 400` on every turn for users behind a network gateway that rewrites API error responses when a beta request header is rejected
Updated `/logout` for Claude apps gateway sign-ins to also end the session on gateways that advertise token revocation

title.zh-TW: 網頁帳號技能與外掛同步終端機，本機修改明確提示儲存方式
title.en: Web Account Skills and Plugins Now Sync to the Terminal, Local Edits Say Clearly How to Save

body.zh-TW:
你在網頁版 claude.ai 啟用的技能與外掛，現在登入同帳號的終端機工作階段（session）時會自動同步啟用。若想關閉此功能，可在設定檔中指定以下開關：
```json
{
  "syncClaudeAiSkills": false,
  "syncClaudeAiPlugins": false
}
```
`ListPlugins` 工具說明已更新，讓模型清楚知道這是列出帳號外掛而非本機外掛。修改同步技能資料夾中的檔案時，編輯結果會明確提醒變更尚未存回雲端帳號並附上儲存指引。內建 `claude-api` 技能即時來源表中的四個失效文件網址也已修正。⟦旅客登入航空公司帳號時自動帶入預設的偏好選餐與行李托運額度，本機暫存修改時也會清楚標記尚未同步至雲端會員中心。⟧
body.en:
Skills and plugins you've enabled on claude.ai on the web now sync automatically into terminal sessions signed in with the same account. To opt out, set these in your config:
```json
{
  "syncClaudeAiSkills": false,
  "syncClaudeAiPlugins": false
}
```
The `ListPlugins` tool description has been updated so Claude knows it lists plugins enabled on your account, not ones installed locally. When you edit a file inside the synced skills folder, the edit result now says clearly that the change isn't saved to your cloud account, with instructions on how to save it. Four dead documentation URLs in the bundled `claude-api` skill's live-sources table have also been fixed. ⟦It's like signing into an airline account and having your default meal preference and baggage allowance carried over automatically, while a change made only locally is clearly flagged as not yet synced to your membership profile in the cloud.⟧

items.original:
Added syncing of the skills and plugins enabled on your claude.ai account to terminal sessions signed in with it; opt out with `syncClaudeAiSkills: false` or `syncClaudeAiPlugins: false`
Fixed four dead documentation URLs (Pricing, Computer Use, Skills, CLI) in the bundled claude-api skill's live-sources table
Improved the `ListPlugins` tool description so Claude knows it lists plugins enabled on your claude.ai account, not plugins installed locally with `/plugin`
Improved Write and Edit results for files in the synced account-skills folder: they now say the change is not saved to your account and how to save it

title.zh-TW: 外掛安裝支援來源市集提示，敏感密碼遮蔽與套件腳本防護
title.en: Plugin Install Can Name a Source Marketplace, Passwords Get Masked and Install Scripts Blocked

body.zh-TW: 安裝外掛現在能直接指定來源市集，指令格式為 `/plugin install <plugin> --marketplace <source>`，系統會在安裝前主動詢問是否先加入該市集。市集更新失敗時不會再誤刪本地副本，記錄與清單中包含在網址內的密碼或授權權杖已全面隱藏。某些 Git 位址顯示錯誤伺服器的問題已修復。從封存檔載入的外掛在預覽重載時，不再覆寫執行中工作階段（session）的解壓縮檔案。從 npm 來源安裝的外掛改採 `npm pack --ignore-scripts` 並校驗完整性，徹底防止安裝腳本暗中執行。⟦應用程式商店在下載安裝新套件前，先由安全掃描器過濾掉安裝腳本並隱藏下載網址中的帳號密碼。⟧
body.en: Installing a plugin can now name a source marketplace directly with `/plugin install <plugin> --marketplace <source>`, and the system offers to add that marketplace first if it isn't already added. A failed marketplace update no longer deletes the local copy by mistake, and passwords or tokens embedded in a URL are now hidden everywhere they'd show up in messages and lists. A bug that showed the wrong server for some git addresses has been fixed. Reloading a plugin loaded from an archive no longer overwrites the extracted files of a running session. Plugins installed from an npm source are now fetched with `npm pack --ignore-scripts` and integrity-verified, so install scripts can no longer run silently. ⟦It's like an app store running a security scan that strips out install scripts and hides your login credentials from the download URL before a new package is installed.⟧

items.original:
Added `/plugin install <plugin> --marketplace <source>`, which offers to add the marketplace before installing the plugin
Fixed `claude plugin marketplace update` deleting a GitHub marketplace's local copy when the fetch failed and the marketplace was named after its repository
Fixed plugin and marketplace messages, logs and `claude plugin marketplace list` showing a password or token stored in a git, ssh or marketplace URL
Fixed plugin messages, logs and the VS Code plugin dialog showing the wrong server for some git addresses
Fixed plugin reload previews replacing a running session's extracted plugin files when the plugin was loaded from a `--plugin-dir` or `--plugin-url` archive
Changed plugins installed from an npm source to be fetched with `npm pack --ignore-scripts` and integrity-verified, so a package's install scripts no longer run

title.zh-TW: Artifact 發布共享指引強化，跨裝置接續與例行任務自動更新
title.en: Artifact Publish Guidance Gets Sharper, Cross-Machine Resume and Routines Update in Place

body.zh-TW: 當工作階段（session）換機恢復或暫存區被清空時，更新失敗的問題已修復。系統會自動還原該頁面最後發布的版本。⟦共同編輯線上公佈欄海報，具備修改權限的成員可以直接在原圖版覆蓋更新，不必每次都複製出一張新的草稿。⟧ 發布與讀取結果現在會清楚標明瀏覽權限與分享選單選項，初次發布時改為要求單字分頁圖示，並在頁面包含空位元組時發出警告。被賦予編輯權限的共享頁面會直接在原處更新，不再另行建立複本。例行任務在執行時能自動儲存並重新發布你可編輯的頁面，省去反覆詢問的步驟。
body.en: A bug where Artifact updates failed after a session resumed on another machine or its scratchpad was cleared has been fixed; the page's last published version is now restored automatically. ⟦It's like a shared bulletin-board poster: a member with edit rights updates the same sheet directly instead of pasting up a fresh copy every time.⟧ Publish and read results now say clearly who can open the page and what the owner's Share menu offers, a first publish now asks for a one-word tab icon instead, and a warning appears when the page contains a NUL byte. A shared page you've been given edit access to now updates in place instead of publishing a separate copy. Scheduled and Run now routine runs can automatically save data to, and republish, a page you can edit, without asking each time.

items.original:
Fixed Artifact updates failing with "File not found" after a session resumes on another machine or its scratchpad is cleared: the page's last published version is restored
Improved the Artifact tool's publish and read results: they now say who can open the page and what the owner's Share menu offers
Improved artifact publish results: they name the tab icon sent, warn when the page contains a NUL byte, and retry a flaky fetch of the newer page to merge after a stale publish
Improved the Artifact tool's guidance so Claude updates a shared artifact in place when you were given edit access to it, instead of publishing a separate copy
Changed the Artifact tool to ask for a one-word tab icon on a first publish instead of an emoji favicon
Changed scheduled and Run now routine runs to save data to, and republish the page of, an artifact you can edit without asking; public artifacts, first publishes and deletes still ask

title.zh-TW: 提示詞快取命中率提升，遙測設定示警與方案用量查詢共用
title.en: Prompt Cache Hit Rate Goes Up, Telemetry Setup Gets a Warning and Usage Reads Get Shared

body.zh-TW: 當你在 `--system-prompt` 中加入 `__SYSTEM_PROMPT_DYNAMIC_BOUNDARY__` 標記時，分界線以上的文字現在會進行全域快取（cache，把計算過的結果暫存起來直接取用）。在對話壓縮或恢復執行後，記憶檔案的時間標註不再於每次請求間變動，有效解決了快取失效的問題。回覆中偶爾出現的多餘標籤已修正。同一台機器上的編輯器視窗與非互動工作階段（session）現在會共用一分鐘內查詢過的方案用量，避免重複呼叫端點。啟動時若設定的遙測小幫手執行失敗，系統會主動發出警告。⟦辦公室共用電話簿，同仁查詢同一支分機時直接查看櫃檯一分鐘前剛翻開的那一頁，避免所有人重複打去總機詢問。⟧
body.en: When your `--system-prompt` contains a `__SYSTEM_PROMPT_DYNAMIC_BOUNDARY__` line, the text above it is now cached globally. After a compaction or resume, a restored memory file's age note no longer changes between requests, which had been causing cache misses. A stray closing tag that occasionally appeared in replies has been fixed. Editor windows and non-interactive sessions on the same machine now share a plan-usage read made within the last minute instead of each calling the usage endpoint separately. A startup warning now appears when a configured telemetry headers helper fails to run. ⟦It's like an office's shared phone directory: when a colleague looks up the same extension, they just check the page the front desk flipped open a minute ago instead of everyone calling the switchboard themselves.⟧

items.original:
Added a startup warning when a configured `otelHeadersHelper` fails, so sessions that silently export no telemetry are noticed
Fixed a restored memory file's age note changing between requests after a compaction or resume, which caused prompt cache misses
Fixed a stray `</ccmemory>`-style closing tag occasionally appearing in responses
Improved prompt caching for a `--system-prompt` that contains a `__SYSTEM_PROMPT_DYNAMIC_BOUNDARY__` line: the text above it is now cached globally, as the SDK's array form already is
Improved plan-usage reads: editor windows and non-interactive sessions on one machine now share a read made in the last minute instead of each calling the usage endpoint

title.zh-TW: 檔案搜尋與讀取不再卡住，沙盒指令狀態碼精準回報
title.en: File Search and Reads No Longer Hang, Sandboxed Commands Report Status Correctly

body.zh-TW: 使用 Grep、Glob 或輸入 `@` 搜尋檔案時，若搜尋結果超出上限，程式不再發生記憶體不足或卡死，ripgrep 遇到大量警告時也會正確回報錯誤。自訂檔案建議指令或輸入 `@.` 時，檔案建議不會再被 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）資源排在下方。在記憶體吃緊導致大檔案無法解碼時，讀取工具現在會明確回報錯誤而非無回應。Linux 沙盒環境下使用 Zsh 時，失敗的 Bash 指令不再誤報成功結束代碼，且沙盒環境已支援寫入名為 `hooks/` 或 `config/` 的專案目錄。⟦圖書館檢索系統在遇到超出借閱上限的龐大藏書清單時，能精準回傳搜尋結果而不至於讓查詢終端機當機。⟧
body.en: When Grep, Glob, or an `@` search returns more results than the cap, the tool no longer hangs or runs out of memory, and system ripgrep now reports an actual error instead of "no matches" after a flood of warnings. With a custom file-suggestion command or when typing `@.`, file suggestions are no longer buried below MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) resources. When memory pressure keeps a large file from being decoded, the Read tool now reports an error instead of hanging. On Linux sandboxes running zsh, a failed Bash command no longer reports exit code 0, and sandboxes can now write to project directories named `hooks/` or `config/`. ⟦It's like a library catalog system that, even when a search turns up more books than the loan cap allows, still returns accurate results instead of freezing the lookup terminal.⟧

items.original:
Fixed @-mention file suggestions being buried below MCP resources when using a custom `fileSuggestion` command or typing `@.`/`@./`
Fixed sandboxed Bash commands on Linux reporting exit code 0 for failed commands when the shell is zsh
Fixed the Read tool hanging instead of reporting an error when part of a large file could not be decoded under memory pressure
Fixed Grep, Glob and @-file suggestions hanging or running out of memory on searches over the 20MB output cap, and system ripgrep reporting "no matches" instead of an error after a flood of warnings
Fixed sandboxed Bash commands being unable to write to project directories named `hooks/` or `config/`

title.zh-TW: 工作階段還原容錯強化，損毀記錄與啟動異常自動修復
title.en: Session Resume Gets More Fault-Tolerant, Corrupted Records and Startup Crashes Now Recover

body.zh-TW: 恢復工作階段（session）時的穩定性現在更加健全。⟦檔案管理員在翻閱泛黃破損的卷宗時，主動撫平黏合損毀的書頁，接續先前的查案思路而不中斷。⟧ 以前若儲存的歷史紀錄中包含格式異常的任務提醒、附件項目或對話內容區塊，常導致 `--resume`、預覽選單或背景代理還原失敗，現在均已能妥善處理。全螢幕檢視此類對話時，在向上捲動狀態下接收新訊息也不會再引發當機。使用 `--resume` 或 `--continue` 接續任務時，即使啟動時包含的內建工具已被伺服器端旗標關閉，對話先前的思考歷程依然完整保留。此外，設定檔 `~/.claude.json` 包含異常數值導致啟動當機的問題也已修復。
body.en: Resuming a session is now noticeably more stable. ⟦It's like an archivist flipping through a yellowed, damaged file, smoothing out a torn page and picking the investigation back up without losing the thread.⟧ A saved history containing a malformed task-reminder, @-file attachment entry, or message content block used to make `--resume`, the resume picker preview, or a resumed background agent fail; all of these now recover properly. Viewing such a conversation in fullscreen no longer crashes when new messages arrive while you're scrolled up. Continuing with `--resume` or `--continue` now keeps a conversation's earlier thinking intact, even when a built-in tool it started with has since been switched off by a server-side flag. A crash at launch caused by a malformed value in `~/.claude.json` has also been fixed.

items.original:
Fixed `--resume`, the resume picker preview, resumed background agents and the transcript view failing on a session whose saved history contains a malformed task-reminder or @-file attachment entry
Fixed a crash when resuming a conversation whose transcript contains a malformed message entry, and a fullscreen crash when such a conversation received new messages while scrolled up
Fixed sessions failing to resume or start when their saved transcript contains a malformed message content block
Fixed a crash at launch when `~/.claude.json` holds a malformed `mcpNeedsAuthNoticed` value
Fixed `--resume` and `--continue` dropping a conversation's earlier thinking when a built-in tool it started with has since been switched off by a server-side flag

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕檢視流暢度升級，背景通知定位與選取複製修復
title.en: Fullscreen Mode Gets Smoother, Background Notices and Text Selection Get Fixed

body.zh-TW: 在全螢幕工作階段（session）中，背景任務的完成通知現在會即時關閉展開的工具列，並精準顯示在抵達位置，不再被壓在摺疊行底下。向上捲動瀏覽長篇檔案修改比對時，畫面不再短暫凍結或反白數秒。在斜線指令下拉選單開啟時快速打字或按住按鍵，不再觸發無法復原的介面錯誤而退出程式。在 `claude --resume` 選擇清單中用滑鼠選取的文字，現在能順利複製至剪貼簿。當終端機運作緩慢或暫停時，系統反應已獲得改善，輸出內容不會在等待期間持續落後。⟦禮堂的多功能投影幕在快速切換長篇簡報時保持畫面流暢，不會因為滑鼠選取文字或快遞通知抵達就突然閃退。⟧
body.en: In a fullscreen session, a background task's completion notice now closes the open tool row right away and shows up exactly where it arrived, instead of getting buried beneath a long turn's collapsed tool row. Scrolling up through a large file diff no longer freezes or blanks the screen for several seconds. Typing fast or holding a key while the slash-command dropdown is open no longer triggers an unrecoverable interface error that exits the program. Text selected with the mouse in the `claude --resume` session picker now actually reaches the clipboard. Responsiveness has also improved when the terminal is slow or paused, so output no longer keeps falling further behind while it waits. ⟦It's like a hall's multi-purpose projector screen staying smooth through fast slide changes, never blanking out just because someone selected text with a mouse or a notification arrived.⟧

items.original:
Fixed fullscreen mode placing background-task completion notices beneath a long turn's collapsed tool row instead of where they arrived; each notice now closes the open row
Fixed fullscreen mode freezing or blanking for several seconds when scrolling up past a large file diff
Fixed fullscreen sessions sometimes exiting with "Claude Code exited after an unrecoverable interface error" when typing fast or holding a key with the slash-command dropdown open
Fixed text selected with the mouse in the fullscreen `claude --resume` session picker never reaching the clipboard
Improved responsiveness when the terminal is slow or paused: output no longer falls further behind while the terminal catches up

title.zh-TW: 子代理訊息轉發完整保留，背景任務與復原指令穩定執行
title.en: Subagent Message Forwarding Stays Complete, Background Tasks and Rewind Run Stably

body.zh-TW: 當你在分支技能（forked skill）中啟動子代理時，`--forward-subagent-text` 輸出與 SDK 不再遺漏轉發訊息。在背景工作階段（session）中執行 `/rewind` 倒轉時，即使歷史備份未完全複製，也不會再還原出全零或遭截斷的損毀檔案。在檔案描述元耗盡的機器上透過標準輸入（stdin）執行指令時，背景工作單元不再異常崩潰重啟。自架執行器在收到關機訊號時會短暫等待當前輪次回報，避免丟失最終結果。帶有特定比對條件的 `SubagentStop` 掛鉤（hook，在特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），也不會再對代理類型為空的子代理錯誤觸發。⟦劇團後台調度員在閉幕廣播響起時，耐心等候正在台前謝幕的演員退場並記錄最終成果，不遺漏任何謝幕環節。⟧
body.en: When you spawn a subagent inside a forked skill, `--forward-subagent-text` stream-json output and the SDK no longer drop its forwarded messages. Running `/rewind` in a background session no longer restores a zero-filled or truncated file when the session's file-history backups couldn't be fully copied. A command run through stdin on a machine that's run out of file descriptors no longer crashes and restarts the background worker. A self-hosted runner receiving a shutdown signal now waits briefly for the current turn to be reported before it loses the final result. A `SubagentStop` hook with a specific matcher no longer fires incorrectly for every stopping subagent whose agent type is empty. ⟦It's like a stage manager backstage who, when the closing announcement sounds, waits patiently for an actor still taking a curtain call out front and logs the final result without missing a single bow.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `--forward-subagent-text` stream-json and SDK output dropping the messages of subagents spawned by a `context: fork` skill, and of forked skills invoked by a subagent or another forked skill
Fixed `/rewind` in a forked or background session restoring a zero-filled or truncated file when the session's file-history backups could not be fully copied
Fixed background sessions crashing and restarting their worker when a command fed through stdin ran on a machine that had run out of file descriptors
Fixed self-hosted runners with `--drain-wait-sec` losing the final result of a turn that finished during a SIGTERM drain; the runner now waits briefly for the turn to be reported
Fixed `SubagentStop` hooks with a specific `matcher` firing for every stopping subagent whose agent type was empty

title.zh-TW: 權限設定規則精確套用，託管環境重啟與圖片存取順暢
title.en: Permission Rules Now Apply Correctly, Hosted Restarts and Image Access Go Smoother

body.zh-TW: 執行 `/update-config` 更新權限時，系統現在會正確寫入 `Edit(path)` 規則而非無法比對的寫入規則。貼上與附加的圖片現在會存放在安全位置，讓模型直接開啟為檔案而無需反覆彈出權限提示。在雲端託管的工作階段（session）中，容器重啟後未回答的授權提示會繼續保留，不必重新詢問。Chrome 擴充套件在自動模式下改為跳過逐站檢查，修復了重新導向後的批次瀏覽權限問題。無法開啟桌面版時，錯誤訊息會清楚說明原因與後續步驟。此外，單次排程例行任務執行完畢後的啟動提示通知已移除。⟦安全警衛室在重新巡邏交接後，依然在門禁看板上保留先前未確認的訪客申請表單，不再重複敲門打擾住戶。⟧
body.en: Running `/update-config` now correctly writes `Edit(path)` permission rules instead of `Write(path)` rules that file permission checks don't match. Pasted and attached images are now saved somewhere Claude can open them directly as files without repeated permission prompts. In a cloud-hosted session, an unanswered permission prompt now stays up after a container restart instead of asking again. Claude in Chrome in auto mode now skips the extension's per-site check for classifier-approved calls, fixing a permission issue with batch browsing after a redirect. When Claude Desktop won't open, the error message now says clearly why and what to do next. The startup notice about a one-off scheduled routine having run since your last session has also been removed. ⟦It's like a security desk that, after a shift-change patrol, still keeps an unconfirmed visitor request on the access board instead of knocking on the resident's door all over again.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `/update-config` writing `Write(path)` permission rules, which file permission checks don't match, instead of `Edit(path)` rules
Improved the `/desktop` error when Claude Desktop does not open: it now says why and what to do next
Improved pasted and attached images: they are now saved where Claude can open them as files without a permission prompt, including in Desktop and VS Code
Changed hosted sessions to keep an unanswered permission prompt up after a container restart, instead of asking again
Changed Claude in Chrome in auto mode to skip the extension's per-site check for classifier-approved calls, as bypass mode does, fixing `browser_batch` "Permission denied" after a redirect
Removed the startup notice that told you a one-off scheduled routine had run since your last session

title.zh-TW: ［VSCode］記憶對話框支援編修，檔案修改分項審查與無字送圖
title.en: [VSCode] Memory Dialog Gets Editing, Diff Review Goes Change-by-Change and Images Send Without Text

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 的記憶管理對話框中，你現在可以直接檢視、修改或刪除已儲存的偏好紀錄。⟦審稿編輯在對照修訂稿時，能逐條勾選採納或退回個別段落的潤飾建議，不必一次性全盤接受。⟧ 修改比對頁籤中為每處變更增設了接受與拒絕按鈕，讓你能逐項審查修改內容。附加圖片現在支援直接送出而無需輸入額外文字。若工作階段（session）偏好位置設定為側邊欄，開啟新工作階段時會直接在側邊欄顯示而非開啟新分頁。在高對比淺色佈景主題下，計畫預覽與權限規則對話框的文字對比度已修復，且在擴充套件無回應時誤送被忽略檔案中選取文字的罕見問題也已解決。
body.en: In VS Code's Memory dialog, you can now view, edit, or delete a saved memory directly. ⟦It's like a copy editor reviewing a marked-up draft who can accept or reject each polish suggestion paragraph by paragraph, instead of taking the whole revision at once.⟧ The proposed-change diff tab now has accept and reject buttons under each change, so you can review an edit change by change. An attached image can now be sent without typing any text. When Preferred Location is set to Sidebar, a new session now opens in the sidebar instead of always opening another tab. Text contrast in the plan preview and the Hooks and Permission rules dialogs has been fixed under the High Contrast Light theme, and a rare case where text selected in a git-ignored file could be sent after the extension was unresponsive has also been fixed.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added viewing, editing and deleting a saved memory inside the Memory dialog
[VSCode] Added sending an attached image without typing any text
[VSCode] Added accept and reject buttons under each change in the proposed-change diff tab, so an edit can be reviewed change by change
[VSCode] Fixed a rare case where text selected in a git-ignored file could be sent to Claude after the extension was unresponsive for several seconds
[VSCode] Fixed unreadable code in the plan preview and the Hooks and Permission rules dialogs with the High Contrast Light theme
[VSCode] Changed New session in a Claude editor tab to open in the sidebar when Preferred Location is set to Sidebar, instead of always opening another tab

title.zh-TW: ［VSCode］代理地圖視覺化升級，背景任務崩潰復原狀態更精準
title.en: [VSCode] Agent Map Visualization Improves, Crash Recovery Status Gets More Accurate

body.zh-TW: VS Code 中的代理地圖現在獲得顯著強化：狀態標籤能即時顯示執行中的代理數量並在失敗時轉為紅燈，捲動時主代理會持續固定在畫面上，所有代理清單依狀態與結束時間整齊排序。重新開啟工作階段（session）後，先前因崩潰而未完成的代理會正確標記為失敗而非停止。在背景任務執行期間若發生崩潰並重載視窗，接續步驟的提示通知能正常出現，且接續次數上限不會被異常重設。背景代理在工具執行期間完成時的結果通知與地圖狀態，在視窗重新整理後也能完整保留。⟦航管塔台的雷達螢幕將故障的無人機標示為警示紅燈，主機雷達始終固定在中央視窗，方便管制員一目了然。⟧
body.en: The agent map in VS Code has gotten a solid upgrade: the pill now counts running agents live and turns red after a failure, the main agent stays pinned in view while the map scrolls, and the agent list sorts by state then end time. After reopening a session, an agent a crash left unfinished is now correctly marked as failed instead of stopped. If a crash happens during a background task and the window reloads, the "Continuing the step" notice now appears correctly and the continue limit no longer resets by mistake. A background agent's completion notice and its status on the map, when it finishes while a tool is running, now also survive a window reload. ⟦It's like an air traffic control radar screen that marks a malfunctioning drone with a red warning light while the main radar itself stays fixed at the center of the screen, so the controller can see everything at a glance.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the agent map showing agents a crash left unfinished as stopped instead of failed once the session is reopened
[VSCode] Fixed the "Continuing the step" notice not appearing, and the continue limit resetting, after a reload that follows a crash with background tasks still running
[VSCode] Fixed a background agent that finished while Claude was running a tool losing its completion notice, and its result on the agent map, after a window reload
[VSCode] Improved the agent map: the pill counts running agents and turns red after a failure, the main agent stays in view while the map scrolls, and agents sort by state then end time

title.zh-TW: ［VSCode］對話捲動體驗改善，斜線指令排隊與發送設定自訂
title.en: [VSCode] Conversation Scrolling Improves, Slash Commands Queue and Send Behavior Is Configurable

body.zh-TW:
當 Claude 正在處理任務時，新發送的訊息現在會整齊停留在對話最底部排隊，直到模型開始處理它。在此期間輸入的斜線指令，會在當前回答結束後依序執行，不再被當成純文字誤送給模型。當你向上捲動閱讀歷史訊息時，串流回覆不再強行將畫面拉回底部，若想徹底關閉發送時自動捲動至底部的行為，可新增以下設定：
```json
{
  "claudeCode.scrollToBottomOnSend": false
}
```
發送訊息時捲動未對齊新回覆，以及權限卡片等待確認時畫面微幅跳動的問題均已修復。⟦會議室即時速記板在聽眾向上翻閱歷史發言時，不會強行把畫面拉回底部，讓每個人都能依照自己的節奏閱讀。⟧
body.en:
While Claude is working, a newly sent message now waits neatly at the bottom of the conversation until Claude starts on it. A slash command typed during that time now runs in order once the current reply finishes, instead of being sent to the model as plain text. When you scroll up to read earlier messages, a streaming reply no longer forces the view back to the bottom; to turn off the jump-to-bottom-on-send behavior entirely, add this setting:
```json
{
  "claudeCode.scrollToBottomOnSend": false
}
```
A bug where scrolling on send didn't line up with the new reply, and a small jump in the screen while a permission card waits for confirmation, have both been fixed. ⟦It's like a conference room's live notes board that, when someone scrolls up to read earlier remarks, doesn't force the view back to the bottom — letting everyone read at their own pace.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the transcript creeping toward the bottom in small steps while a permission card waits and content keeps arriving
[VSCode] Fixed the scroll to the bottom on send stopping short of the reply when the reply starts arriving during the scroll
[VSCode] Fixed slash commands typed while Claude is responding being sent to the model as text instead of running once the response finishes
[VSCode] Fixed the conversation pulling you back to the bottom while a reply streams after you scroll up, and added a `claudeCode.scrollToBottomOnSend` setting to turn off the jump on send
[VSCode] Changed a message sent while Claude is working to wait at the bottom of the conversation until Claude starts on it

title.zh-TW: ［VSCode］工作階段清單時間精準，分支對話權限與重新命名修復
title.en: [VSCode] Session List Timestamps Get Accurate, Forked Conversations Keep Permissions and Renaming Gets Fixed

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 的工作階段（session）清單中，排序時間現在忠實依據最後一則訊息的發送時間顯示，不再因重新開啟視窗而更新。⟦圖書館借書證在重新蓋章後，依舊以最後一次借閱的實際日期排序，分流出的研究筆記也完整保留原本的借閱權限。⟧ 重新命名執行中的工作階段時，名稱不會再無故跳回系統預設名稱。執行「從此處分支對話」或倒轉對話時，新對話會完整沿用原先設定的授權權限模式。修復了在 Claude 運作期間發送訊息後接續分支會失敗的問題，且重新開啟工作階段後提示詞快取（cache，暫存計算結果）的有效計時器已能正確顯示剩餘時間。部分雲端對話在 VS Code 開啟時呈現空白畫面的問題也已順利修復。
body.en: In VS Code's session list, the sort time now faithfully reflects when the last message was sent, instead of updating just because the window was reopened. ⟦It's like a library card that, even after being re-stamped, still sorts by the actual date of the last checkout — and a forked research note still carries over the original borrowing privileges.⟧ Renaming a running session no longer reverts to the generated name for no reason. Using "Fork conversation from here" or rewinding a conversation now keeps the permission mode you had originally picked. A bug where forking failed on the message right after one sent while Claude was working has been fixed, and the prompt cache clock now shows the correct remaining time after reopening a session with a message sent while Claude was working. Some cloud conversations opening in VS Code as a blank screen has also been fixed.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed rewound and forked conversations not keeping the permission mode you had picked for the original conversation
[VSCode] Fixed the session list showing when a session was last reopened, such as after a window reload, instead of when its last message was sent
[VSCode] Fixed "Fork conversation from here" failing on the message right after one sent while Claude was working
[VSCode] Fixed the prompt cache clock showing too few minutes after reopening a session with a message sent while Claude was working
[VSCode] Fixed renaming a running session reverting to the generated name (regression in 2.1.269)
[VSCode] Fixed some claude.ai/code sessions opening in VS Code as an empty conversation with no messages

title.zh-TW: ［VSCode］MCP 伺服器支援重試，遠端遙控開關與外掛設定安全
title.en: [VSCode] MCP Server List Gets a Retry, Remote Control Toggle and Plugin Settings Get Safer

body.zh-TW: 當 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器清單載入失敗時，對話框中現在會主動顯示「重試」連結供你快速重新連線。在遠端遙控（Remote Control）連線中若想取消，再次輸入 `/remote-control` 即可立即關閉連線，且連線關閉失敗後狀態能正確顯示為已關閉。外掛管理對話框中不再外洩市集網址內輸入的密碼或權杖，並修正了無效安裝連結的彈窗問題。此外，若在環境變數設定中留下空的 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`，系統不會再將設定檔案錯誤存放在工作區目錄中。⟦遠端遙控開關在嘗試連線階段若被再次按下，能立刻中止連線程序，安全面板也不會暴露連接線路上的金鑰字串。⟧
body.en: When the MCP (a protocol that connects AI to external tools) server list fails to load, the dialog now shows a Retry link so you can reconnect quickly. If you want to cancel a Remote Control connection, running `/remote-control` again now turns it off immediately, and it now shows as off correctly after a failed turn-off. The Manage plugins dialog no longer leaks a password or token typed into a marketplace URL, and a bug with invalid install links opening the dialog has been fixed. An empty `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` left in the environment variables setting no longer makes Claude Code keep its files in the workspace by mistake. ⟦It's like a remote-control toggle that, if pressed again while still connecting, immediately aborts the connection — and a security panel that never exposes the key string sitting on the wire.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a Retry link to the MCP servers dialog when the server list fails to load
[VSCode] Fixed an empty `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` entry in the `environmentVariables` setting making Claude Code keep its files in the workspace
[VSCode] Fixed plugin install links opening the Manage plugins dialog for plugin names and marketplace addresses that can't be used in a link
[VSCode] Fixed Remote Control staying shown as connected after a turn-off that Claude Code reported as failed; it now shows as off
[VSCode] Fixed `/remote-control` being ignored while Remote Control is still connecting: running it again now turns Remote Control off immediately
[VSCode] Fixed the Manage plugins dialog showing a password or token that was typed into a marketplace URL

title.zh-TW: ［Web］例行任務頁面新增捷徑，通知完整度與雲端網域設定防護
title.en: [Web] Routine Pages Get a New Shortcut, Notifications and Cloud Domain Settings Get Safer

body.zh-TW: 當例行任務（Routine）連結失效時，錯誤頁面現在新增了「新增例行任務」按鈕，方便你快速建立新任務。⟦站務廣播系統在排程廣播暫停時，清楚提示站長親自撥動復原開關，並指引管理者裁剪超長的允許清單。⟧ 任務暫停或保留的通知字句不再被中途截斷，訂閱暫停時會清楚提示你在恢復後手動重啟任務。若請 Claude 操作非它建立的任務，它會直接提供該任務的設定頁連結。雲端工作階段（session）設定過長的允許網域清單時，儲存當下便會主動阻擋並提示應縮減的長度，避免日後啟動失敗。個人帳號遇到 GitHub 存取受阻時，系統指引會直接附上正確的帳號連結頁面。
body.en: When a routine link no longer resolves, the error page now shows a "New routine" button so you can create one quickly. ⟦It's like a station's broadcast system that, when a scheduled announcement is paused, clearly tells the stationmaster to flip the resume switch themselves, while also guiding the admin to trim an overly long allow list.⟧ A routine's "paused" and "on hold" notifications are no longer cut off mid-sentence, and the paused-subscription notice now says clearly that you need to turn the routine back on yourself once it resumes. When you ask Claude to edit, delete, or run a routine it didn't create, it now links you straight to that routine's page. A cloud environment with a very long allowed-domains list now fails to save up front with a message on how much to trim, instead of saving fine and failing every session start later. Claude's guidance when a personal account's GitHub access is denied now links directly to the correct account page.

items.original:
[Claude Code on the web] Added a "New routine" button to the page shown when a routine link no longer resolves, next to the link back to your routines list
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed routine "paused" and "on hold" notifications being cut off mid-sentence; the paused-subscription notice now says to turn the routine back on yourself
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed cloud environments with a very long allowed-domains list saving fine and then failing every session start; saving now fails up front and says how much to trim
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed Claude's guidance when a cloud session on a personal account is denied GitHub access: it now links to claude.ai/connect-github instead of an admin settings page
[Claude Code on the web] Improved what Claude tells you when asked to edit, delete or run a routine it didn't create: it now links to the routine's page so you can do it yourself

title.zh-TW: ［Claude Tag］存取套件支援外部頻道，雲端監控預設與 S3 連線修復
title.en: [Claude Tag] Access Bundles Can Reach Outside Channels, Cloud Monitoring Presets and S3 Get Fixed

body.zh-TW: 在 Claude Tag 管理設定中，擁有者現在可以為存取套件（access bundle）設定附加條件，允許該套件套用至包含訪客的頻道或 Slack Connect 跨企業頻道，不再侷限於僅限成員的私密頻道。在憑證標籤頁中，新增了 Amazon CloudWatch、CloudWatch Logs、Amazon SNS、Google Cloud Monitoring 與 Cloud Logging 等預設範本。Datadog 連線新增了多個站點預設並限制為唯讀與查詢路由。透過 AWS 連線使用新版 CLI 與 SDK 上傳至 S3 儲存庫時觸發 502 錯誤的問題已修復。⟦展覽會館通行證管理員允許參展廠商將特定設備的存取權限延伸至貴賓洽談區，並提供主流雲端服務的快速登記範本。⟧
body.en: In Claude Tag admin settings, an Owner can now set attach conditions for an access bundle, letting it also apply in channels with guests or Slack Connect channels, not just member-only ones. New presets have been added to the Credentials tab, including Amazon CloudWatch, CloudWatch Logs, Amazon SNS, Google Cloud Monitoring, and Cloud Logging. Datadog connections now add presets for several sites and are limited to Datadog's read and query routes. A bug where S3 uploads from recent AWS CLI and SDK versions failed with a 502 error over an AWS connection has been fixed. ⟦It's like an exhibition hall's badge administrator letting an exhibitor extend a specific device's access into the VIP lounge, while also handing out quick sign-up templates for the major cloud services.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Added attach conditions for access bundles in Claude Tag settings: an Owner can let a bundle also apply in channels with guests or Slack Connect channels, not just member-only
[Claude Tag] Added Amazon CloudWatch, CloudWatch Logs, Amazon SNS, Google Cloud Monitoring and Cloud Logging presets to an access bundle's Credentials tab in Claude Tag admin settings
[Claude Tag] Added Datadog presets for the US3, AP1, AP2 and US1-FED sites; new Datadog connections are now limited to Datadog's read and query API routes
[Claude Tag] Fixed S3 uploads from recent AWS CLI and SDK versions failing with a 502 error when sent through an AWS connection

title.zh-TW: ［Claude Tag］Slack 討論串身分維持，頻道活躍度判斷與企業網格提示
title.en: [Claude Tag] Slack Threads Keep Their Identity, Channel Activity Detection and Enterprise Grid Notices Improve

body.zh-TW: 當 Claude 仍在透過例行任務或討論串在 Slack 頻道中發言時，不會再將該頻道誤判為閒置而略過未標記的訊息。⟦跨部門工作群組中的虛擬助理在重新上線後，依然牢記自己在各討論串中的專屬代稱與所選語言模型。⟧ 在對話工作階段（session）重新整理或重啟後，討論串中的專屬任務名稱不再跳回預設名稱，手動切換的語言模型也不會被默默重設為頻道預設值。當其他應用程式或機器人在頻道頂層提及 Claude 時，偶爾重複回覆兩次的問題已修復。在 Enterprise Grid 跨工作區共用頻道中，若尚未設定工作區，系統通知會清楚說明原因。
body.en: Claude no longer mistakes a channel for inactive and skips untagged messages there while it's still posting in that channel from a routine or a thread. ⟦It's like a cross-team assistant who, after coming back online, still remembers its own display name and chosen model in each separate thread.⟧ After a session refreshes or restarts, a thread's dedicated task name no longer reverts to the default, and a manually switched model no longer silently resets to the channel default. A bug where Claude sometimes replied twice when another app or bot mentioned it in a top-level channel message has been fixed. In Enterprise Grid channels shared across workspaces, the notice now says clearly when no workspace has been set up yet.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude treating a channel as inactive, and skipping untagged messages there, while it was still posting in that channel from a routine or a thread
[Claude Tag] Fixed a thread's "Claude [task]" display name reverting to plain "Claude" after the session behind that thread was refreshed or restarted
[Claude Tag] Fixed the model you switched to in a Slack thread silently reverting to the channel's default after that thread's session was restarted or refreshed
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude sometimes replying twice when another app or bot @mentioned it in a top-level channel message
[Claude Tag] Improved Claude's notices in Enterprise Grid channels shared across workspaces: they now say when no workspace is set up yet, or why only organization defaults apply

title.zh-TW: ［Code Review］多代理審查分析完整呈現，大量審查 PR 合併複審輕量化
title.en: [Code Review] Multi-Agent Analysis Stops Dropping Findings, Heavy-Review PRs Get Lighter Merge Checks

body.zh-TW: 當多個審查代理協同分析程式碼時，即使個別代理以非預期的格式回傳發現，審查報告也不會再遺失部分分析結論。在累積超過一百次 Claude 審查的 Pull Request（合併請求）中，從基礎分支進行乾淨合併時，系統現在會精確執行專注於合併內容的輕量複審，不再耗費資源觸發通篇完整重審。以前每次合併都會強制全面重審，如今省去了重複審查的等待時間。⟦論文審稿委員會在收到作者微調標點的小修版本時，只針對修改處快速核對，不再召集所有委員重新通篇大審。⟧
body.en: When multiple reviewing agents analyze code together, the review report no longer loses part of its analysis just because one agent returned its findings in an unexpected format. On a pull request with more than 100 Claude reviews, a clean merge from the base branch now correctly triggers the lighter, merge-focused review instead of a full re-review. Every merge used to force a complete re-review, which wasted time; that repeated wait is now gone. ⟦It's like a paper review committee that, on receiving a minor revision with only a few punctuation tweaks from the author, quickly checks just the changed spots instead of reconvening every reviewer for a full re-read.⟧

items.original:
[Code Review] Fixed reviews occasionally dropping part of their analysis when one of the reviewing agents returned its findings in an unexpected format
[Code Review] Fixed pull requests with more than 100 Claude reviews getting a full re-review on every clean merge from the base branch instead of the lighter merge-focused review

entries: Added a visible warning when memory usage is critical, with steps to free memory or restart safely
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` to bound how long the first non-interactive turn waits for connecting MCP servers (`0` = don't wait)
Added `effort` attribute to the `claude_code.llm_request` OpenTelemetry trace span, matching the `api_request` event
Added `claude_code.managed_settings_resolved` OTel event: managed-settings sources and policy helper state; redacted settings and digests with `OTEL_LOG_MANAGED_SETTINGS=1`

Added `store.connect_timeout_seconds` to the Claude apps gateway config to lengthen the Postgres connect timeout (default 5 seconds), and improved the boot error when the database is unreachable to point to `store.postgres_url` and the configured timeout
Added `enduser.sub`, the IdP subject, to the telemetry Claude Desktop and Cowork send through a Claude apps gateway
Added a Claude apps gateway warning when a replica has more requests open than the 256 it sends upstream at once, and a startup log line showing that limit
Added click-to-expand for collapsed teammate and agent messages in fullscreen mode

Fixed sessions getting stuck endlessly retrying "unexpected tool_use_id" 400 errors: corrupted transcripts now self-heal where possible, and otherwise a clear error (with a `/rewind` hint) ends the loop
Fixed MCP servers configured as `http` that only speak legacy HTTP+SSE failing to connect when they answer the first request with 422 or another 4xx error
Fixed Streamable HTTP MCP tool calls timing out after about 5 minutes even when a longer per-server `timeout` was set
Fixed MCP prompts and resources not refreshing when a server sends list-changed notifications without declaring `listChanged`
Fixed MCP tool calls refused with 403 insufficient_scope being reported as an expired sign-in: the error now names the missing permissions and points to `/mcp` re-authentication
Fixed hook-driven sessions (such as an active `/goal`) ending with "Prompt is too long" instead of compacting when the context overflowed again after a reactive compaction
Fixed an active `/goal` being lost when resuming (`--continue` / `--resume`) a session that had compacted
Fixed `claude agents` losing `--model`, `--effort`, `--permission-mode`, `--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions` and `--agent` after an auto-update relaunch
Fixed a per-turn slowdown when a language server publishes project-wide diagnostics for thousands of files
Fixed subagents with `model: "opus"` on Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry leaving the session's model when its id has no recognizable model family (unless `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL` is set)

Fixed the first turn of a cloud session sometimes starting without the tools of an SDK-hosted MCP server that was still connecting
Fixed background agent notifications claiming the agent had no live background work when it was still waiting on its own background task and would resume

title.zh-TW: 記憶體緊繃即時示警，背景指令不再提早中斷
title.en: Critical Memory Warnings Alert in Real Time, Background Commands No Longer Stop Prematurely

body.zh-TW: 當電腦記憶體（RAM，負責暫存執行中程式的空間）吃緊時，終端機會直接跳出明顯警示，並附上釋放記憶體或安全重啟的引導步驟。以前在一般記憶體壓力下閒置三十分鐘就會被停止的背景指令，現在只有在記憶體極度不足時才會停下，除錯日誌也會清楚記錄停用原因。⟦這就像汽車儀表板上的水溫警示燈，只有在水箱真正過熱時才會亮起紅燈提醒駕駛檢修，平常行駛不會隨意強制熄火。⟧
body.en: When system memory is running critically low, the terminal now displays a visible warning with guided steps to free memory or restart safely. Background commands that were previously stopped after idling for thirty minutes under mild memory pressure now only stop when memory is critically low, with the debug log clearly recording the reason. ⟦This is like a coolant temperature warning light on a car dashboard: a red light alerts the driver for inspection only when the radiator is truly overheating, rather than stalling the engine randomly during normal driving.⟧

items.original:
Added a visible warning when memory usage is critical, with steps to free memory or restart safely
Fixed background commands being stopped after 30 idle minutes on machines under mild memory pressure; they're now stopped only when memory is critically low, and the debug log says why

title.zh-TW: MCP 連線協定全面升級，啟動等待時間靈活設定
title.en: MCP Connection Protocol Upgrades and Flexible Startup Wait Time Configuration

body.zh-TW: ⟦登機門廣播最後登機時限，時間一到準點出發，後續抵達的行李再由下一班次送達。⟧ 非互動模式現在能透過 `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` 設定首輪等待 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器連線的上限時間。搭配空的 `--mcp-config` 使用 `--strict-mcp-config` 時，首輪不再因無關伺服器苦等逾時。在串流 JSON 的工作階段中，延後搜尋的工具不再卡住首輪啟動。Bedrock、Vertex 與 Foundry 等安裝環境預設改採第二版用戶端與最新協定交涉。設定檔中無效的 SDK 伺服器項目會直接跳過並發出警告。
body.en: ⟦The boarding gate announces a final boarding cutoff, departing promptly once time is up while luggage arriving later is sent on the next flight.⟧ Non-interactive mode can now set the maximum wait time for connecting MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers during the first turn via `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS`. When using `--strict-mcp-config` with an empty `--mcp-config`, the first turn no longer gets held up waiting to time out on incidental servers. In streaming JSON sessions, deferred tool search tools no longer stall first-turn startup. Environments such as Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry now adopt the v2 client and the latest protocol negotiation by default. Invalid SDK server entries in configuration files are skipped with a warning.

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_MCP_STARTUP_WAIT_MS` to bound how long the first non-interactive turn waits for connecting MCP servers (`0` = don't wait)
Fixed `--strict-mcp-config` with an empty `--mcp-config` holding the first non-interactive turn for up to `MCP_TIMEOUT` on incidental MCP servers
Improved startup in `--input-format stream-json` sessions: the first turn no longer waits up to 2s for still-connecting MCP servers whose tools tool search defers; they arrive on a later turn
Changed Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry and telemetry-disabled installs to use the v2 MCP client and MCP 2026-07-28 negotiation with direct HTTP servers by default, as other installs already do (opt out: `MCP_SDK_GENERATION=v1` or `MCP_PROTOCOL_NEGOTIATION=legacy`)
Changed `"type": "sdk"` MCP entries in `.mcp.json`, settings, plugins and agent files to be skipped with a warning: only an SDK host application can register in-process servers

title.zh-TW: MCP 工具權限清晰回報，敏感變數安全隱藏
title.en: Clear Reporting for MCP Tool Permissions and Safe Masking of Sensitive Variables

body.zh-TW: 呼叫外部擴充工具時，若因權限不足遭伺服器拒絕，錯誤訊息現在會明確列出缺少的權限項目並提示使用 `/mcp` 重新驗證，不再誤報為登入過期。連線錯誤日誌與登入工具說明中，不再洩漏環境變數解析後的機密字串。使用傳統 HTTP 與 SSE 協定的伺服器回傳錯誤代碼時已能正確連線。可串流的工具呼叫不再受限於固定時間而提早逾時。當伺服器推送清單變更時，提示詞與資源項目會即時更新。⟦這如同海關退件時清楚附上補件清單與櫃檯指引，並主動遮蓋個人個資，不再把缺少證件誤判為護照失效。⟧
body.en: When calling external extension tools, if a request is refused by the server due to insufficient permissions, the error message now clearly names the missing permissions and points to `/mcp` re-authentication instead of misreporting an expired sign-in. Connection error logs and the login tool description no longer leak resolved secret strings from environment variables. Servers using legacy HTTP and SSE protocols now connect properly even when returning error codes. Streamable tool calls are no longer bound to a fixed timeout and won't time out early. Prompts and resources update immediately when a server sends list-changed notifications. ⟦This is like customs returning a package with a clear checklist of missing documents and counter guidance while proactively redacting personal information, rather than mistaking missing paperwork for an expired passport.⟧

items.original:
Fixed MCP servers configured as `http` that only speak legacy HTTP+SSE failing to connect when they answer the first request with 422 or another 4xx error
Fixed Streamable HTTP MCP tool calls timing out after about 5 minutes even when a longer per-server `timeout` was set
Fixed MCP prompts and resources not refreshing when a server sends list-changed notifications without declaring `listChanged`
Fixed MCP tool calls refused with 403 insufficient_scope being reported as an expired sign-in: the error now names the missing permissions and points to `/mcp` re-authentication
Fixed MCP connection errors and the MCP login tool's description showing secrets resolved from `${VAR}` placeholders in MCP configs

title.zh-TW: OpenTelemetry 遙測記錄升級，請求溯源更透明
title.en: OpenTelemetry Telemetry Logging Upgrades for More Transparent Request Tracing

body.zh-TW: ⟦這就像為飛行記錄器升級標籤索引，每次對話與請求都精準記錄航程編號與油耗數據，事後調閱一清二楚。⟧ 系統遙測（telemetry，收集軟體運作數據以利分析的機制）現在於大型語言模型請求追蹤中新增了 `effort` 思考程度屬性。透過新增的受管設定解析事件，管理者能清楚掌握設定來源與策略狀態，設定環境變數 `OTEL_LOG_MANAGED_SETTINGS=1`，即可在記錄中自動遮蔽敏感的設定值與摘要。當你將原始請求內容輸出至本機檔案時，新產生的 `index.jsonl` 索引檔與關聯識別碼能將每次模型回覆精確連結至對應的請求檔案與對話訊息。
body.en: ⟦This is like upgrading the indexing labels on a flight recorder: every conversation and request precisely logs its flight number and fuel metrics, making post-flight review crystal clear.⟧ System telemetry now adds an `effort` attribute to LLM request traces. Through the new managed settings resolved event, administrators can clearly track configuration sources and policy status, and setting the environment variable `OTEL_LOG_MANAGED_SETTINGS=1` automatically redacts sensitive setting values and digests in logs. When exporting raw request bodies to local files, the newly generated `index.jsonl` file and event attributes accurately link each model response to its corresponding request file and transcript message.

items.original:
Added `effort` attribute to the `claude_code.llm_request` OpenTelemetry trace span, matching the `api_request` event
Added `claude_code.managed_settings_resolved` OTel event: managed-settings sources and policy helper state; redacted settings and digests with `OTEL_LOG_MANAGED_SETTINGS=1`
Improved `OTEL_LOG_RAW_API_BODIES=file:<dir>` output: a new `index.jsonl` and `request_body_id` / `message.id` event attributes link each response to its request file and transcript message

title.zh-TW: 企業網關連線逾時可調，關機等待請求消化
title.en: Configurable Timeout for Enterprise Apps Gateway and Graceful Shutdown for In-Flight Requests

body.zh-TW: 管理 Claude 企業應用的應用程式網關（Gateway，負責轉發與管理連線的中繼伺服器）現在支援在設定中加入 `store.connect_timeout_seconds`，用以延長資料庫連線逾時秒數。開機時若資料庫連線稍有延遲，網關會主動重試連線最多三次，無法連線時也會明確指出設定位置。當伺服器收到關機訊號時，不再強制切斷進行中的連線，會最多等待二十五秒讓處理中的請求順利傳輸完成。⟦這好比餐廳打烊前不再直接熄燈趕客，而是留出充裕時間讓最後入座的客人優雅用餐完畢。⟧
body.en: The Claude apps gateway now supports adding `store.connect_timeout_seconds` in its configuration to lengthen the database connection timeout. If the database connection experiences a slight delay during boot, the gateway actively retries the connection up to three times, and clearly points to the configuration location if unreachable. When the server receives a shutdown signal, it no longer forcefully cuts open streams, instead waiting up to twenty-five seconds for in-flight requests to complete transmission smoothly. ⟦This is like a restaurant at closing time not abruptly turning off the lights to rush customers out, but rather leaving ample time for the last seated guests to finish their meal gracefully.⟧

items.original:
Added `store.connect_timeout_seconds` to the Claude apps gateway config to lengthen the Postgres connect timeout (default 5 seconds), and improved the boot error when the database is unreachable to point to `store.postgres_url` and the configured timeout
Fixed Claude apps gateway cutting every open stream on SIGTERM: it now lets in-flight requests finish for up to 25 seconds before exiting (`CLAUDE_GATEWAY_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS`)
Improved Claude apps gateway boot: it now tries the first Postgres connection up to three times before exiting, so a database that is reachable a few seconds late no longer fails the boot

title.zh-TW: 網關負載警示強化，額度檢查省時省力
title.en: Enhanced Gateway Load Warnings and Streamlined Spend Limit Checks

body.zh-TW: 企業應用網關現在會在連線數量超過二百五十六筆時主動發出負載警示，並於遙測資料中納入身分識別資訊。在高承載狀態下，花費用量檢查從原本的四次資料庫往返簡化為一次，有效減少逾時風險；若在檢查期間資料庫連線中斷，系統也能妥善捕捉異常。當使用者在 `/login` 觸發登入頻率限制時，介面會清楚說明拒絕原因，伺服器日誌也會同步標記觸發的規則與建議修改的設定項。⟦整套控管猶如銀行大廳的智慧叫號系統，人潮湧現時主動調度窗口，將多道審核程序併為單次臨櫃辦理。⟧
body.en: The Claude apps gateway now issues an active load warning when open connections exceed two hundred and fifty-six, and includes identity information in telemetry data. Under high load, the spend-limit check is simplified from four database round trips to one, effectively reducing timeout risks; if the database drops a connection during the check, the system properly handles the exception. When a user triggers sign-in rate limits at `/login`, the interface clearly explains the refusal reason, while gateway logs flag which limit was hit and suggest which setting to change. ⟦The entire management is like a smart queuing system in a bank lobby: dispatching extra counters when crowds surge and merging multi-step verification into a single teller visit.⟧

items.original:
Added `enduser.sub`, the IdP subject, to the telemetry Claude Desktop and Cowork send through a Claude apps gateway
Added a Claude apps gateway warning when a replica has more requests open than the 256 it sends upstream at once, and a startup log line showing that limit
Fixed an unhandled promise rejection in the Claude apps gateway when Postgres drops a connection during a spend check
Improved the Claude apps gateway's spend-limit check under load: it now takes one database round trip instead of four, so fewer checks time out on a busy gateway
Improved Claude apps gateway sign-in rate limit errors: `/login` now explains the refusal, and the gateway log says which limit was hit and which setting to change

title.zh-TW: 對話記錄智慧修復，目標與掛鉤工作階段不中斷
title.en: Smart Transcript Self-Healing and Uninterrupted Goal and Hook Sessions

body.zh-TW: ⟦速記員整理會議紀錄時，若發現紙頁破損會自動黏合，內容過長時主動提煉重點，絕不遺漏既定目標。⟧ 當對話記錄損毀導致工具呼叫錯誤時，工作階段會嘗試自我修復，或提示使用 `/rewind` 結束重試迴圈。由掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）驅動的長任務，在篇幅再次超出上限時會自動壓縮對話。例如執行中的 `/goal` 在接續已壓縮的工作階段時，不會遺失進行中的目標。對話中輸入的自訂編號清單不再被強制重新排序。阻擋對話的掛鉤重複觸發時改以精簡標籤呈現。
body.en: ⟦When a stenographer compiles meeting notes, torn pages are automatically mended, overly long content is summarized for key points, and established goals are never lost.⟧ When a corrupted transcript leads to tool call errors, sessions attempt to self-heal or provide a hint to use `/rewind` to end retry loops. Long-running tasks driven by hooks automatically compact the conversation when context overflows again after previous compaction. For instance, an active `/goal` will not lose its ongoing objective when resuming a compacted session. Ordered lists entered in messages are no longer forcefully renumbered. Stop prompt hooks that trigger repeatedly now display with a concise label.

items.original:
Fixed sessions getting stuck endlessly retrying "unexpected tool_use_id" 400 errors: corrupted transcripts now self-heal where possible, and otherwise a clear error (with a `/rewind` hint) ends the loop
Fixed hook-driven sessions (such as an active `/goal`) ending with "Prompt is too long" instead of compacting when the context overflowed again after a reactive compaction
Fixed an active `/goal` being lost when resuming (`--continue` / `--resume`) a session that had compacted
Fixed the transcript renumbering ordered lists in your own messages (typing "3. 2. 1." displayed "3. 4. 5."); numbers and "N)" markers now show as typed
Fixed Stop prompt hooks re-sending their whole prompt on every block in a conversation; repeat blocks now name the condition with a 500-character label

title.zh-TW: 子代理參數完整保留，對話紀錄與進度精確呈現
title.en: Subagent Parameters Preserved and Accurate Transcript and Progress Display

body.zh-TW: 使用 `claude agents` 指令管理代理時，自動更新重啟後不會再遺失 `--model`、`--effort` 或權限模式等啟動參數。在 Bedrock、Vertex 與 Foundry 平台上，指定 Opus 模型的子代理能正確辨識並保留模型設定。子代理回傳給主工作階段的訊息，在桌面版重啟後依然完整保留在對話記錄中；子代理的精簡進度摘要也不會再被冗長的多段回覆意外覆蓋。⟦這猶如外派專員的識別證與工作清單，無論換班或重新登記，身上配備的工具與簡報摘要都確實保留。⟧
body.en: When managing agents using the `claude agents` command, launch parameters such as `--model`, `--effort`, and permission modes are no longer lost after an auto-update relaunch. On Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry platforms, subagents configured with the Opus model correctly recognize and retain their model settings. Messages sent by a subagent to the main session remain fully preserved in the desktop transcript after a relaunch, and a subagent's concise progress summary is no longer accidentally overwritten by a runaway multi-paragraph reply. ⟦This is like a dispatched specialist's badge and task list: regardless of shift changes or re-registration, their equipped tools and briefing summaries remain intact.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `claude agents` losing `--model`, `--effort`, `--permission-mode`, `--allow-dangerously-skip-permissions` and `--agent` after an auto-update relaunch
Fixed subagents with `model: "opus"` on Bedrock, Vertex or Foundry leaving the session's model when its id has no recognizable model family (unless `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL` is set)
Fixed a message a subagent sends to the main session disappearing from the Claude Desktop transcript after a relaunch
Fixed a sub-agent's progress summary being replaced by a runaway multi-paragraph reply

title.zh-TW: 背景任務接續更流暢，通知彙整省下模型輪次
title.en: Smoother Background Task Resumption and Notification Batching to Save Model Turns

body.zh-TW: 在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視窗的背景執行模式）與 SDK 工作階段中，多個同時完成的背景任務現在會合併為單次模型呼叫處理，不再逐一分次發送請求。恢復執行被中斷的背景代理時，不會殘留不完整的批次工具呼叫；使用 `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` 接續工作時，也能正確回報先前未完成的背景任務。背景代理等待任務時的狀態通知更加準確。監視工具的腳本輸出與結束狀態合併為單一通知送達。⟦這宛如檢驗機將採集的多組樣本一次送入分析儀，省去反覆開關機器的等待時間。⟧
body.en: In headless mode and SDK sessions, multiple background tasks finishing concurrently are now handled in a single model call rather than sending individual requests one by one. Resuming an interrupted background agent avoids leaving behind incomplete batched tool calls, and resuming work with `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` properly reports previously unfinished background tasks. Status notifications when background agents wait on tasks are more accurate. Script output and exit status from the Monitor tool are delivered merged into a single notification. ⟦This is like a laboratory machine feeding multiple collected samples into an analyzer all at once, eliminating the wait time of repeatedly powering the device on and off.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a resumed background agent keeping half of an interrupted tool batch when one of its calls was approved with a message
Fixed a local `claude -p --resume` started with `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` not reporting background tasks the previous process left unfinished
Fixed background agent notifications claiming the agent had no live background work when it was still waiting on its own background task and would resume
Fixed headless and SDK sessions making a separate model call for every background task that finished; completions already queued are now answered by one call
Improved Monitor tool notifications: a script's final output and its exit now arrive as one notification instead of two, saving a model turn

title.zh-TW: 外掛管理效能升級，設定載入不再頻繁重讀
title.en: Plugin Management Performance Upgrades and Elimination of Redundant Configuration Reloads

body.zh-TW: 外掛套件（Plugin，擴充系統功能的附加模組）原則由遠端集中管理時，系統啟動時不再頻繁重寫清單檔案，避免桌面版重複重新載入所有工作階段的外掛。外掛重新載入後，執行終端機指令時只有在執行檔目錄變更時才會重新讀取設定檔，有效消除指令執行時的停頓。獨立外掛目錄不再錯誤繼承外部的 Git 版本號；從壓縮檔載入的外掛在多次重載後不會讀取到舊解壓檔案；複製套件庫時預設保留大檔案指標以節省頻寬。⟦這好比在工具箱安裝新配件時，只在工具位置改變時清點收納格，平時不必整箱翻開重對。⟧
body.en: When plugin policy is centrally managed remotely, the system no longer frequently rewrites the manifest file on startup, preventing the desktop version from repeatedly reloading plugins across all open sessions. After plugins reload, terminal commands only re-source the profile if executable directories changed, effectively eliminating command execution stalls. Standalone plugin directories no longer mistakenly inherit version numbers from enclosing Git repositories; plugins loaded from archive files avoid stale extracted files after multiple reloads; and repository clones retain Git LFS pointers by default to save bandwidth. ⟦This is like installing a new accessory in a toolbox: only inventorying compartments when a tool's location changes, without needing to unpack and check the entire box every time.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a plugin or marketplace directory with no git repository of its own taking its version from an enclosing git repository, such as a git-managed `~/.claude`
Fixed `installed_plugins.json` being rewritten on nearly every start-up when plugin policy comes from remote managed settings, which made Claude Desktop reload every open session's plugins
Fixed the Bash tool re-sourcing the shell profile (a multi-second stall on the next command) after every plugin reload; it now does so only when the plugins' `bin/` directories changed
Fixed plugins with a top-level `$schema` in `hooks/hooks.json` showing an "unknown key" notice
Fixed a plugin loaded from a `.zip` being served from a stale extraction after several overlapping reloads
Changed plugin and marketplace clones to leave Git LFS files as pointers instead of downloading them; `git lfs pull` in the checkout fetches them

title.zh-TW: 成果工件讀寫更順暢，團隊協作與發布防覆蓋
title.en: Smoother Artifact Operations and Overwrite Protection for Team Collaboration and Publishing

body.zh-TW: ⟦多人共用雲端設計圖時，系統在送出修改前先確認線上最新版本，避免後發布的圖稿意外覆蓋隊友心血。⟧ 成果工件（Artifact，由 AI 產生的獨立檔案或程式碼成果）工具現在於更新前會先確保工作階段讀取最新內容，不再出現確認更新後又被拒絕的窘境。在團隊協作與雲端環境中，讀取隊友工件不再被誤判為網路連線關閉。若尚未登入雲端帳號，首次執行即會明確告知並減少無效重試。發布舊版本時會主動攔截並提供最新頁面以便合併；本機環境中遠端發布的新版本也不會無故打斷目前對話。
body.en: ⟦When multiple people collaborate on cloud blueprints, the system checks the latest online version before submitting modifications, preventing newly published drafts from accidentally overwriting teammates' work.⟧ The Artifact tool now ensures the session reads the latest content before updating, eliminating the dilemma where an approved update is subsequently refused. In team collaboration and cloud environments, reading a teammate's artifact is no longer misjudged as disabled network access. If not signed in to a cloud account, the terminal clearly notifies on the first attempt and stops futile retries sooner. Publishing based on an older version is proactively intercepted with the newer page provided to merge, and new versions published remotely in local environments no longer interrupt current conversation turns.

items.original:
Fixed the Artifact tool asking you to approve an update to an artifact that it then refused because the session had not read the latest version
Fixed Cowork and claude.ai cloud sessions with network access on treating reads of a teammate's artifact as if network access were off
Improved Artifact tool errors: when you are not signed in to claude.ai the terminal now says so on the first attempt, and Claude is told to stop retrying a rejected call sooner
Improved artifact publishing: a publish built on an older version is stopped before it is sent, with the newer page to merge
Changed artifact watching in local sessions: a new version published elsewhere no longer starts a turn; Claude learns of it from a later Artifact tool result

title.zh-TW: 指令權限把關更嚴密，工作樹隔離與編輯預覽修正
title.en: Stricter Command Permission Checks and Fixes for Worktree Isolation and Edit Previews

body.zh-TW: 執行包含特殊變數指派或迴圈的終端機指令時，系統現在會正確觸發權限確認提示。在工作樹（worktree，Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）隔離的工作階段中，帶有巢狀指令擴展的潛在危險操作會被直接拒絕。在包含多位元組字元（例如中文字）的檔案中，檔案編輯權限提示中的預覽位置不再與實際修改處產生偏差。此外，在移除包含子模組簽出的代理工作樹前，系統會執行更嚴謹的安全檢查以防資料遺失。⟦這好比施工現場嚴格核實每張特種作業操作證，拆除臨時鷹架前必須逐一檢查固定扣件。⟧
body.en: When executing terminal commands involving special variable assignments or loops, the system now properly triggers permission prompts. In worktree-isolated sessions, potentially dangerous operations with nested shell expansions are directly refused. In files containing multi-byte characters, the preview position in Edit permission prompts no longer drifts from the actual modification location. Furthermore, the system performs stricter safety checks before removing an agent worktree containing submodule checkouts to prevent data loss. ⟦This is like a construction site strictly verifying every special operations permit and inspecting each fastener before dismantling temporary scaffolding.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Bash permission checks for commands that loop over or assign certain special shell variables; these commands now ask for permission
Fixed worktree-isolated sessions accepting Bash commands with certain nested shell expansions; these are now refused
Fixed the Edit permission prompt preview sometimes showing a different location than the approved edit in files with multi-byte characters
Improved safety checks before removing an agent worktree that contains submodule checkouts

title.zh-TW: 全螢幕訊息點擊展開，問答預覽與檔案連結修復
title.en: Click-to-Expand Fullscreen Messages and Fixes for Question Previews and File Links

body.zh-TW: 在全螢幕模式下，原本摺疊的隊友與代理訊息現在支援點擊展開完整閱讀。終端機中指向本機檔案路徑的可點擊連結，已修正為符合 `file://` 協定標準，在 VS Code 等終端機中點擊即可順利開啟檔案。在互動問答工具的預覽模式下，輸入的備註文字會精準附加在當前反白的選項上，按下 Enter 送出時也不會遺失選取的項目。在 Linux Wayland 環境的編輯器終端機中啟動時，不再異常開啟額外的空白編輯器視窗。⟦這就像展覽館的導覽平板，點選摘要直接展開詳情，填寫問卷時備註欄位精準鎖定勾選的項目。⟧
body.en: In fullscreen mode, collapsed teammate and agent messages now support click-to-expand for full reading. Clickable links pointing to local file paths in the terminal have been corrected to adhere to the `file://` protocol standard, opening files smoothly when clicked inside terminals like VS Code. In AskUserQuestion preview mode, entered notes attach accurately to the currently highlighted option, and pressing Enter to submit no longer drops the selected item. Launching inside editor terminals on Linux under Wayland no longer unexpectedly opens extra blank editor windows. ⟦This is like an exhibition tablet guide: clicking a summary instantly expands full details, and note fields precisely lock onto checked items when completing a survey.⟧

items.original:
Added click-to-expand for collapsed teammate and agent messages in fullscreen mode
Fixed clickable links to local file paths doing nothing in VS Code and other terminals that require a `file://` URI
Fixed AskUserQuestion preview notes being attached to a previously chosen option instead of the highlighted one
Fixed AskUserQuestion preview mode dropping the highlighted option when submitting a note with Enter
Fixed extra empty editor windows opening at startup on Linux under Wayland when running inside the Cursor or VS Code terminal

title.zh-TW: 斜線指令提示精準對齊，程式碼審查更輕量
title.en: Accurate Slash Command Guidance and Leaner Code Review Execution

body.zh-TW: 桌面版工作階段中的錯誤提示現在會引導使用 `/usage-credits` 等斜線指令，不再推薦無效的命令列參數。當組織政策禁用快速模式時，非互動環境輸入 `/fast on` 會明確告知已被停用。`/schedule` 儲存例行排程時能完整保留提示詞角色。`/status` 指令會正確顯示金鑰輔助程式的失敗細節，並將相關雲端功能統一標示為雲端工作階段。`/code-review` 改為使用輕量化的內嵌提示詞，不再為一般模型繁衍過多審查子代理。⟦整套操作猶如汽車儀表板更新，各項開關與警示燈號各就其位，清楚反映目前的行車模式。⟧
body.en: Error hints in desktop sessions now suggest slash commands such as `/usage-credits` instead of invalid command-line flags. When organization policy disables fast mode, entering `/fast on` in non-interactive environments explicitly reports that it has been disabled. The `/schedule` command preserves prompt message roles when saving routines. The `/status` command correctly displays failure details for the API key helper and unifies terminology for related features under cloud sessions. The `/code-review` command switches to leaner inline review prompts, avoiding spawning excessive review subagents for standard models. ⟦The entire operation is like updating a car dashboard: every switch and warning light falls neatly into place, clearly reflecting the current driving mode.⟧

items.original:
Fixed error hints in Claude Desktop sessions to suggest slash commands like `/usage-credits` instead of CLI flags that cannot be used there
Fixed `/schedule` saving a routine's prompt without its message role when Claude writes the routine in the shape that listing routines returns
Fixed `/status` not showing the `apiKeyHelper` failure that its own error banner told you to check
Fixed `/fast on` in non-interactive sessions reporting on and then turning off under an organization's managed fast mode policy; it now says the organization has disabled it
Changed `/code-review` to use leaner inline review prompts for every model that has no tuned settings of its own, instead of spawning many review subagents
Changed the `/status` GitHub line to read "Cloud sessions", and `/web-setup`, `/ultrareview`, and teleport messages to say "cloud session" instead of "Claude Code on the web"

title.zh-TW: 語言伺服器診斷不卡頓，自託管執行器穩定續航
title.en: Fluid Language Server Diagnostics and Reliable Persistence for Self-Hosted Runners

body.zh-TW: 若是語言伺服器（LSP，在背景分析程式碼語法與錯誤的工具）對數千個檔案發布專案診斷時，系統不再於每一輪對話產生明顯延遲。自託管 Runner 執行器在更新 token（驗證身分的授權令牌）遇到短期失敗時會持續重試，遇到授權錯誤時也會主動重新取得憑證，不再讓工作階段頻繁中斷。在程式碼託管平台存取檢查被拒絕的唯讀套件庫，執行器會主動略過而非直接導致啟動失敗。雲端工作階段首輪對話也不會遺漏連線中的 MCP 工具。⟦這好比自動化工廠在面對龐大零件清單時穩定運行，遇到門禁感應不良也會即刻重刷通行證。⟧
body.en: When a language server publishes project-wide diagnostics across thousands of files, the system no longer causes noticeable per-turn slowdowns. Self-hosted runners now keep retrying upon transient failures during token refreshes, and actively fetch new tokens following authentication errors, preventing sessions from frequently breaking. The runner skips read-only repositories refused by the git host during access checks rather than failing session startup. The first turn of a cloud session no longer misses tools from connecting MCP servers. ⟦This is like an automated factory running smoothly when handling massive parts inventories, promptly swiping access passes again if a security sensor briefly misreads.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a per-turn slowdown when a language server publishes project-wide diagnostics for thousands of files
Fixed self-hosted runner sessions failing every turn with a 401 after a few failed token refreshes, until the next scheduled refresh; the runner now keeps retrying, and fetches a new token after a 401
Fixed the first turn of a cloud session sometimes starting without the tools of an SDK-hosted MCP server that was still connecting
Changed self-hosted runners to skip a read-only repository the git host refuses at the access check instead of failing the session start

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 視窗重載接續執行，自訂選單管理記憶與指示
title.en: [VSCode] Resuming Steps Across Window Reloads and Managing Memories and Instructions from Customize Menu

body.zh-TW: ⟦這就像在辦公桌上夾好工作便條，即使下班斷電重啟電腦，進行到一半的公文也能精準接續，抽屜裡的參考資料隨時都能查閱。⟧ 在 VS Code 中重新載入視窗後，系統會自動接續中斷的步驟並於對話中加上標籤；執行工具期間送出的訊息也不會再因重新載入而遺失。自訂選單中新增了記憶與指示管理項目，方便檢視自動記憶開關與編輯指示檔案。透過新增的 `claudeCode.lockEditorGroups` 設定，可防止擴充套件鎖定編輯器分組，解決重新開啟分頁或建立新工作階段時版面意外分割的問題。
body.en: ⟦This is like clipping notes to an office desk: even if the computer restarts after power-off, halfway-completed documents resume accurately, and reference materials in drawers remain accessible at any time.⟧ After reloading the window in VS Code, the system automatically continues interrupted steps with a label in chat, and messages sent while running a tool are no longer lost upon reload. The Customize menu adds Memory and Instructions entries to view auto-memory toggles and edit instruction files. A new `claudeCode.lockEditorGroups` setting prevents the extension from locking editor groups, resolving unintended layout splitting when reopening tabs or starting new sessions.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added continuation of the step a window reload interrupted, labeled in the chat, with a Claude Code: Continue After Reload setting to turn it off
[VSCode] Added Memory and Instructions entries to the Customize menu: Memory shows the auto-memory toggles, the saved memories and the memory folders, and Instructions edits the CLAUDE.md files
[VSCode] Added a `claudeCode.lockEditorGroups` setting to stop Claude from locking the editor groups it opens in
[VSCode] Fixed a message sent while Claude was running a tool disappearing from the conversation after a window reload
[VSCode] Fixed reopening a closed Claude tab splitting the editor layout when its locked group still holds another Claude tab and a file
[VSCode] Fixed New session opening another locked editor group whenever a file tab shared the group with your Claude tab

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 設定寫入防衝突，快捷鍵開啟分頁即刻輸入
title.en: [VSCode] Conflict-Free Settings Writes and Immediate Focus on New Tab Shortcut

body.zh-TW: 在 VS Code 中使用快捷鍵開啟新分頁時，輸入框會自動取得焦點，無需手動點擊即可直接打字。擴充套件並行寫入設定時增加防護，避免 `~/.claude/settings.json` 損毀或遺漏設定項。新對話剛建立時使用 `/btw` 提問，不再錯誤顯示其他工作階段的歷史問答。首次查詢全域忽略檔案時的短暫卡頓已消除，並支援標準的 XDG 設定路徑。在環境變數設定中修改設定目錄後，終端機內的登入與登出狀態會即時反映。⟦這好比在資料夾中抽換文件時精確歸位，翻開新活頁紙時筆尖已在第一行待命。⟧
body.en: When opening a new tab via shortcut in VS Code, the input box automatically gains focus so you can type immediately without clicking. Overlapping settings writes from the extension now include safeguards to prevent `~/.claude/settings.json` corruption or dropped settings. Asking side questions with `/btw` right after starting a conversation no longer mistakenly displays another session's history. The brief freeze when first querying global gitignore files is resolved, with standard XDG config paths supported. Sign-in and sign-out states in terminals reflect immediately after changing configuration directories in environment variables. ⟦This is like neatly slotting documents back into a binder: turning to a fresh page finds the pen tip already poised at the first line.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed a `/btw` side question asked in a new conversation's first seconds occasionally showing another session's side-question history
[VSCode] Fixed a brief freeze when the extension first looks up your global gitignore file
[VSCode] Fixed sign-ins and sign-outs made in a terminal not showing until a reload after `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` changed in the Environment Variables setting
[VSCode] Fixed overlapping settings writes from the extension leaving `~/.claude/settings.json` unparseable or dropping a setting
[VSCode] Fixed Open in New Tab (Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Esc) sometimes leaving the new tab's message box unfocused, so typing went nowhere until you clicked it
[VSCode] Changed the default global gitignore file to `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/git/ignore` when `XDG_CONFIG_HOME` is an absolute path

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 差異比對完整呈現，無障礙與高對比主題修復
title.en: [VSCode] Full Diffs Display and Fixes for Accessibility and High Contrast Themes

body.zh-TW: 對話中的檔案修改差異比對框現在會完全貼合內容行數，即使在長行折行或特殊面板寬度下也不再被底部截斷。在高對比主題下，行內代碼與程式碼區塊已恢復清晰可讀。螢幕報讀軟體現在會清楚朗讀訊息發送者（例如「You」或「Claude」）與執行的工具名稱。計畫審查卡片支援留言清單捲動，不再遮擋意見回饋按鈕。外掛管理與 MCP 對話框支援完整鍵盤操作。工作階段選擇器在搜尋時名稱不再橫向晃動。⟦整套介面升級猶如為文件加上合適的字級與語音導覽，無論使用哪種閱讀輔助工具都能舒適瀏覽。⟧
body.en: Edit diff boxes in chat now fit the exact number of rows displayed, no longer getting cut off at the bottom under wrapped lines or specific panel widths. Under High Contrast themes, inline code and code blocks are once again clearly readable. Screen readers now clearly announce message senders (such as "You" or "Claude") along with the names of executed tools. The plan review card supports scrolling through comments, preventing the feedback button from being obstructed. Plugin management and MCP dialogs now support full keyboard navigation. Session names no longer shift horizontally when typing queries in the session picker. ⟦The entire interface upgrade is like adding appropriate typography and audio guidance to a document, ensuring comfortable browsing regardless of assistive tools used.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the Manage Plugins enable toggle and MCP servers dialog rows being unreachable from the keyboard
[VSCode] Fixed Edit diffs in the chat being cut off at the bottom at some panel widths and for long wrapped lines; diff boxes now fit the rows shown
[VSCode] Fixed session names shifting sideways in the session picker while typing a search query
[VSCode] Fixed the plan review card cutting off its Send feedback button and reason field when a plan has several comments; the comment list now scrolls
[VSCode] Fixed inline code and code blocks in chat replies being unreadable under the High Contrast themes
[VSCode] Improved screen reader navigation of the conversation: each message is announced as "You" or "Claude", with the tool name for tool steps

title.zh-TW: [網頁版] 雲端分支靈活比對，Git 操作與認證更穩定
title.en: [Claude Code on the web] Flexible Cloud Branch Diffing and More Stable Git Operations and Authentication

body.zh-TW: ⟦在雲端檢視工程藍圖時，你隨時能挑選任意版本進行對照，換發臨時通行證時也不會耽誤現場施工。⟧ 網頁版雲端工作階段的差異比對檢視中，新增了分支選擇器，讓你自由比對變更與任何分支的差異，不再受限於基準分支。當 GitHub 的 token（用於存取服務的授權令牌）短期更新失敗時，Git 操作不再直接跳出服務不可用的錯誤；認證憑證重新整理後，程式碼提交也不會再出現短暫的簽章失敗。標記已讀的工作階段不會再跳回未讀狀態。
body.en: ⟦When reviewing engineering blueprints in the cloud, you can select any version for comparison at any time, and reissuing temporary passes never delays on-site work.⟧ In the diff view for cloud sessions on the web, a new branch picker lets you freely compare changes against any branch instead of being restricted to the base branch. When GitHub token renewals briefly fail, git operations no longer throw service unavailable errors; and after credentials refresh, commits no longer experience temporary signing errors. Sessions marked as read no longer revert back to an unread status.

items.original:
[Claude Code on the web] Added a "Compare against" branch picker to a cloud session's diff view, so you can diff its changes against any branch instead of only the base branch
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed git operations in cloud sessions failing with "service unavailable" when GitHub's token renewal briefly errors
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed commits in cloud sessions occasionally failing with a signing error for a few minutes after the session's credentials refreshed
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed sessions sometimes flipping back to unread right after you mark them read

title.zh-TW: [網頁版] 例行排程穩定度提升，連線異常支援長效重試
title.en: [Claude Code on the web] Improved Routine Reliability and Long-Term Retry for Disconnected Accounts

body.zh-TW: 編輯例行排程（Routine，在雲端定時或依事件觸發的自動化任務）時，不再發生意外觸發兩次或自動重新啟用已暫停排程的狀況。儲存排程若因達到觸發上限等原因無法連結 GitHub，提示訊息會具體指出失敗原因。當擁有者的 GitHub 連線遺失時，排程會跳過當次執行並持續重試長達七十二小時，不再於首次檢查失敗時直接關閉排程。當訂閱暫停導致排程擱置時，通知會清楚引導在恢復訂閱後手動重新開啟排程。⟦這好比花園的自動定時灑水器，水管暫時缺水時會定時再次嘗試供水，不會直接整組報廢。⟧
body.en: Editing a routine no longer triggers unintended double firing or automatically re-enables a paused routine. When saving a routine fails to link with GitHub due to repository trigger limits, the toast message explicitly details the failure cause. When the owner's GitHub connection is lost, the routine skips the current run and continues retrying for up to seventy-two hours instead of disabling the routine on the first failed check. When subscription pauses place a routine on hold, the notice clearly guides users to manually re-enable it after restoring the subscription. ⟦This is like an automated garden sprinkler system: when the water pipe is temporarily dry, it periodically re-attempts supply rather than scrapping the entire setup.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed editing a routine occasionally making it fire twice or re-enabling a routine that had just been paused
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed the toast after saving a routine whose GitHub trigger couldn't be linked to show the reason, such as a per-repository trigger limit, instead of only "edit to retry"
[Claude Code on the web] Changed routines to skip a run and retry for up to 72 hours when the owner's GitHub connection is missing, instead of switching the routine off at the first failed check
[Claude Code on the web] Changed a routine's on-hold notice: when your subscription is paused it now tells you to turn the routine back on yourself instead of promising an automatic resume

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] 頻道訪客權限預先設定，機器人標記即時喚醒
title.en: [Claude Tag] Upfront Channel Guest Permissions and Prompt Bot Mention Wakeups

body.zh-TW: ⟦這好比辦公大樓的智慧值班管家，不僅能預先登記訪客通行等級，聽到其他部門助理呼叫時也會立刻起身應對。⟧ 在 Claude Tag 管理設定中新增了訪客權限選項，讓管理員在新增頻道時預先指定存取規範。當其他 Slack 應用程式或機器人標記 `@Claude` 時，即使頻道閒置多日也能正確喚醒並回覆；新頻道建立時的標記訊息也會在加入後順利送達。隔數分鐘後發送的重要後續更新會發布為新的通知訊息，不再靜默修改舊訊息。跨工作區共享頻道監控與環境名稱顯示也已修正。
