[Code Review] Fixed follow-up reviews re-posting a security finding a person had already resolved when a later push moved the lines it was anchored to
[Code Review] Fixed reopening a finished /ultrareview cloud session in the Claude app starting the whole review over again unprompted
Windows: Fixed PowerShell commands failing with "Exit code 1" and no output when the session's temp output path reaches 260 characters

title.zh-TW: 程式碼審查不再重複發文，已解決問題不重複回報
title.en: Code Review Stops Duplicate Posts and Won't Re-report Resolved Findings

body.zh-TW: 在 GitHub 上提交拉取請求等待審查時，最怕遇到審查遺漏或重複回報。現在限制每個拉取請求審查一次的儲存庫中，若在排隊等候時送入新修訂，會如實審查該次修訂。當 GitHub 回報錯誤但實際已建立審查時，不再重複張貼兩三次相同的意見。針對先前已由真人標記解決的資安問題，即使後續程式碼行數挪移，追蹤審查也不會重新貼出。在應用程式中重新打開已完成的 `/ultrareview` 雲端工作階段（session），也不會無故重頭跑完整輪審查。⟦這有如雜誌社編輯校對稿件，當作者更新段落時不會把同一個錯字反覆退件三次，已確認修正的章節也不會因為頁碼挪移就重新抓出來糾正。⟧
body.en: When submitting pull requests on GitHub for review, missing reviews or duplicate reports are frustrating. In repositories configured to review once per PR, if a new commit arrives while waiting in the queue, it now properly reviews that requested commit. When GitHub reports an error for a review that was actually created, it no longer repeatedly posts the same findings two or three times. For security findings previously resolved by a human, follow-up reviews will not re-post them even if subsequent code line numbers shift. Reopening a completed `/ultrareview` cloud session in the Claude app will no longer restart the entire review unprompted. ⟦This is like a magazine editor proofreading manuscripts: updating a paragraph won't trigger three duplicate rejection notices for the same typo, and chapters already verified as fixed won't be flagged again just because page numbers shifted.⟧

items.original:
[Code Review] Fixed a pull request in a repository reviewed once per PR sometimes getting no review when a commit arrived while its review was waiting to start; it now reviews the requested commit
[Code Review] Fixed Code Review occasionally posting the same findings two or three times when GitHub reported an error for a review it had in fact created
[Code Review] Fixed follow-up reviews re-posting a security finding a person had already resolved when a later push moved the lines it was anchored to
[Code Review] Fixed reopening a finished /ultrareview cloud session in the Claude app starting the whole review over again unprompted

title.zh-TW: Claude Tag 串流討論不中斷記憶，通知與環境選單更清楚
title.en: Claude Tag Preserves Thread Context and Clarifies Notifications and Environment Menus

body.zh-TW: 在通訊軟體群組裡呼叫 Claude Tag 協助工作時，多討論串的訊息管理變得更加可靠。在持續啟用的頻道中，即使對話主要發生在討論串內，討論串活動現在能維持工作上下文，不再每隔約一小時就重置記憶。指派 Claude 監控拉取請求的討論串，在重啟後能持續接收持續整合（CI）失敗、留言與審查通知。刪除已獲回覆的討論串首則訊息時，Claude 會如期終止該處的工作。不再因為其他機器人的舊指令而扣留發文，只有指名給 Claude 的指令才生效，不確定時會主動詢問。加入熱門頻道時的卡片會說明真實原因，不再誤稱看見大量自動發文。管理設定中的環境挑選器明確標示 Anthropic 託管或自託管選項並提供編輯連結。⟦這好比會議室裡的專屬秘書，只要大家還在子討論串裡發言就不會突然遺忘剛才的決議，聽到別人向其他助理交代事情時也不會胡亂插嘴。⟧
body.en: When invoking Claude Tag in chat groups to assist with work, managing messages across multiple threads is now far more reliable. In channels where Claude stays continuously active, even if conversations mostly take place within threads, thread activity now preserves working context instead of resetting memory roughly once every hour. A thread asking Claude to monitor a pull request continues to receive CI failure, comment, and review notifications even after restarting Claude. When the first message of a thread that Claude already replied to is deleted, Claude terminates its work there as expected. Claude no longer holds back posts due to earlier instructions addressed to other bots; only instructions addressed to Claude take effect, and it proactively asks when unsure. The card posted upon joining a busy channel now explains the real reason rather than incorrectly claiming it sees a lot of automated posts. The Environment picker in admin settings clearly labels Anthropic-hosted or self-hosted options and provides links to edit or create them. ⟦This is like a dedicated secretary in a meeting room who won't suddenly forget recent decisions as long as people are still speaking in breakout threads, nor interject when someone delegates tasks to a different assistant.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude in a channel where it stays active losing its working context about once an hour when the conversation is mostly in threads; thread activity now keeps it from being reset
[Claude Tag] Fixed a thread that asked Claude to watch a pull request no longer hearing about CI failures, comments and reviews after Claude was restarted in that thread
[Claude Tag] Fixed deleting the first message of a thread Claude had already replied in not ending Claude's work there; it now stops, as it did when a message with no replies was deleted
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude holding back a post because of an earlier instruction addressed to a different bot or assistant; only instructions addressed to Claude bind it, and it asks when unsure
[Claude Tag] Fixed the reply-mode card Claude posts on joining a busy channel saying it "sees a lot of automated posts" when the channel is only chatty or large; the card now names the real reason
[Claude Tag] Improved the Environment picker in Claude Tag admin settings: options are labeled Anthropic-hosted or self-hosted, with links to edit that environment or create one

title.zh-TW: 網頁版例行工作頁面改版，雙分頁呈現執行狀態
title.en: Web Routines Page Redesigned with Dual Tabs Displaying Run Status

body.zh-TW: 登入網頁版管理自動排程任務時，例行工作（routines）頁面帶來全新架構。在 claude.ai/code 頁面上，版面劃分為「你的例行工作」與「範本」兩大分頁，並以雙欄卡片直觀呈現每項例行工作的執行狀態。同時移除了先前的日曆視圖，讓清單檢視更為俐落。⟦這就像把工具箱分成「自訂專用」與「現成範本」兩個抽屜，每張工作卡片上直接亮出執行燈號，找工具時一目了然。⟧
body.en: When managing automated scheduled tasks on the web, the Routines page introduces a fresh layout. On claude.ai/code, the layout is split into two major tabs, "Yours" and "Templates", using two-column routine cards that intuitively display the run status of each routine. The previous calendar view has also been removed to keep the list view streamlined. ⟦This is like organizing a toolbox into "Custom Tools" and "Ready-made Templates" drawers, where each task card displays a status light so you can find what you need at a glance.⟧

items.original: [Claude Code on the web] Changed the Routines page on claude.ai/code to a new layout with Yours and Templates tabs and two-column routine cards that show run status, and removed its calendar view

title.zh-TW: 雲端環境支援自訂網域白名單，離線工作階段發話即重啟
title.en: Cloud Environments Add Custom Domain Whitelisting, Offline Sessions Restart on Message

body.zh-TW: 管理雲端開發環境時，現在擁有更細緻的網路存取控制與快速恢復機制。在管理員設定的雲端環境編輯器中，新增了自訂網路存取選項，提供與 claude.ai/code 環境對話框相同的允許網域清單。管理頁面清楚列出 Claude Tag 與 Claude Code 的預設環境，附上切換連結並標註建議建立的類型。雲端工作階段（session）在背後行程結束但外觀仍保持連線時，以前可能卡住約十分鐘才回應，現在只要發送訊息就會立刻重新啟動。⟦整套控管好比社區門禁的名冊管理，只有事先登記在白名單上的網址才能連線，遇到遠端連線中斷只要按門鈴就能立刻重新通電。⟧
body.en: Managing cloud development environments now offers finer network access controls and a rapid recovery mechanism. In the Cloud environments editor within admin settings, a Custom network access option has been added, offering the same allowed-domains list available in the claude.ai/code environment dialog. The admin page clearly lists the default environments for Claude Tag and Claude Code, complete with links to change them and labels indicating recommended types to create. When a cloud session's background process exits while the session still appears connected, it previously took about ten minutes to respond; now sending a message restarts it immediately. ⟦This control setup is like gated community access management: only pre-registered domains on the allowlist can connect, and if a remote connection drops, ringing the doorbell instantly reconnects the power.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed a cloud session sometimes taking about ten minutes to respond after its process exited while the session still looked live; sending a message now restarts it right away
[Claude Code on the web] Added a Custom network access option to the Cloud environments editor in admin settings, with the same allowed-domains list the environment dialog on claude.ai/code offers
[Claude Code on the web] Improved the Cloud environments admin page: it shows the default environment for Claude Tag and Claude Code, with a link to change it, and marks the recommended kind to create

title.zh-TW: VSCode 支援關閉自動附加檔案，工作階段清單更穩定
title.en: VSCode Supports Disabling Auto-Attached Files and Stabilizes Session List

body.zh-TW: 在 VSCode 編輯器中使用 Claude Code 寫程式時，對話傳送內容與歷史清單獲得多項體驗改善。新增「附加開啟中檔案（Attach Open File）」設定，關閉後不再自動將當前開啟的檔案內容塞入對話，但選取的文字片段依然會附加。工作區位於 Windows 網路磁碟機或 SUBST 虛擬磁碟時，修復歷史記錄只顯示目前工作階段（session）的問題。篩選選單同時勾選作用中與開啟時，不再隱藏處於閒置狀態的已開啟工作階段。工作階段清單重新整理時，新建的聊天視窗不會跳回上一筆對話。修改設定中的 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 環境變數後，側邊欄與分頁會即時套用新目錄。切換開關的開啟狀態顏色從原本的 Claude 橘色改為跟隨編輯器主題的按鈕顏色。⟦這如同在素描本上加上開關便利貼，不想把整份畫冊寄出時只要撥開開關，就只會傳送你用螢光筆圈選的那一段草稿。⟧
body.en: When coding with Claude Code in VSCode, message attachments and history lists receive several user experience improvements. A new "Attach Open File" setting allows turning off the automatic inclusion of currently open files in messages, while explicitly selected text is still attached. Fixed an issue where session history only showed the current session when the workspace was located on a Windows mapped network drive or SUBST virtual drive. When both Active and Open are checked in the filter menu, open idle sessions are no longer hidden. When the session list refreshes, newly created chat windows no longer switch back to the previous conversation. After changing the `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` environment variable in settings, the sidebar and open tabs immediately apply the new directory. The "on" state color of toggle switches has also changed from Claude orange to the editor theme's button color. ⟦This is like adding a toggle sticky note to a sketchbook: when you don't want to send the entire portfolio, simply flipping the switch sends only the draft excerpt highlighted with your marker.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Added an Attach Open File setting that, when turned off, stops the open file from being added to messages; selected text is still attached
[VSCode] Fixed session history showing only the current session when the workspace is on a Windows mapped network drive or SUBST drive
[VSCode] Fixed the session list's Active filter hiding open idle sessions when Open is also checked in the filter menu
[VSCode] Fixed a new chat switching back to the previous chat when the session list refreshed
[VSCode] Fixed open tabs and the side bar keeping the old config folder until a window reload after `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` changed in the `environmentVariables` setting
[VSCode] Changed the on state of toggle switches from Claude orange to the editor theme's button color

title.zh-TW: VSCode 掛鉤儲存防呆升級，消除主控台視窗閃爍
title.en: VSCode Upgrades Hook Save Guards and Eliminates Flashing Console Windows

body.zh-TW: 在 VSCode 擴充套件中微調自動化規則時，設定對話框與背景視窗干擾問題已全面改善。掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）與權限規則對話框不再把已成功的儲存誤報為失敗，並修正受外掛政策鎖定時畫面反白或儲存錯誤顯示顏色代碼的異常。儲存掛鉤時替換不再產生重複項目，修改標頭大小寫時能保留金鑰機密，且返回前會自動將本機設定檔加入忽略清單。設定檔本身導致儲存受阻時，彈出視窗會附帶「開啟設定檔」按鈕與錯誤原因。在 Windows 上執行背景 Git 或登入檢查時，不再頻繁閃爍黑色的主控台（console）視窗。提示快取（cache，把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用）時鐘懸浮文字與自動壓縮圖示的提示框顯示也已修復。⟦這好似填寫電子表單時的防呆設計，設定檔出問題時主動提供修改按鈕，背景查驗資料時也不會在螢幕前不斷閃爍黑色小視窗。⟧
body.en: When fine-tuning automation rules in the VSCode extension, settings dialogs and background window disturbances are now resolved. The Hooks and Permission rules dialogs no longer falsely report successful saves as failed, and issues causing the screen to go blank under plugin policy locks or showing color codes in save errors are fixed. Saving hooks on replace no longer produces duplicates, retyping header names in different capitalization preserves secrets, and the local settings file is added to gitignore before the save returns. When the settings file itself blocks saving, the popup includes an "Open settings file" button alongside the error reason. Background Git, ripgrep, or sign-in checks on Windows no longer cause black console windows to flash frequently. Prompt cache clock hover text delays and duplicate tooltips on the auto-compact icon are also fixed. ⟦This is like foolproof design on an electronic form: providing an edit button whenever a configuration error occurs, while background verification runs silently without flashing black windows on your screen.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the Hooks and Permission rules dialogs reporting a save that landed as failed, and the Hooks dialog going blank under a plugin-only policy lock or showing color codes in save errors
[VSCode] Fixed Hooks dialog saves: no duplicate hook on replace, a header name retyped in other capitals keeps its secret, and settings.local.json is gitignored before the save returns
[VSCode] Fixed console windows flashing on Windows when the extension runs background commands such as git, ripgrep, and the sign-in status check
[VSCode] Fixed the prompt cache clock's hover text appearing only after a delay, and the auto-compact icon showing the browser's own tooltip beside its popup
[VSCode] Improved the Hooks dialog: a save refused because of the settings file itself now opens a popup with an "Open settings file" button and the reason behind "Copy error"

title.zh-TW: 遠端連線支援快速模式，/fast 關閉與降速備援修復
title.en: Remote Connections Add Fast Mode, Fixing /fast Disabling and Fallback Speeds

body.zh-TW: 在雲端或自託管環境連線執行 Claude Code 遠端工作階段（session）時，現在也能享受快速模式的加速體驗。只要組織政策允許，遠端主機的設定或在工作階段中輸入 `/fast` 即可啟用快速模式。當組織停用快速模式時，輸入 `/fast off` 現在會如實關閉，不再錯誤回應模式不可用。跳過組織檢查啟動的工作階段在 API 拒絕快速請求後，會明確顯示原因並停止每回合重送。遇上用量額度（quota）上限或系統過載時，重試監控機制會自動切換速度。系統改以標準速度作為備援（fallback），不再直接中斷或堅持高速重試。⟦這就像行駛在高速公路的快速通行車道，只要公司授權就能順暢前進，遇到額度用盡或車流壅塞時也會自動切回一般車道穩定前行。⟧
body.en: When running Claude Code Remote sessions in cloud or self-hosted environments, users can now enjoy the accelerated experience of fast mode. Where organization policy allows, fast mode can be enabled via host settings or by typing `/fast` directly in the session. When the organization disables fast mode, typing `/fast off` now turns it off properly instead of returning an error stating the mode is unavailable. Sessions started by skipping organization checks will display the rejection reason and stop resending fast requests every turn once the API rejects them. When encountering usage quota limits or system overloads, the retry watchdog automatically switches speeds. The system falls back to standard speed rather than failing the turn or insisting on fast retries. ⟦This is like driving in an express lane on a highway: you cruise smoothly with company clearance, but automatically blend back into standard lanes if quotas run out or traffic becomes congested.⟧

items.original:
Added fast mode in Claude Code Remote sessions (cloud and self-hosted runners): the host's fast-mode setting or `/fast` typed in the session applies where your organization allows it
Fixed `/fast off` answering "Fast mode unavailable" instead of turning fast mode off when the organization has fast mode disabled
Fixed sessions started with `CLAUDE_CODE_SKIP_FAST_MODE_ORG_CHECK` re-sending fast requests every turn after the API rejected fast mode; the rejection now stands and its reason is shown
Fixed fast mode under `CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG` failing the turn on a usage-credits limit, or retrying an overload at fast speed, instead of falling back to standard speed

title.zh-TW: 企業政策即時更新，支援自訂模型計費倍率
title.en: Enterprise Policies Update Instantly with Custom Model Pricing Multipliers

body.zh-TW: 在企業組織中統籌多位成員的開發環境時，政策派發與成本拆帳迎來更精確的控管機制。在 `modelPricing` 管理設定與應用程式閘道器中，新增高於 1 且最高至 10 的 `multiplier` 參數，方便計算內部拆帳。切換帳號或金鑰時，組織政策快取（cache，把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）會即時刷新。工作階段（session）中途政策載入完成或變更後，工具與指令清單會同步更新。當企業的 `managed-mcp.json` 設定檔無法解析時，會在啟動時發出警告並維持專屬管制，禁止載入非核准的 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器。透過本機代理轉發組織政策時遭拒絕的問題也已修復。⟦這好比總公司的記帳系統，各部門調用資源時能依倍率精確分攤預算，一旦切換員工識別證，最新的授權規範也會立刻生效。⟧
body.en: Managing development environments across organizations now features more precise policy distribution and cost chargebacks. A `multiplier` parameter above 1 and up to 10 has been added to the `modelPricing` managed setting and the Claude apps gateway `pricing` block to facilitate marked-up internal chargeback rates. When switching accounts, organizations, or API keys, cached organization policies refresh immediately. When policies finish loading after startup or change mid-session, tool and command lists update synchronously. When an enterprise `managed-mcp.json` file cannot be parsed, it issues a warning at startup while maintaining exclusive control, blocking unapproved MCP servers from loading. Fixed an issue where organization policies were rejected when fetched through third-party local proxies configured via `ANTHROPIC_UNIX_SOCKET`. ⟦This is like a corporate accounting system where departments split budgets accurately using custom multipliers, and scanning a new employee badge immediately activates their updated authorization rules.⟧

items.original:
Added support for a `multiplier` above 1, up to 10, in the `modelPricing` managed setting and the Claude apps gateway `pricing` block, for marked-up internal chargeback rates
Fixed a cached organization policy being reused after switching accounts, organizations, or API keys, and the policy not refreshing until the hourly check when the credential changes mid-session
Fixed the tool and command lists not updating when the organization policy finishes loading after startup or changes mid-session
Fixed an enterprise `managed-mcp.json` that can't be read or parsed being ignored: it now keeps exclusive MCP control (user, project and plugin servers don't load) and warns at startup
Fixed org policy being fetched through, and rejected by, third-party local proxies set via `ANTHROPIC_UNIX_SOCKET`; they are again treated like other custom gateways, including for Remote Control

title.zh-TW: 自託管 Runner 支援退場標記，超大設定檔改存磁碟快照
title.en: Self-Hosted Runners Support Drain Markers and Store Oversized Configs on Disk

body.zh-TW: 自行架設伺服器執行自託管執行器（self-hosted runner）時，主機維護與大型專案設定更可靠。執行 `claude self-hosted-runner --drain-marker-file <path>` 後，只要指定檔案存在且收到 SIGTERM 退場信號，執行器會向伺服器通報 host drain，但這僅作 telemetry 通報，不代表額外調度行為。當主機設定資料夾超過 64 MiB 時，過去工作階段可能默默遺失整份 host config，包含 settings、skills、plugins、MCP servers。現在新增 `--host-config-snapshot disk|memory`，可把快照放在磁碟或記憶體。⟦這如同貨運列車進站維修前掛上整備標誌，調度中心只收到狀態回報，同時整份行車紀錄先完整備份，不會漏掉車廂清單。⟧
body.en: When operating self-hosted runners on your own servers, host maintenance and large project setups are significantly more reliable. Running `claude self-hosted-runner --drain-marker-file <path>` allows the runner to report its exit to the server as a host drain upon receiving a SIGTERM signal if the specified file exists, though this functions strictly as telemetry reporting without triggering extra scheduling. When the host config directory exceeds 64 MiB, sessions previously suffered from silently losing the entire host config, including settings, skills, plugins, and MCP servers. A new `--host-config-snapshot disk|memory` option now allows placing config snapshots on disk or in memory. ⟦This is like placing a maintenance tag on a freight train before depot servicing: dispatch receives the telemetry status while the full manifest is backed up safely so no cars are lost.⟧

items.original:
Added `claude self-hosted-runner --drain-marker-file <path>`: when that file exists at a SIGTERM drain, the runner reports its exit to the server as a host drain (telemetry only)
Fixed self-hosted runner sessions silently losing all host config (settings, skills, plugins, MCP servers) when the host config directory exceeds 64 MiB; added `--host-config-snapshot disk|memory`

title.zh-TW: 沙盒指令獨立設定連線網域，自動模式審查行內指令
title.en: Sandboxed Commands Configure Domain Access Independently, Auto Mode Reviews Inline Commands

body.zh-TW: 在自動模式搭配沙盒環境執行終端機操作時，網路安全界限變得更加嚴密。Bash、PowerShell 與 Monitor 指令在沙盒模式下新增個別指令的 `allowed_domains` 網域清單，指令所需的網路主機會與指令一同審查並僅向該指令開放，其他連線一律拒絕。技能或斜線指令中內嵌的 `!` 開頭 Shell 指令，改為遵循預設模式的權限規則而非由分類器全權判定，若無規則適用的指令則作為需審查的工具呼叫執行。⟦這套防護猶如實驗室的獨立通風櫥，每項化學實驗只能連接自己專屬的試劑管線，不會順手碰到隔壁工作台的藥品。⟧
body.en: When executing terminal operations in auto mode with sandboxing, network security boundaries are much tighter. Bash, PowerShell, and Monitor commands in sandboxed mode now include per-command `allowed_domains` lists, ensuring required network hosts are reviewed alongside each command and opened exclusively for it while all other hosts are refused. Inline `!` shell commands embedded inside skills or slash commands now follow default-mode permission rules rather than being evaluated entirely by the classifier; commands not covered by any rule execute as reviewed tool calls. ⟦This protection is like an isolated fume hood in a laboratory: each chemical experiment connects only to its dedicated reagent lines, preventing accidental contact with chemicals on neighboring workbenches.⟧

items.original:
Added per-command `allowed_domains` to Bash, PowerShell and Monitor in auto mode with sandboxing: the hosts a command needs are reviewed with it and opened for it alone; other hosts are refused
Changed auto mode so that a skill's or slash command's inline `!` shell commands follow default-mode permission rules instead of the classifier; a command no rule decides runs as a reviewed tool call

title.zh-TW: Bash 權限檢查涵蓋萬用字元，防堵跨目錄讀取漏洞
title.en: Bash Permission Checks Cover Wildcards to Prevent Cross-Directory Read Leaks

body.zh-TW: 透過命令列執行 Bash 工具時，權限防護系統對檔案路徑與參數的識別更加縝密。當 `fmt` 或 `column` 等指令跟隨未識別的選項時，不再遺漏其讀取的檔案路徑。萬用字元（wildcard，用星號代表多個檔案的符號）位於指令模式或選項值中時，例如 `grep -v dir/* file` 這類指令展開後的檔案都會納入權限檢查。Shell 變數宣告旗標不再造成指令被偽裝誤判。包含兩次目錄切換、子 Shell 或 `cd` 與 `git` 連接的指令，在啟用禁止讀取工作目錄外部設定時，不會跳過確認提示。⟦這就像倉庫巡檢員核對出入庫清單，即使貨物名稱帶有星號或特殊縮寫，也必須逐件核對是否超出指定的儲位範圍。⟧
body.en: When running Bash tools from the command line, permission guards identify file paths and arguments with greater precision. When commands like `fmt` or `column` are followed by unrecognized options, the file paths they read are no longer missed. When wildcards sit inside a command's pattern or option value, such as in `grep -v dir/* file`, all expanded files are now included in permission checks. Shell variable declaration flags can no longer misrepresent the command being run. Commands containing two directory changes, a subshell, or a `cd` and `git` chain will not bypass confirmation prompts when `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` is enabled in bypass or auto mode. ⟦This is like a warehouse inspector auditing inventory sheets: even when cargo names contain wildcards or special abbreviations, every item must be checked individually to ensure it stays within designated storage bays.⟧

items.original:
Fixed Bash permission checks missing the file that `fmt`, `column` and similar commands read when it follows an option the checker doesn't recognize
Fixed Bash permission checks skipping files a wildcard expands to when the wildcard sits in a command's pattern or option value (for example `grep -v dir/* file`)
Fixed Bash permission checks so that shell variable declaration flags cannot misrepresent the command being run
Fixed Bash commands with two directory changes, a subshell, or a `cd`+`git` chain skipping the prompt under `permissions.blockReadsOutsideWorkingDirectories` in bypass and auto mode

title.zh-TW: 外掛安裝支援 SHA-256 驗證，確保指令未被竄改
title.en: Plugin Installations Support SHA-256 Verification to Prevent Tampered Commands

body.zh-TW: 在自動化腳本中安裝或更新擴充外掛時，現在有比盲目確認更安全的核可機制。`claude plugin install` 與 `claude plugin update` 都新增 `--accept-command <sha256>` 參數，用來接受前一次 `--json` run 顯示的指令雜湊值。這會精確比對那次顯示的 command hash，取代原本直接用 `-y` 放行。⟦這好比快遞簽收時對照包裹上的防偽標籤，確認序號完全相符才開箱，避免途中被調包成不同指令。⟧
body.en: When installing or updating plugins within automated scripts, a safer verification mechanism replaces blind confirmations. Both `claude plugin install` and `claude plugin update` have added the `--accept-command <sha256>` parameter to accept the exact command hash displayed in a previous `--json` run. This matches the displayed command hash precisely instead of passing `-y` unconditionally. ⟦This is like checking an anti-tamper security seal on a parcel upon delivery: you only unbox after verifying the exact serial number, preventing goods from being swapped for different instructions in transit.⟧

items.original: Added `--accept-command <sha256>` to `claude plugin install` and `claude plugin update` to accept exactly the command a previous `--json` run displayed, instead of `-y`

title.zh-TW: 子代理支援精簡模式，動態工作流程達額度自動暫停
title.en: Subagents Support Lean Mode, Dynamic Workflows Auto-Pause at Quota Limits

body.zh-TW: 多代理拆專案時，子代理（subagent）少載規則，回報可控。自訂/外掛子代理可用 frontmatter/`--agents` JSON 裡的 `omitClaudeMd`，不載入使用者、專案、本機 `CLAUDE.md`，但載入管理政策。雲端工作階段（session）重啟工作單元後，不再拒絕子代理工具呼叫。動態工作流程遇到用量額度（quota）上限會暫停，重置後接續。自動模式改用 hand-back call 回報並由安全分類器審查。Pro 預設規模改為 small，medium 上限從 15 降到 10。`claude-api` 技能讓串流自訂工具啟用 `eager_input_streaming`，並用 `user.define_outcome` 開始 deliverable-shaped Managed Agents work。⟦這像外包只收工單，缺料時先停工。⟧
body.en: When splitting projects across multiple agents, subagents load fewer rules and provide controllable reporting. Custom and plugin subagents can use `omitClaudeMd` in agent frontmatter or `--agents` JSON to run without loading user, project, or local `CLAUDE.md` files, while managed policy files still load. Cloud sessions no longer reject subagent tool calls after worker restarts. Dynamic workflows pause upon hitting usage limits and resume automatically when reset, rather than dropping agents. Auto mode now reports back via dedicated hand-back calls reviewed by the safety classifier. The default dynamic workflow size on Pro plans is now small, and the medium guideline is lowered from 15 to 10 agents. The `claude-api` skill enables `eager_input_streaming` on streaming custom tools and initiates deliverable-shaped Managed Agents work with `user.define_outcome`. ⟦This is like contractors working strictly off work orders and pausing production when materials run out.⟧

items.original:
Added `omitClaudeMd` to agent frontmatter and `--agents` JSON, letting custom and plugin subagents run without user, project and local CLAUDE.md files; managed policy files still load
Fixed cloud sessions rejecting every subagent tool call ("updatedInput … failed schema validation") when a workflow or agent approval was applied after the session's worker restarted
Improved dynamic workflows to pause when you hit your usage limit and continue automatically when it resets, instead of dropping the affected agents
Changed auto mode so a subagent reports back to its caller through a dedicated hand-back call that the safety classifier reviews, instead of its last message being reviewed after the fact
Changed the default dynamic workflow size to small on Pro plans and lowered the medium size guideline from 15 to 10 agents
Updated the bundled `claude-api` skill to enable `eager_input_streaming` on streaming custom tools, and to start deliverable-shaped Managed Agents work with `user.define_outcome`

title.zh-TW: /config 支援全螢幕滑鼠滾輪，路徑與選取標籤優化
title.en: Fullscreen /config Adds Mouse Support, Optimizing Paths and Selection Pills

body.zh-TW: 在終端機介面中調整系統偏好或輸入路徑時，互動操作變得更符合現代使用習慣。全螢幕 `/config` 設定面板加入滑鼠支援，可透過滾輪滾動清單、點擊數值直接切換，游標下方的列也會高亮顯示。`/add-dir` 路徑輸入支援左右方向鍵移動游標，按下 Enter 鍵只會加入實際輸入的路徑，不會誤加反白的自動補齊項。主提示詞外的文字欄位不再將開頭的驚嘆號 `!` 移至末尾。修正全螢幕渲染殘留背景顏色的破圖。提示詞中的 IDE 選取標籤改為可隨文字換行的 `[⧉ …]` 膠囊標籤，按 Backspace 即可移除。⟦整套操作宛如將控制面板升級為觸控介面，滑動滾輪就能翻頁、點選就能變更開關，輸入文字時游標也能自由左右移動。⟧
body.en: Adjusting system preferences or typing paths in the terminal is now far more ergonomic. The fullscreen `/config` panel adds mouse support, allowing the scroll wheel to navigate settings, clicking values to toggle them, and highlighting the row under the pointer. The `/add-dir` path input supports left and right arrow keys to move the cursor, and pressing Enter adds only the typed path instead of including highlighted autocompletions. Text fields outside the main prompt no longer shift a leading exclamation mark `!` to the end of your input. Fixed a fullscreen rendering glitch where text retained a stale background color. The IDE selection indicator in prompts is now a `[⧉ …]` pill that wraps cleanly with text and can be removed with Backspace. ⟦This overhaul feels like upgrading a control panel to a touchscreen: scrolling turns pages, clicking toggles switches, and the cursor moves freely while typing.⟧

items.original:
Added mouse support to the `/config` panel in fullscreen mode: the wheel scrolls the settings list, a click on a setting's value changes it, and the row under the pointer is highlighted
Fixed the `/add-dir` path input: the left and right arrow keys now move the cursor, and Enter adds only the typed path instead of also adding the highlighted completion
Fixed text fields outside the main prompt moving a leading `!` to the end of what you typed (`!foo` came out as `foo!`)
Fixed a fullscreen rendering glitch where text kept a stale background color after the box around it lost its background
Changed the IDE selection indicator in the prompt to a `[⧉ …]` pill that wraps with the text instead of squeezing multi-line prompts; delete it with Backspace to leave the selection out

title.zh-TW: MCP 支援工具簡稱搜尋，長任務定時回報防止中斷
title.en: MCP Supports Bare Name Tool Searches and Periodic Updates for Long Tasks

body.zh-TW: 透過 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）擴充工具庫時，伺服器連線與呼叫流程更為穩健。工具搜尋支援 Claude 以簡短名稱選取工具，不再強制使用完整前綴名稱。當 MCP 伺服器密集發送清單變更通知時，能有效防止 CPU 負載過高與重複請求。`claude mcp serve` 執行中的工具呼叫每 30 秒發送一次進度更新，避免因長時間無輸出而被閒置逾時中斷。雲端平台中標記為 `alwaysLoad` 的 MCP 伺服器在中途連線完成後，下一回合即可直接使用。恢復工具全來自 MCP 的單次提示詞工作階段（session）時不再報錯。⟦這好比廚房出餐時每隔一段時間向點餐櫃檯回報進度，避免外場誤以為當機而直接取消訂單，尋找工具時也能憑簡稱迅速定位。⟧
body.en: Expanding toolsets via MCP now provides more reliable server connections and execution flows. Tool search allows Claude to select tools by bare names without requiring full prefixed names. When an MCP server sends rapid list change notifications, sustained high CPU usage and duplicate requests are effectively prevented. Running tool calls in `claude mcp serve` send progress updates every 30 seconds, preventing idle timeouts from aborting long commands that produce no output. MCP servers marked `alwaysLoad` in cloud platforms can be used on the next turn once connected mid-conversation. Resuming single-prompt sessions whose tools come entirely from MCP servers no longer throws errors. ⟦This is like a kitchen updating the order counter periodically so the front desk doesn't cancel orders assuming the system froze, while tools can be located quickly by shorthand names.⟧

items.original:
Fixed resumed `claude -p` sessions whose tools all come from MCP servers failing with "At least one tool must have defer_loading=false"
Fixed sustained high CPU usage and repeated tool-list requests when an MCP server sends `list_changed` notifications in a tight loop
Fixed tool search returning no match when Claude selects an MCP tool by its bare name instead of its full `mcp__server__tool` name
Improved `claude mcp serve`: a running tool call now sends a progress update every 30 seconds, so clients show it is still running and idle timeouts don't abort a long command that prints nothing
Improved Foundry and Claude Platform on AWS sessions: an `alwaysLoad` MCP server that finishes connecting mid-conversation is usable on the next turn without a tool-search round trip

title.zh-TW: MCP 授權註冊邏輯修復，快捷鍵不再中斷重新連線
title.en: MCP OAuth Registration Logic Fixed, Shortcuts Won't Cancel Reconnects

body.zh-TW: 連接需要身分驗證的第三方 MCP 伺服器時，授權交握與遠端遙控操作更加穩定。修正 MCP（Model Context Protocol，讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）OAuth 授權用戶端註冊處理，解決拒絕同意時強制重新註冊、誤用其他轉址 URI，以及多重寫入刪除有效憑據或保留錯誤設定的問題。按下 Ctrl+O 快捷鍵不再意外取消正在排隊的 MCP 伺服器重新連線。修復在開啟對話紀錄視圖時，從遠端操控（Remote Control）發送 `/mcp` 指令失敗的異常。⟦這就像辦理證件時核發的臨時通行證，換個窗口辦理不會重複發卡，重新連線時也不會被中途開啟的紀錄視窗意外打斷。⟧
body.en: Connecting to third-party MCP servers requiring authentication is now much more stable during handshakes and remote control. MCP OAuth client registration handling is fixed, resolving issues where denying consent forced re-registration, reused registrations for different redirect URIs, or, during concurrent writes, deleted valid credentials or kept a mismatched registration. Pressing Ctrl+O no longer cancels pending MCP server reconnections. Fixed an error where `/mcp` commands sent from Remote Control failed while the transcript view was open. ⟦This is like issuing temporary visitor badges: visiting a different desk won't issue duplicate passes, and reconnecting won't be interrupted by someone opening a log window.⟧

items.original:
Fixed MCP OAuth mishandling client registrations: denying consent forced a new one, one for another redirect URI was reused, and a concurrent write could delete a valid one or keep a mismatched one
Fixed Ctrl+O cancelling pending MCP server reconnects, and `/mcp` sent from Remote Control failing while the transcript view is open

title.zh-TW: 產出物渲染為精美排版文件，監聽數量上限翻倍
title.en: Artifacts Render as Styled Documents, Doubling Watched Artifact Limits

body.zh-TW: 利用產出物（artifacts）功能產出文件或程式碼時，預覽效果與檔案同步能力獲得顯著增強。發佈為產出物的 Markdown 檔案現在會渲染為具備標題列、排版樣式與語法高亮的精美文件頁面。單一工作階段（session）可同時監聽的發佈產出物上限從 5 個提升至 10 個，方便追蹤其他地方的重新發佈。背景工作階段會如實監聽自己發佈的產出物。透過 `/artifacts` 附加的產出物在以 `--resume` 恢復工作階段後不會消失。發佈錯誤訊息更清楚，未指定檔案時會提示先寫入檔案，並列出所有支援的功能規格。⟦這如同將草稿紙重新排版印刷成精裝書頁，標題與程式碼區塊都有專屬配色，還能同時追蹤多份文件在其他地方的修訂。⟧
body.en: Preview quality and file synchronization for documents and code generated via artifacts receive significant upgrades. Markdown files published as artifacts now render as styled document pages with title headers, document typography, and syntax-highlighted code. The maximum number of published artifacts a single session can watch simultaneously has increased from 5 to 10, facilitating tracking of republishes made elsewhere. Background sessions now watch artifacts they publish. Artifacts attached via `/artifacts` no longer disappear after resuming a session with `--resume`. Publish error messages are clearer, prompting users to write to a file first when none is specified and listing all supported capabilities. ⟦This is like typesetting manuscript drafts into hardcover pages with dedicated color palettes for headers and code blocks, while simultaneously tracking revisions across multiple external documents.⟧

items.original:
Fixed artifacts attached with `/artifacts` disappearing from the session after `--resume`
Fixed background sessions (`claude --bg`, `claude agents`) not watching the artifacts they publish for republishes made elsewhere
Improved Markdown files published as artifacts: they now render as styled document pages (title header, document typography, syntax-highlighted code)
Improved Artifact tool publish errors: a publish with no file now says to write the page to a file first, and an unsupported file type is reported before a missing favicon
Improved the Artifact tool's error when a page declares a capability its contract version lacks: it now lists every supported capability and notes when a newer contract version has it
Improved artifact watching: a session can now watch up to 10 published artifacts at once for republishes made elsewhere, up from 5

title.zh-TW: 工作階段恢復記憶精準，模型切換不誤報快取遺失
title.en: Precise Session Resumes Prevent False Cache Loss Warnings on Model Switches

body.zh-TW: 中斷工作後想接續先前的開發進度時，各項工作階段（session）恢復與狀態同步問題已獲得修復。使用 `/resume` 或 `/teleport` 恢復工作階段時，不會殘留前次對話的檔案讀取追蹤，確保權限狀態乾淨。使用 `--resume` 恢復工作階段時，即使模型系列與預設不同，也能正確保留百萬 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）的上下文視窗。使用 `/model` 切換回對話原本運行的模型時，不再誤報即將遺失快取（cache，把查過的結果暫存起來直接用）。對話壓縮後，仍在運行的背景指令不會被重複啟動第二份。跨工作階段傳送訊息時提供明確遞送狀態通知，而在高度較矮的終端機上使用全螢幕選單也能完整列出工作階段。⟦這好比看書時夾上精準的章節書籤，隔天翻開時能完整保留當前章節的記憶與快取，不會無故把書本重複翻開兩遍。⟧
body.en: Resuming earlier development work after interruptions is now smoother thanks to multiple session recovery fixes. Resuming sessions via `/resume` or `/teleport` no longer retains previous file-read tracking, ensuring clean permission states. Resuming via `--resume` preserves the 1M token context window even when the resumed session's model family differs from the configured default. Switching back to the model a conversation originally ran on via `/model` no longer falsely warns about losing the conversation cache. After conversation compaction, running background commands are not duplicated. Cross-session messaging provides clear delivery notifications, and fullscreen menus on short terminals display session lists properly. ⟦This is like placing a precise bookmark in a book: reopening it the next day preserves the memory and context of the current chapter without accidentally opening two copies of the book.⟧

items.original:
Fixed cross-session messages held by the receiving session's permission-mode policy leaving no trace: headless senders now get a delivery notice, and `SendMessage` results no longer imply it was read
Fixed Claude starting a second copy of a background command (such as a watch task or dev server) that was still running after the conversation was compacted
Fixed `/model` warning about losing the conversation cache when switching back to the model the conversation actually ran on
Fixed `/resume` and `/continue` showing only 1-2 sessions in fullscreen mode on short terminals
Fixed `/resume` and `/teleport` keeping the previous conversation's file-read tracking, so Claude could edit files the resumed conversation had never read
Fixed `--resume` dropping the 1M context window (`[1m]`) when the resumed session's model family differs from the configured default model

title.zh-TW: 掛鉤執行顯示耗時進度，支援 Esc 取消等待
title.en: Hook Executions Display Elapsed Time, Supporting Esc to Cancel Waiting

body.zh-TW: 設定自動化掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）時，執行狀態反饋更加即時透明。當 SessionStart、UserPromptSubmit、PreToolUse 或 SessionEnd 掛鉤執行時，狀態轉輪會明確顯示執行狀態與已耗費時間。在等待 SessionStart 掛鉤完成期間，可隨時按下 Esc 鍵取消當前提示詞。修復互動式 `/hooks` 選單在掛鉤比對名稱包含 `__proto__` 或 `constructor` 等保留屬性時發生的當機問題。⟦這如同在等待網頁載入時顯示具體的秒數進度條，隨時能按鍵中斷等待，設定特殊名稱時也不會讓整個系統選單卡死。⟧
body.en: Configuring automation hooks provides more immediate and transparent feedback. While a SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, or SessionEnd hook runs, the status spinner clearly shows its execution status alongside elapsed time. While waiting for a SessionStart hook to complete, pressing Esc cancels the prompt at any time. Fixed crashes in the interactive `/hooks` menu when a hook matcher is named after inherited properties like `__proto__` or `constructor`. ⟦This is like displaying an elapsed-second progress bar while a webpage loads, allowing you to cancel with a keystroke without freezing the system menu over special naming.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the interactive `/hooks` menu crashing when a hook matcher is named after an inherited object property such as `__proto__` or `constructor`
Improved hook feedback: while a SessionStart, UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse or SessionEnd hook runs, the spinner says so with elapsed time, and Esc cancels a prompt waiting on a SessionStart hook

title.zh-TW: 轉輪提示長思考狀態，引導下載桌面與行動版
title.en: Spinner Displays Long Thinking Status and Guides Desktop and Mobile Downloads

body.zh-TW: 等待 AI 運算複雜任務時，狀態列提供更清晰的思考進度與多裝置應用指引。思考時間超過 45 秒時，狀態轉輪會顯示陷入沉思。自輸出 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）限制恢復時，則顯示接續思考。輸入 `/desktop` 指令可取得桌面版應用程式下載連結，並針對雲端平台使用者提供專屬引導提示。輸入 `/mobile` 指令時顯示單一 QR Code 網址，自動導向手機對應的應用程式商店。修正轉輪提示推薦目前帳號類型無法使用或工作階段中已停用指令的問題。⟦這好似導航軟體在規劃長途路線時清楚顯示正在深度計算路線，並在畫面上提供掃碼下載手機版應用的捷徑。⟧
body.en: Waiting for AI computations during complex tasks now offers clearer progress indicators and multi-device app guidance. When thinking exceeds 45 seconds, the spinner displays "deep in thought". While recovering from output-token limits, it displays "picking the thought back up". Typing `/desktop` provides download links for the desktop app alongside dedicated tips for cloud platform users. Typing `/mobile` displays a single QR code URL that automatically routes to the appropriate app store for your phone. Fixed spinner tips recommending commands unavailable for the current account type or disabled in the session. ⟦This is like navigation software clearly showing in-depth route calculations for long journeys, with on-screen shortcuts to scan QR codes and download the mobile app.⟧

items.original:
Added a spinner tip pointing Bedrock, Vertex AI, Foundry and LLM gateway users to the Claude desktop app; the claude.ai desktop app tip now suggests `/desktop`, which offers to download the app
Fixed spinner tips suggesting commands that aren't available for your account type or are disabled in your session
Improved the spinner status during long thinking: it now reads "deep in thought" after 45s, and shows "picking the thought back up" while recovering from the output-token limit
Improved `/mobile` to show a single QR code for claude.ai/mobile, which opens the right app store for your phone

title.zh-TW: 跨作業系統檔案監聽更穩固，Git 鎖定檔殘留修復
title.en: Cross-Platform File Watching Stabilized, Stale Git Lock Files Fixed

body.zh-TW: 在 macOS、Linux 與 Windows 等多種環境下開發時，底層系統檔案與終端機操作更流暢。Linux 上沙盒指令啟動失敗後，不再殘留 `.git/config.lock` 鎖定檔而導致工作階段（session）後續 Git 指令失效。macOS 系統檔案事件飽和時，設定檔監聽器會自動改用輪詢機制。系統會以此作為備援（fallback），即時偵測外部變更。修正 Windows 加密虛擬磁碟回報 inode 0 時自訂代理與斜線指令無法載入的問題。登出後未於清理天數內重新整理的同步技能，下次啟動時會移至可復原的垃圾桶。修復特殊終端機的鍵位以及退出時終端機查詢字串滲漏至命令列的異常。⟦這就像多功能萬用轉接頭，在不同作業系統間靈活調度檔案監聽機制，即使在特殊終端機裡按刪除鍵也能精準響應。⟧
body.en: Operating across macOS, Linux, and Windows now delivers smoother low-level file and terminal handling. On Linux, when a sandboxed command fails to start, stale `.git/config.lock` files are no longer left behind to break subsequent Git commands in the session. When system file-event services are saturated on macOS, the config watcher automatically falls back to polling to detect external changes. Fixed custom agents and slash commands failing to load from virtual drives reporting inode 0 on Windows. Synced skills not refreshed within `cleanupPeriodDays` after signing out move to the recoverable trash upon the next launch. Fixed keybindings in specialized terminals and terminal query strings leaking to the shell prompt upon exit. ⟦This is like a universal adapter that flexibly shifts file-watching mechanisms across operating systems, responding accurately even when pressing Delete in niche terminal emulators.⟧

items.original:
Fixed a stale `.git/config.lock` breaking `git checkout -b`, `git push -u` and `git config` for the rest of a session after a sandboxed command failed to start (Linux)
Fixed settings file changes made outside the session going unnoticed on macOS machines whose system file-event service is saturated; the watcher now falls back to polling
Fixed custom agents, slash commands and output styles beyond the first not loading from a virtual drive that reports inode 0, such as an encrypted vault mounted as a Windows drive
Fixed skills synced from claude.ai staying on disk indefinitely after signing out; copies not refreshed within `cleanupPeriodDays` now move to the recoverable trash at the next launch
Fixed Delete in st and Alt+arrow keys in rxvt-unicode not working in attached background sessions
Fixed the terminal's replies to capability queries (`^[[?1;2c`) appearing at the shell prompt or in an editor when Claude Code exits, is suspended, or opens an editor right after starting

title.zh-TW: Claude in Chrome 提示休眠狀態，遠端連線減少殘留
title.en: Claude in Chrome Notes Sleep State, Remote Control Leaves Fewer Empty Sessions

body.zh-TW: 透過瀏覽器擴充套件或遠端操控（Remote Control）與 Claude 互動時，連線錯誤訊息更加貼近實際狀況。雲端工作階段無法連線至本機瀏覽器時，提示訊息會先說明電腦可能處於休眠狀態，再建議安裝擴充功能。工具搜尋不可用時，不再指示模型透過 ToolSearch 載入工具。在不穩定網路環境下建立遠端操控失敗時，減少在 claude.ai 上殘留的空白工作階段（session）。⟦這好比電視遙控器在訊號不良時先提示「電視可能處於待機狀態」，而不是盲目催促使用者重新購買遙控器。⟧
body.en: When interacting with Claude via browser extensions or Remote Control, connection error messages reflect real conditions more accurately. When a cloud session cannot reach the local browser, the message notes that the computer may be asleep before suggesting an extension install. When ToolSearch is unavailable, it no longer instructs the model to load tools via ToolSearch. When Remote Control setup fails on unstable networks, fewer empty sessions are left behind on claude.ai. ⟦This is like a TV remote displaying "TV may be in standby" during weak signals, rather than immediately urging the user to buy a new remote.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the Claude in Chrome prompt telling the model to load tools through ToolSearch when ToolSearch is unavailable
Improved Remote Control to leave fewer empty sessions on claude.ai when setup fails on a flaky network
Improved the Claude in Chrome message in cloud sessions when the browser can't be reached: it now says the computer may be asleep before it suggests an install

title.zh-TW: 終端機長文渲染不再卡頓，監聽任務設有逾時上限
title.en: Terminal Renders Large Diffs Smoothly, Monitor Watches Enforce Deadlines

body.zh-TW: 面對龐大程式碼變更與長時間監控任務時，命令列工具的反應速度與資源管理更有保障。終端機渲染效能改善，大量差異比對與長對話紀錄顯示更加流暢。介面減少掉格卡頓（jank，短暫畫面停頓現象）。啟動時略過內建模型資料的重複驗證，略微縮短啟動時間。Monitor 監聽機制改為強制設定時間上限（一般工作階段最多 30 分鐘，單次提示詞模式為 10 分鐘），到期前提醒 Claude 重新武裝，取代過去無逾時的常駐選項。Windows 環境下暫存輸出路徑達到 260 字元上限時，修復 PowerShell 指令報錯 Exit code 1 且無輸出的問題。⟦這如同將老舊投影機更換為高更新率鏡頭，翻閱龐大差異比對時不再掉格卡頓，監控設備也加上安全定時器定期回報。⟧
body.en: When dealing with massive code diffs and long-running monitoring tasks, command-line responsiveness and resource management are much more reliable. Terminal rendering performance is improved so large diffs and long transcripts render faster with fewer frame drops. Startup time is slightly reduced by skipping redundant validation of built-in model data. Monitor watches now enforce a mandatory deadline (at most 30 minutes in regular sessions, 10 minutes in single-prompt `-p` runs) and notify Claude to re-arm, replacing the previous no-timeout persistent option. Fixed an issue on Windows where PowerShell commands failed with "Exit code 1" and no output when the session temp output path reached the 260-character limit. ⟦This is like replacing an old projector with a high-refresh display so paging through massive diffs no longer stutters, while monitoring equipment is fitted with safety timers that report regularly.⟧

items.original:
Improved terminal rendering performance: large diffs and long transcripts render faster, with fewer slow frames
Improved startup time slightly by skipping a redundant validation of built-in model data on every launch
Changed Monitor watches to always have a deadline (at most 30 minutes; 10 in single-prompt `-p` runs) and notify Claude to re-arm, replacing the no-timeout `persistent` option
Windows: Fixed PowerShell commands failing with "Exit code 1" and no output when the session's temp output path reaches 260 characters

title.zh-TW: LLM 閘道相容純文字回應，切換目錄精確重計技能
title.en: LLM Gateways Support Plaintext Replies, Skill Counts Stay Accurate After Directory Changes

body.zh-TW: 串接大型語言模型閘道器或切換工作目錄時，資料格式解析與環境清理更為精準。當大型語言模型（LLM）閘道器將非串流回覆以 `text/plain` 純文字格式返回時，對話回合不再報錯為空回應或格式損毀。執行 `/cd` 切換目錄後，`/reload-skills` 回報的技能數量與斜線選單完全一致。引用 PDF 檔案時若無法計算頁數，會明確標註「頁數未知」，不再根據檔案大小猜測。Claude 應用程式閘道器與第三方雲端平台（Bedrock、Vertex AI、Foundry）的工作階段，不再刷新多餘且未使用的 claude.ai 登入狀態。⟦這好似快遞分揀機即使收到純文字包裹也能順利送達，更換工作目錄後技能數量依然精準清點，不再殘留多餘的登入狀態。⟧
body.en: Connecting through LLM gateways or switching directories now features more accurate formatting and environment cleanup. When an LLM gateway returns non-streaming replies as `text/plain`, turns no longer fail with empty or malformed response errors. After changing directories via `/cd`, `/reload-skills` reports a skill count that perfectly matches the slash menu. When referencing PDF files where page count cannot be determined, it explicitly notes "page count unknown" rather than guessing based on file size. Sessions on the Claude apps gateway and third-party cloud platforms (Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry) no longer refresh unused leftover claude.ai logins. ⟦This is like a package sorter reliably delivering plain-text parcels, while changing workspaces keeps tool counts accurate without leaving redundant login sessions behind.⟧

items.original:
Fixed turns failing with "API returned an empty or malformed response" when an LLM gateway returns the non-streaming reply as `text/plain`
Fixed `/reload-skills` reporting a skill count that disagreed with the slash menu after `/cd`
Improved PDF @-mentions to say "page count unknown" instead of a page count guessed from the file size when pdfinfo cannot count the pages
Changed Claude apps gateway, Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry sessions so that they no longer refresh a leftover claude.ai login that the session does not use

entries: Fixed read-only git commands in Bash unexpectedly asking for permission after a session had been running for a while (regression in 2.1.269)

title.zh-TW: 工作階段運行已久時，唯讀 Git 指令不再誤跳授權詢問
title.en: Read-only Git commands no longer mistakenly prompt for permission during long-running sessions

body.zh-TW: 當你長時間開啟工作階段（從開啟工具到結束對話的完整操作過程）處理專案時，如果只想查閱檔案紀錄，最怕流程莫名被打斷。⟦這好比在賣場貨架前翻看商品背面的成分說明，你既沒有拆封也沒有推走貨品，店員卻在你逛了一陣子後，每拿一瓶就突然上前要求你出示證件簽名。⟧在先前的 2.1.269 版本中，工具就出現了這項令人困擾的退步問題。當時只要你在 Bash（在黑底白字視窗裡輸入文字指令的運作環境）中持續操作了一段時間，原本完全不更動任何檔案的 Git 唯讀指令，就會出乎意料地彈出確認提示，反覆向你要求授權。特別是像 Git 這種用來追蹤檔案修改歷程的工具，其查詢狀態或檢視歷史的指令純粹只是讀取資料，本就不該頻繁索取權限。這項問題現在已經修好，往後即使工作階段持續運行，各類唯讀指令也能順暢完成，不再出現多餘的授權詢問來打斷你的思路。
body.en: When you keep a session open for a long time to work on a project and simply want to inspect file history, having your workflow randomly interrupted is frustrating. ⟦It is like browsing store shelves to check the ingredient labels on the back of products—without opening any packaging or taking items away, yet after you have shopped for a while, a clerk suddenly walks up and demands your ID and signature every single time you pick up a bottle.⟧ In the previous 2.1.269 release, the tool suffered from this frustrating regression. Back then, after operating for a while in Bash, read-only Git commands that modify no files at all would unexpectedly trigger confirmation prompts and repeatedly demand permission. Especially for a tool like Git used to track file modification history, commands that inspect status or view history purely read data and should never demand permissions so frequently. This issue has now been resolved; going forward, even when a session runs continuously, various read-only commands complete smoothly without unnecessary permission prompts interrupting your flow.

items.original: Fixed read-only git commands in Bash unexpectedly asking for permission after a session had been running for a while (regression in 2.1.269)

Added a diff of the files a Bash command changed to the Bash tool result when the Bash tool handles file edits (setting `bashEditDiffEnabled`)
Added `OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_REPOSITORY` to tag OpenTelemetry metrics and events with `vcs.*` repository attributes; commit events get `vcs.ref.head.*` with `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS`
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS` to extend the LLM gateway `/v1/models` discovery timeout (default 3s)
Added a spinner tip suggesting `/focus` for a view with just your prompt, a one-line work summary, and the response
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENTS` (1–256) to raise the Workflow tool's per-run concurrent agent limit for inference-bound fan-outs
Fixed the prompt cache being partially invalidated on the turn after a response was cut off at the output-token limit and automatically resumed
Fixed a case where resuming a session after interrupting Claude mid-thought could change how earlier context was re-sent, hurting prompt-cache reuse

Fixed the terminal's replies to capability queries (`^[[?1;2c`) appearing as stray text at startup in some terminals
Fixed rows at the top or bottom of the transcript going blank in fullscreen after resizing the terminal
Fixed a deny or ask permission rule starting with `!` applying beyond the settings source that wrote it; such a rule now applies only within its own source, and a bare `!` negation is ignored
Fixed the git status Claude is told after a compaction: it is now the current status, not the one from the start of the session
Fixed synced plugin MCP servers not connecting when a remote session resumes
Fixed resumed headless sessions losing a turn's replies when the model was switched or a request was retried mid-turn
Fixed terminal escape codes, line breaks and oversized text from a background task's on-disk record reaching the task list and task notifications when work is resumed

Fixed the managed settings approval dialog not naming the collector for a gRPC telemetry endpoint set without a scheme

Fixed missing cursor in the permission-rule, auto-mode-rule, add-directory, session-rename and feedback-review text fields when the terminal's native cursor is enabled
Fixed repeated clicks on a `/fork` receipt, each under a second apart, never backgrounding the session right away while it waited for the current tool to finish
Fixed plugin LSP servers that reject `shutdown` params (e.g. rust-analyzer) being left running at session end; `exit` is now sent even if `shutdown` fails
Fixed the attribution reminder overriding a CLAUDE.md or memory rule against commit and pull request attribution; lines set by managed settings still apply
Fixed prompt suggestions being dropped for text in Japanese, Chinese, Thai and other languages written without spaces between words
Fixed synchronized output being assumed from the terminal's name in GNOME Terminal and Konsole versions that do not support it
Fixed `permission_denials` in `--output-format stream-json` results omitting Read, Edit and Write calls blocked by a path-scoped deny rule
Fixed sessions run through the SDK or the desktop app showing an unknown status in other sessions' agent list
Fixed `/insights` failing on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and gateway deployments whose account can't reach the default Opus model by using the session model there instead
Fixed organization policy limits not loading for the session when another Claude Code process refreshed the login at the same moment
Fixed Claude Desktop sessions using Bedrock, Vertex, or a gateway not getting the contextual "what Claude needs" turn-end notification text
Fixed MCP servers reconnecting when an updated config only changed the order of the server URL's query parameters
Fixed the prompt box's top border splitting into extra lines when viewing a background agent whose name or description has line breaks or is wider than the terminal
Fixed sessions getting permanently stuck on "Prompt is too long" when auto-compaction had no complete earlier exchange to summarize (mostly Agent SDK sessions with very large prompts)
Fixed `/goal` runs silently stalling after API errors, network drops, or token limits: the goal now retries with backoff, or pauses and says why, including until a usage limit resets
Fixed prompt cache misses in cloud sessions by waiting briefly for server configuration before the first request
Fixed `/btw` answers that contained made-up tool calls and output: the side question is now told not to write them, and any that appear are flagged as not executed
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-running a turn that had failed with an API error over 6 hours earlier, or longer ago than `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS` when set
Fixed organization plugins enabled through managed settings not loading in headless sessions and on Claude Desktop (once Desktop bundles this CLI version); they load from the next session
Fixed plugin archives extracted for a session being readable by other local users, extracted files keeping world-writable bits from the archive, and stale files surviving re-extraction
Fixed `Edit()` deny rules and the write-path check not applying to the file a Bash `tee` command writes; a `Bash(tee:*)` allow rule no longer covers destinations outside the working directories
Fixed stray characters like `22c`, or a terminal's color or version reply, being typed into the prompt at startup over slow connections (ssh, browser terminals)

Fixed the cursor block staying visible after returning from an external editor in fullscreen mode on rxvt-unicode

Fixed the interface being drawn twice in Konsole after returning from an external editor

Improved responsiveness in long sessions: transcript updates no longer re-process the whole conversation to build the collapsed tool-use summaries
Improved first-party sessions with telemetry disabled: an `alwaysLoad` MCP server that finishes connecting mid-conversation is usable on the next turn without a tool-search round trip
Changed `/ultrareview --post` to post the PR comment directly when the findings arrive and print the comment link, instead of starting a second cloud session to post it
Changed artifact database reads that save into the session scratchpad so they no longer stop for working-folder approval

[VSCode] Added live progress rows for running subagents under the tool-call groups in Focus view

[VSCode] Added a Cancel button to the Switch account screen that returns to your session as the current account
[VSCode] Fixed Focus view showing a turn started by a delivered plain-text prompt, such as a scheduled task's, as part of the previous turn
[VSCode] Fixed the footer's prompt cache clock hiding its minutes when the panel is narrow
[VSCode] Fixed the session list keeping sessions from the default folder when `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is set in a settings file or the `environmentVariables` setting
[VSCode] Fixed a plan preview that finished loading late sometimes hiding its comment box or showing an older plan
[VSCode] Fixed a plan preview accepting comments that went nowhere after its Claude tab closed
[VSCode] Fixed the prompt cache clock and reopen notice for a session compacted after its last reply and then closed, which now reads as cold when reopened
[VSCode] Fixed a session renamed in the extension while Remote Control is on keeping its old name on claude.ai/code
[VSCode] Fixed the "Enable Remote Control for all sessions" toggle keeping its last position after the setting was reset to default from a terminal
[VSCode] Fixed restored Claude tabs not counting as open in the session list after a window reload until clicked, and their row opening a second tab
[VSCode] Fixed Switch account making a tab forget its dismissed usage-limit warnings when you sign back in as the same account
[VSCode] Fixed a session rename being replaced by the generated name after a window reload when the session was renamed during a long turn
[VSCode] Fixed the sidebar usage meter keeping a stale per-model weekly limit row after the account loses that limit
[VSCode] Fixed a rare case where an @-mention sent with the keyboard shortcut while a new chat view was still starting could be inserted into the input long after the keystroke
[VSCode] Fixed the session list jumping down when the Account & usage header appeared a moment after opening the Claude side bar
[VSCode] Improved documents and messages written for someone other than the user: Claude now writes them for that audience and names it at the top of its reply
[VSCode] Improved screen reader and keyboard accessibility in the slash-command menu, @-mention menu, output-style picker, Send/Stop button, permission and question cards, and onboarding checklist
[VSCode] Changed the current-file chip in the message box: an X now removes it, replacing the Hide toggle
[VSCode] Removed the Claude Code items from a session tab's right-click menu and the editor title bar's "..." menu; they could not act on the tab the menu was opened on
[Claude Code on the web] Added taking back a queued message in a cloud session before Claude reads it: remove it from the queue, or press Esc or Up, and the text returns to the message box
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed `/model default` in a cloud session leaving every later message failing in organizations that restrict which models Claude Code can use
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed one-off scheduled routines occasionally running a second time after a transient server error
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed routine runs that use subagents sometimes being treated as finished too early, which could skip the retry after a real failure or start a duplicate run
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed file links in cloud session transcripts opening a GitHub 404 when Claude was working from a subfolder of the repository
[Claude Code on the web] Changed the Cloud environments admin page to list every environment instead of capping each table at five rows behind a Show more control that could be unreachable
[Claude Code on the web] Changed claude.ai/code for Free-plan users to open the plans page with a path to upgrade, instead of a "Disabled by org admin" page with no way forward

[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude accepting a switch to a model your organization hasn't enabled and then quietly answering with a fallback model; it now declines and says an admin can enable it

title.zh-TW: 外掛套件評測評分上線，修正路徑顯示與解壓縮權限
title.en: Plugin evaluation scoring launched, fixing path display and extraction permissions

body.zh-TW:
外掛開發者現在能直接評估擴充套件的表現，透過全新指令可對 Claude Code 執行評測套件，產出可重現評分報告（包含 JSON 與 HTML 報告）：
```
claude plugin eval --help              # 查看評測指令使用說明
```
多項外掛安全與路徑問題也已修復。工作階段（session）的外掛封存檔，修復了先前其他本機使用者也能讀取、解壓縮檔案保留全域可寫入權限，以及舊檔案在重新解壓縮後仍殘留的狀況。組織透過受管設定啟用的外掛，修復了在無頭模式（沒有視覺介面的執行模式）未正常載入的問題。Claude Desktop 需等桌面端打包這版 CLI 後，才會在下個工作階段載入。此外，`headersHelper` 同意提示不再顯示容易誤讀為主機名稱的網址路徑，Windows 上包含 `@` 資料夾的相對路徑也不再被誤判為遮蔽網址。⟦整套流程好似汽車檢驗廠的定期安檢，用專用機台逐項量測煞車與廢氣數據並發給標籤，避免未經審驗的零件在組裝時留下漏洞。⟧
body.en:
Plugin developers can now directly evaluate extension performance, using a new command to run an eval suite against Claude Code and generate scored, reproducible results (including JSON and HTML reports):
```
claude plugin eval --help              # View plugin evaluation command help
```
Several plugin security and path issues have also been fixed. For plugin archives in a session, fixes resolve issues where other local users could read extracted files, extracted files retained world-writable permissions from archives, and stale files survived re-extraction. For plugins enabled by organizations through managed settings, an issue where they failed to load in headless mode has been resolved; Claude Desktop will load them from the next session once Desktop bundles this CLI version. Additionally, `headersHelper` consent prompts no longer display URL paths that could be misread as hostnames, and relative paths on Windows containing folders starting with `@` are no longer misidentified as redacted URLs. ⟦The entire workflow is like periodic inspections at a vehicle testing facility, using dedicated machines to measure brake and emission data item by item and issuing inspection decals to prevent unverified parts from leaving vulnerabilities during assembly.⟧

items.original:
Added `claude plugin eval`: run a plugin's eval suite against Claude Code and get scored, reproducible results (JSON + HTML report); see `claude plugin eval --help`
Fixed plugin `headersHelper` consent prompts showing a URL path that could be misread as a different host
Fixed plugin errors showing `[redacted URL]` in place of a relative Windows path with a folder name that starts with `@`
Fixed organization plugins enabled through managed settings not loading in headless sessions and on Claude Desktop (once Desktop bundles this CLI version); they load from the next session
Fixed plugin archives extracted for a session being readable by other local users, extracted files keeping world-writable bits from the archive, and stale files surviving re-extraction

title.zh-TW: 技能命名空間對齊桌面端，改善語言伺服器結束流程
title.en: Skill namespaces align with Claude Desktop, improving Language Server exit workflows

body.zh-TW: 當你在雲端工作階段（session）使用從 claude.ai 同步的技能時，套件名稱已改為 `anthropic-skills:<name>` 格式以對齊桌面端行為；若沒有其他同名項目衝突，輸入簡稱依然可以正常呼叫。若 Skill 工具呼叫到未註冊的簡稱，只要剛好唯一符合某個外掛技能，錯誤訊息現在會主動提示完整名稱。背景執行的外掛 LSP 語言伺服器（例如 rust-analyzer），過去在工作階段結束時若拒絕 `shutdown` 參數會持續殘留，現在即便關閉請求失敗也會補送 `exit` 指令確實終止行程。此外，將工件資料庫讀取並儲存到工作階段暫記板的操作，不再停下來詢問工作目錄的核准權限。⟦這好似交響樂團排練後的樂器歸位清點，外聘樂手帶來的特製樂器都清楚標上聲部序號，練習解散時即使琴盒卡扣卡住，場地管理員也會確實檢查並清空舞台。⟧
body.en: When using skills synced from claude.ai in cloud sessions, package names are now formatted as `anthropic-skills:<name>` to match Claude Desktop behavior; bare names can still be used when there are no conflicting items. If the Skill tool is called with an unregistered bare name that uniquely matches a plugin skill, the error message now actively suggests the full name. For plugin LSP language servers running in the background (such as rust-analyzer) that previously remained running at session end if they rejected `shutdown` parameters, an `exit` command is now sent even if the shutdown request fails to ensure processes are terminated. Additionally, reading the artifact database and saving it into the session scratchpad no longer stops to ask for working-directory approval. ⟦This is like packing away instruments after a symphony rehearsal, where custom instruments brought by guest musicians are clearly tagged with section numbers, and even if an instrument case latch gets stuck when dispersing, the stage manager thoroughly checks and clears the stage.⟧

items.original:
Fixed plugin LSP servers that reject `shutdown` params (e.g. rust-analyzer) being left running at session end; `exit` is now sent even if `shutdown` fails
Improved the Skill tool's "Unknown skill" error to name the plugin skill's full name when a bare name matches exactly one plugin skill
Changed artifact database reads that save into the session scratchpad so they no longer stop for working-folder approval
Changed skills synced from claude.ai in cloud sessions to be named `anthropic-skills:<name>`, matching Claude Desktop; the bare name still works when nothing else uses it

title.zh-TW: 終端機切換輸出風格，旋轉提示推薦專注檢視
title.en: Terminal output style switching added, spinner tips recommend focus view

body.zh-TW:
⟦這就像在專業攝影棚隨手切換濾鏡與取景視角，攝影師能隨時套用黑白或柔光調色，想聚焦主角表情時也能立刻調暗四周陳設。⟧終端機現在新增了樣式切換指令：
```
/output-style                         # 列出所有可用的輸出風格
/output-style [name]                  # 切換至指定的輸出風格
```
這項功能也支援遠端控制、雲端環境與各類無頭模式（沒有終端機畫面的執行模式）工作階段。等待回覆的旋轉動畫現在會隨機推薦 `/focus` 指令，讓你切換到僅保留提示詞、一行工作摘要與最終成果的精簡畫面。檢視檔案變更的 `/diff` 面板現在改為一次完整渲染呈現，不再先顯示載入狀態。此外，過去夾帶印刷用 CMYK 色彩格式的 JPEG 圖片時跳出解碼失敗的問題已經修復，現在會像一般圖片一樣正常縮放並附加到對話中。
body.en:
⟦This is like switching filters and camera angles on the fly in a professional photography studio, where the photographer can instantly apply black-and-white or soft-focus color grading, or dim surrounding fixtures right away when focusing on the subject's expression.⟧ The terminal now adds style-switching commands:
```
/output-style                         # List all available output styles
/output-style [name]                  # Switch to the specified output style
```
This feature also supports Remote Control, cloud environments, and various headless sessions. The spinner animation while waiting for responses now suggests `/focus` to switch to a streamlined view retaining only your prompt, a one-line work summary, and the response. The `/diff` panel for reviewing file changes now opens fully rendered in one step instead of showing a loading state first. Additionally, an issue where attaching CMYK JPEG images caused decoding failures has been fixed; they are now converted, resized, and attached like regular JPEGs.

items.original:
Added `/output-style [name]` to list and switch output styles, including over Remote Control and in cloud and other headless sessions
Added a spinner tip suggesting `/focus` for a view with just your prompt, a one-line work summary, and the response
Fixed CMYK JPEG images failing to attach with "cannot decode"; they are now converted and resized like other JPEGs
Improved the `/diff` panel to open fully rendered in one step instead of showing a loading state first

title.zh-TW: Bash 編輯檔案顯示變更差異，補強管線寫入安全限制
title.en: Bash file edits show diffs, strengthening pipeline write security restrictions

body.zh-TW: 當終端機透過 Bash 執行指令修改檔案時，現在工具的輸出結果會直接附帶檔案變更差異對照。此功能由受管設定 `bashEditDiffEnabled` 提供支援。安全檢查也針對管線寫入做了補強。過去透過 Bash 的 `tee` 指令寫入檔案時，`Edit()` 拒絕規則與寫入路徑檢查可能遭到略過，現在防護已經修好，且 `Bash(tee:*)` 允許規則不再涵蓋工作目錄以外的目的地。此外，在對話壓縮後系統通知 Claude 的 Git 狀態，現在會即時更新為當下的最新狀態，不再沿用工作階段（session）剛開始時的舊記錄。⟦施工驗收有如裝潢工地的明細對帳單，施工清單明確列出敲除了哪面隔板與換修了哪段水管，若有人想私自拉暗管穿越隔壁未簽約的住家，巡查員當場就能攔截阻擋。⟧
body.en: When commands executed through Bash modify files in the terminal, tool results now directly include a diff of the changed files. This feature is supported by the managed setting `bashEditDiffEnabled`. Security checks have also been reinforced for pipeline writes. Previously, when writing files via Bash's `tee` command, `Edit()` deny rules and write-path checks could be bypassed; this protection is now fixed, and `Bash(tee:*)` allow rules no longer cover destinations outside the working directories. Additionally, the Git status told to Claude after compaction is now refreshed to the current status instead of using outdated records from the start of the session. ⟦Construction sign-off is like an itemized invoice at a renovation site, clearly listing which partition wall was removed and which pipe was replaced; if anyone tries to run hidden pipes through an unsigned neighbor's unit without authorization, the inspector can intercept and stop it on the spot.⟧

items.original:
Added a diff of the files a Bash command changed to the Bash tool result when the Bash tool handles file edits (setting `bashEditDiffEnabled`)
Fixed the git status Claude is told after a compaction: it is now the current status, not the one from the start of the session
Fixed `Edit()` deny rules and the write-path check not applying to the file a Bash `tee` command writes; a `Bash(tee:*)` allow rule no longer covers destinations outside the working directories

title.zh-TW: 權限驚嘆號限制來源範圍，遙測指標標記程式庫屬性
title.en: Permission exclamation marks restrict source scope, telemetry metrics tag repository attributes

body.zh-TW:
⟦這如同海關貨運的專屬查驗程序，特別條款只對簽署它的報關行生效，運送貨櫃也確實印上船號與代碼，不再混入匿名來源。⟧遙測與權限設定迎來多項調整：
```
# 標記 vcs.* 程式庫屬性；提交事件附帶 vcs.ref.head.*
export OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_REPOSITORY=1
export OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1
```
以驚嘆號 `!` 開頭的拒絕或詢問規則，現在僅於撰寫該設定的來源生效而不擴散，單獨的 `!` 符號會被忽略。路徑拒絕規則所阻擋的 Read、Edit 與 Write 呼叫，先前在 `--output-format stream-json` 的 `permission_denials` 中被漏列的問題已修復。此外，署名提示不再覆蓋 CLAUDE.md 或記憶中反對 commit 與 PR 署名的規則；但受管設定寫入的署名行仍會套用，未帶協定的 gRPC 端點在核准視窗中也會正確標記收集器名稱。
body.en:
⟦This is like dedicated customs clearance procedures in freight shipping, where special clauses apply only to the customs broker that signed them, and shipping containers are clearly stamped with vessel numbers and codes without mixing in anonymous sources.⟧ Telemetry and permission settings receive several adjustments:
```
# Tag vcs.* repository attributes; commit events include vcs.ref.head.*
export OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_REPOSITORY=1
export OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS=1
```
Deny or ask permission rules starting with an exclamation mark `!` now apply only within the settings source that wrote them without spreading, and a bare `!` negation is ignored. An issue where Read, Edit, and Write calls blocked by path-scoped deny rules were omitted from `permission_denials` in `--output-format stream-json` results has been fixed. Additionally, attribution reminders no longer override CLAUDE.md or memory rules against commit and PR attribution; lines set by managed settings still apply, and gRPC endpoints without a scheme correctly name the collector in the approval dialog.

items.original:
Added `OTEL_METRICS_INCLUDE_REPOSITORY` to tag OpenTelemetry metrics and events with `vcs.*` repository attributes; commit events get `vcs.ref.head.*` with `OTEL_LOG_TOOL_DETAILS`
Fixed a deny or ask permission rule starting with `!` applying beyond the settings source that wrote it; such a rule now applies only within its own source, and a bare `!` negation is ignored
Fixed the managed settings approval dialog not naming the collector for a gRPC telemetry endpoint set without a scheme
Fixed the attribution reminder overriding a CLAUDE.md or memory rule against commit and pull request attribution; lines set by managed settings still apply
Fixed `permission_denials` in `--output-format stream-json` results omitting Read, Edit and Write calls blocked by a path-scoped deny rule

title.zh-TW: 閘道模型探索自訂等候逾時，雲端推論改採工作階段模型
title.en: Gateway model discovery customizes timeout, cloud inference adopts session model

body.zh-TW:
使用企業模型閘道器或第三方雲端平台的使用者，連線彈性與多工穩定性迎來改善。若閘道器的 `/v1/models` 端點回應較慢，現在可透過環境變數自訂等候時間（預設為 3 秒）。
```
export CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS=10000
```
在 Bedrock、Vertex、Foundry 與閘道環境中，若帳號無法存取預設的 Opus 模型，執行 `/insights` 指令時改以當前工作階段（session）使用的模型分析，解決了過去直接回傳失敗的問題。當其他本機行程剛好在同一瞬間重新整理登入時，工作階段也能完整載入組織原則上限。此外，在桌面版搭配 Bedrock、Vertex 或閘道環境時，回合結束的通知訊息現在會附上情境文字說明 Claude 需要什麼。⟦這恰似醫院急診室的分流檢傷窗口，遇到特殊化驗時主動放寬等候通話時間，主治醫師若剛好換班就由現場值班醫師接手判讀報告，多組病患同時掛號也不會互相沖銷病歷記錄。⟧
body.en:
Connection flexibility and multitasking stability have improved for users on enterprise model gateways or third-party cloud platforms. If a gateway's `/v1/models` endpoint responds slowly, the wait timeout can now be customized via an environment variable (defaulting to 3 seconds).
```
export CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS=10000
```
Across Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and gateway environments where an account cannot access the default Opus model, running `/insights` now uses the current session model instead, resolving previous direct failures. When another local process happens to refresh login at the exact same moment, the session still fully loads organization policy limits. Additionally, for desktop sessions using Bedrock, Vertex, or a gateway, turn-end notifications now include contextual text explaining what Claude needs. ⟦This is like the triage window in a hospital emergency room, proactively extending call waiting times during special lab tests, having on-duty doctors take over report interpretation if the attending physician shifts changes, and ensuring simultaneous registrations never overwrite medical records.⟧

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS` to extend the LLM gateway `/v1/models` discovery timeout (default 3s)
Fixed `/insights` failing on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry, and gateway deployments whose account can't reach the default Opus model by using the session model there instead
Fixed organization policy limits not loading for the session when another Claude Code process refreshed the login at the same moment
Fixed Claude Desktop sessions using Bedrock, Vertex, or a gateway not getting the contextual "what Claude needs" turn-end notification text

title.zh-TW: 工作流程放寬背景代理併發上限，修復狀態回報與排版
title.en: Workflow raises background agent concurrency limits, fixing status reporting and formatting

body.zh-TW:
⟦這套排程猶如現代化貨櫃碼頭的重型裝卸吊臂，多組機具能同時並行搬運貨物，中控台不會在吊臂還在吊掛時誤報空檔，設備規格看板也不再因文字過長而把邊框撐破。⟧面對大量推論並行需求，現在可透過環境變數調高 Workflow 工具每次執行的背景代理人併發上限（可設定為 1 至 256）：
```
export CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENTS=32
```
多項背景任務與顯示問題也已改善。在遠端或無頭模式（沒有終端機畫面的執行模式）工作階段中，修復了背景代理仍在運作時卻誤報等待輸入的問題，若想恢復舊行為可設定 `CLAUDE_CODE_BG_TASKS_REPORT_RUNNING=0`。連續點擊 `/fork` 產生的收據不再卡住背景化流程，SDK 或桌面端啟動的工作階段在代理清單中不再顯示未知狀態。此外，恢復背景任務時，磁碟記錄裡的跳脫碼、換行與過長文字不再進到工作清單與任務通知，輸入框頂部邊界也不再被換行撐裂。
body.en:
⟦This scheduling is like heavy container gantry cranes at a modern shipping terminal, where multiple machines move cargo concurrently, the central control room never falsely reports idle slots while cranes are actively hoisting, and equipment specification boards no longer split their borders due to oversized text.⟧ For high-volume concurrent inference demands, an environment variable can now raise the Workflow tool's per-run concurrent background agent limit (configurable from 1 to 256):
```
export CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENTS=32
```
Several background task and display issues have also been resolved. In remote and headless sessions, an issue where background agents running still mistakenly reported waiting for input has been fixed (set `CLAUDE_CODE_BG_TASKS_REPORT_RUNNING=0` to restore the old behavior). Rapidly clicking `/fork` receipts no longer blocks immediate backgrounding, and sessions started via the SDK or desktop app no longer show unknown statuses in agent lists. Additionally, when resuming background tasks, escape codes, line breaks, and oversized text from on-disk records no longer reach task lists or notifications, and prompt box top borders no longer split into extra lines from line breaks.

items.original:
Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_MAX_CONCURRENT_AGENTS` (1–256) to raise the Workflow tool's per-run concurrent agent limit for inference-bound fan-outs
Fixed remote and headless sessions reporting "waiting for your input" while background agents were still running (set `CLAUDE_CODE_BG_TASKS_REPORT_RUNNING=0` to restore the old behavior)
Fixed terminal escape codes, line breaks and oversized text from a background task's on-disk record reaching the task list and task notifications when work is resumed
Fixed repeated clicks on a `/fork` receipt, each under a second apart, never backgrounding the session right away while it waited for the current tool to finish
Fixed sessions run through the SDK or the desktop app showing an unknown status in other sessions' agent list
Fixed the prompt box's top border splitting into extra lines when viewing a background agent whose name or description has line breaks or is wider than the terminal

title.zh-TW: 提示快取重用精準維持，修復長對話恢復與壓縮停滯
title.en: Prompt cache reuse accurately maintained, fixing long-session resumption and compaction stalls

body.zh-TW: ⟦這好似圍棋選手在比賽暫停後回到棋盤前復盤，能直接按照先前的棋譜接續落子，不會因為計時鐘響起就把整盤棋子撥亂重擺。⟧長時間對話的流暢度與暫存效能顯著提升。當回答因輸出上限中斷並自動恢復時，下一個回合的提示快取（把算過結果暫存起來直接用）不再部分失效。在 Claude 思考中途打斷後恢復工作階段（session），修復了重新傳送脈絡改變而損害快取重用的問題。雲端工作階段在首個請求前會短暫等待伺服器設定，避免了快取未命中。自動壓縮在缺乏完整對話歷史可總結時，不再卡死在提示過長狀態。更新對話紀錄不再重新處理整個對話來建立摺疊摘要。此外，`CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` 不再重跑超過 6 小時前因 API 錯誤失敗的回合，亦可自訂 `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS` 上限。
body.en: ⟦This is like Go players returning to the board after a match pause to resume play, placing stones directly according to earlier game records without knocking over the entire board when the clock chimes.⟧ Responsiveness and caching performance in long conversations have improved significantly. When a response is cut off at the output limit and automatically resumed, prompt caching on the next turn no longer partially invalidates. Resuming a session after interrupting Claude mid-thought fixes an issue where changed re-sent context hurt cache reuse. Cloud sessions briefly wait for server configuration before the first request, preventing cache misses. Auto-compaction no longer gets permanently stuck on prompt-too-long states when lacking complete earlier exchanges to summarize. Transcript updates no longer re-process the entire conversation to build collapsed tool-use summaries. Additionally, `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` no longer re-runs turns that failed with API errors over 6 hours ago, and `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS` can customize this limit.

items.original:
Fixed the prompt cache being partially invalidated on the turn after a response was cut off at the output-token limit and automatically resumed
Fixed a case where resuming a session after interrupting Claude mid-thought could change how earlier context was re-sent, hurting prompt-cache reuse
Fixed sessions getting permanently stuck on "Prompt is too long" when auto-compaction had no complete earlier exchange to summarize (mostly Agent SDK sessions with very large prompts)
Fixed prompt cache misses in cloud sessions by waiting briefly for server configuration before the first request
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN` re-running a turn that had failed with an API error over 6 hours earlier, or longer ago than `CLAUDE_CODE_RESUME_INTERRUPTED_TURN_MAX_AGE_MS` when set
Improved responsiveness in long sessions: transcript updates no longer re-process the whole conversation to build the collapsed tool-use summaries

title.zh-TW: 終端機鍵盤協定相容性修復，消除啟動多餘字元
title.en: Terminal keyboard protocol compatibility fixed, eliminating stray startup characters
