body.zh-TW: 鍵盤操作與不同終端機的相容性獲得全面校準。過去在 kitty 協定終端機中 F1、F2 與 F4 無效、st 中的 Delete 鍵失效、rxvt-unicode 中 Alt 加方向鍵被誤判為 Escape，以及 WezTerm 中 Shift 加標點打出未換檔按鍵的問題均已修復。部分終端機啟動時不再把 capability query 回覆顯示成雜字。慢速連線如 SSH 或瀏覽器終端機中，`22c`、顏色或版本回覆不再被打進輸入框。此外，透過 SSH 或在未知終端機中，只要軟體能回應 kitty 鍵盤查詢（如 foot 與 Alacritty 0.16 以上版本），現在都能正常使用 Shift+Enter 與 Ctrl+Shift 快速鍵。⟦整套調校猶如專業電競鍵盤的微動開關與信號防衝，訊號線不再把測試電壓誤判為按鍵敲擊，各類複合指令隨按隨發。⟧
body.en: Keyboard interactions and compatibility across terminals have been thoroughly calibrated. Issues where F1, F2, and F4 failed in kitty-protocol terminals, Delete failed in st, Alt+arrows acted as Escape in rxvt-unicode, and Shift+punctuation typed unshifted keys in WezTerm have all been resolved. Replies to capability queries no longer appear as stray text at startup in certain terminals. Over slow connections like SSH or browser terminals, `22c`, color, or version replies are no longer typed into the prompt. Additionally, over SSH or in unrecognized terminals that answer kitty keyboard queries (such as foot and Alacritty 0.16+), Shift+Enter and Ctrl+Shift shortcuts are now fully supported. ⟦The entire calibration is like mechanical microswitches and anti-ghosting circuits on professional gaming keyboards, where signal lines never mistake test voltages for keystrokes and complex key combinations fire instantly.⟧

items.original:
Fixed F1/F2/F4 not working in kitty-protocol terminals and Delete in st, Alt+arrows acting as Escape in rxvt-unicode, and Shift+punctuation typing the unshifted key in WezTerm (regression in 2.1.247)
Fixed the terminal's replies to capability queries (`^[[?1;2c`) appearing as stray text at startup in some terminals
Fixed stray characters like `22c`, or a terminal's color or version reply, being typed into the prompt at startup over slow connections (ssh, browser terminals)
Improved keyboard support over SSH and in unrecognized terminals: terminals that answer the kitty keyboard query (such as foot and Alacritty 0.16+) now get Shift+Enter and Ctrl+Shift shortcuts

title.zh-TW: 終端機全螢幕縮放畫面防留白，輸入游標正常呈現
title.en: Terminal fullscreen resizing prevents blank rows, input cursors render normally

body.zh-TW: ⟦這如同展覽會場的升降式投影布幕，無論布幕如何拉寬或收合，畫面的頂端與底部邊界都不會無故留白，指標與更新頻率也隨規格精準契合。⟧終端機介面的畫面排版與游標顯示修復了多項瑕疵。在全螢幕模式下調整終端機視窗大小後，對話紀錄最頂部或底部的列數先前會異常變成空白，現在已經修復。當啟用終端機的原生游標時，權限規則、自動模式規則、新增目錄、工作階段（session）重新命名與反饋檢閱的文字欄位，修復了游標消失看不見打字位置的問題。此外，GNOME Terminal 與 Konsole 若屬於不支援同步輸出的版本，Claude Code 不再單憑終端機名稱就預設啟用同步輸出，避免了畫面更新異常。
body.en: ⟦This is like motorized projection screens in an exhibition hall: no matter how wide the screen stretches or retracts, top and bottom borders never turn blank unexpectedly, and pointers and refresh rates match specifications precisely.⟧ Terminal interface layout and cursor rendering have received multiple fixes. After resizing terminal windows in fullscreen mode, an issue where rows at the top or bottom of transcripts went blank has been fixed. When the terminal's native cursor is enabled, text fields for permission rules, auto-mode rules, add-directory, session renames, and feedback reviews fix missing cursors that obscured typing positions. Additionally, for GNOME Terminal and Konsole versions that do not support synchronized output, Claude Code no longer assumes synchronized output based merely on terminal names, preventing display update anomalies.

items.original:
Fixed rows at the top or bottom of the transcript going blank in fullscreen after resizing the terminal
Fixed missing cursor in the permission-rule, auto-mode-rule, add-directory, session-rename and feedback-review text fields when the terminal's native cursor is enabled
Fixed synchronized output being assumed from the terminal's name in GNOME Terminal and Konsole versions that do not support it

title.zh-TW: 外部編輯器返回重繪修正，消除全螢幕殘留區塊游標
title.en: External editor return redraws fixed, eliminating lingering block cursors in fullscreen

body.zh-TW: 習慣呼叫外部編輯器編輯長文的使用者，切換視窗後的畫面渲染更加穩定。在非全螢幕模式下按 Ctrl+G 從外部編輯器返回後，畫面先前會被重複繪製兩次，這項重繪問題已經修正。在 Konsole 終端機中，從外部編輯器返回時介面被重複繪製兩次的問題也一併排除。針對 rxvt-unicode 終端機，離開或重新進入全螢幕時終端機方塊游標在介面下方穿透顯示的問題已修好，在全螢幕模式下從外部編輯器返回時方塊游標持續殘留的問題也已解決。⟦整體切換有如寫生畫家收合攜帶式素描板，從戶外大畫架抽回小草稿本時畫布不會被重複複印兩次，翻開全版畫紙時筆尖游標也不會卡在邊緣陰影中。⟧
body.en: Window switching and rendering are now more stable for users accustomed to launching external editors for long-form edits. Returning from an external editor outside fullscreen mode via Ctrl+G previously caused the interface to be drawn twice; this redraw issue has been corrected. An issue where returning from an external editor in Konsole drew the interface twice has also been resolved. For rxvt-unicode terminals, issues where terminal block cursors showed through beneath the interface after leaving or re-entering fullscreen, or stayed visible after returning from an external editor in fullscreen mode, are now resolved. ⟦The overall transition is like a plein air painter folding a portable sketchpad, where pulling back to a small sketchbook from an outdoor easel never stamps the canvas twice, and unfolding full-sheet paper leaves no stylus cursor stuck in edge shadows.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the terminal's block cursor showing under the interface in rxvt-unicode after leaving or re-entering fullscreen
Fixed the cursor block staying visible after returning from an external editor in fullscreen mode on rxvt-unicode
Fixed the interface being drawn twice after returning from an external editor (Ctrl+G) outside fullscreen mode
Fixed the interface being drawn twice in Konsole after returning from an external editor

title.zh-TW: 外部工具伺服器連線修復，無頭工作階段重試不丟回覆
title.en: External tool server connections fixed, headless session retries retain replies

body.zh-TW: ⟦這套連線架構有如跨洋海底電纜的中繼轉接站，線路重新通電時外部通訊站立刻接通，網址參數微調不再觸發盲目重啟，背景傳送指令也能獨立運轉至完成。⟧遠端與無頭模式（沒有終端機畫面的執行模式）工作階段的通訊穩定度迎來重要修復。恢復遠端工作階段（session）時，外掛連線已修好。同步外掛的 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器先前無法連線的問題已獲解決。在恢復的無頭工作階段中，若在回合中途切換模型或重試請求，不再遺失該回合的回覆。當更新的設定僅改變伺服器網址的查詢參數順序時，MCP 伺服器不再不必要地重新連線。關閉遙測的第一方工作階段中，對話中途連線完成的 `alwaysLoad` 伺服器在下一回合即可直接使用。在 Windows 上，送入背景執行的 PowerShell 工具指令在 Claude Code 結束時不再被迫中斷。
body.en: ⟦This connection architecture is like repeater stations along transoceanic submarine cables, where external stations connect immediately when power restores, URL parameter tweaks never trigger blind restarts, and background transmission commands operate independently to completion.⟧ Communication stability in remote and headless sessions receives important fixes. Resuming remote sessions now connects synced plugin MCP servers properly. In resumed headless sessions, switching models or retrying requests mid-turn no longer loses that turn's replies. When updated configurations only change query parameter ordering in server URLs, MCP servers no longer reconnect unnecessarily. In first-party sessions with telemetry disabled, `alwaysLoad` servers that finish connecting mid-conversation are immediately usable on the next turn. On Windows, PowerShell tool commands sent to the background no longer terminate when Claude Code exits.

items.original:
Fixed synced plugin MCP servers not connecting when a remote session resumes
Fixed resumed headless sessions losing a turn's replies when the model was switched or a request was retried mid-turn
Fixed MCP servers reconnecting when an updated config only changed the order of the server URL's query parameters
Windows: Fixed PowerShell tool commands sent to the background stopping when Claude Code exits
Improved first-party sessions with telemetry disabled: an `alwaysLoad` MCP server that finishes connecting mid-conversation is usable on the next turn without a tool-search round trip

title.zh-TW: 目標執行自動重試與退避，審查報告直接送出 PR 留言
title.en: Goal execution adds automatic retry and backoff, review reports post PR comments directly

body.zh-TW: 當你使用進階指令執行長效任務時，流程控制變得更加可靠。過去 `/goal` 遇到網路中斷、API 錯誤或達到 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）上限時會靜默卡住。現在它會自動進行退避重試，或暫停並清楚說明原因，包含等候用量重置。`/ultrareview --post` 現在審查結果出爐時會直接發布 PR 評論並印出連結，不必另開第二個雲端工作階段（session）。在輸入列中，日文、中文、泰文等詞間無空格的文字提示建議遺失問題已修復。中日韓文字的提示建議現在會保留單詞與混合語系建議，並比照英文剔除後設評估字眼。此外，`/btw` 旁支提問先前可能捏造工具呼叫與輸出，現在已明確要求不撰寫虛構呼叫，若有出現也會標記為未執行。⟦這就像馬拉松補給站的配速指引，跑者遇到體力耗盡或缺水時主動放慢步調並指引休息站，路旁志工據實回報路況而不胡亂編造路線。⟧
body.en: Process control is now more dependable when executing long-running tasks with advanced commands. Previously, `/goal` silently stalled after network drops, API errors, or reaching token limits. It now automatically retries with backoff, or pauses and clearly states why, including waiting until usage limits reset. `/ultrareview --post` now posts PR comments directly when findings arrive and prints comment links, without needing a second cloud session. In the input prompt, prompt suggestions dropped for text without spaces between words (such as Japanese, Chinese, and Thai) have been restored. Prompt suggestions for CJK text now retain single-word and mixed-script suggestions, dropping meta or evaluative text just like English. Additionally, `/btw` side questions previously could fabricate tool calls and output; Claude is now instructed not to write them, and any that appear are flagged as unexecuted. ⟦This is like pacing guidance at marathon aid stations, where runners facing exhaustion or dehydration slow their pace and are directed to rest stops, while roadside volunteers report actual course conditions without inventing detour routes.⟧

items.original:
Fixed prompt suggestions being dropped for text in Japanese, Chinese, Thai and other languages written without spaces between words
Fixed `/goal` runs silently stalling after API errors, network drops, or token limits: the goal now retries with backoff, or pauses and says why, including until a usage limit resets
Fixed `/btw` answers that contained made-up tool calls and output: the side question is now told not to write them, and any that appear are flagged as not executed
Improved prompt suggestion filtering for Japanese, Chinese and Korean text: mixed-script and single-word suggestions are kept, and meta or evaluative text is dropped as it is for English
Changed `/ultrareview --post` to post the PR comment directly when the findings arrive and print the comment link, instead of starting a second cloud session to post it

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 子代理地圖可視化管理，專注檢視即時顯示進度
title.en: [VSCode] Subagent map visualizes management, Focus view displays live progress

body.zh-TW: ⟦這好似工程工地的分工動態看板，以獨立卡片列出每位工頭的負責責任區與進展，監工能隨時翻閱施工紀錄或隨時停下特定工班。⟧VSCode 擴充套件為多代理人協同帶來視覺化新工具。點擊頁尾的代理人標籤即可開啟地圖，以專屬卡片檢視當前工作階段（session）的所有子代理人，並支援停止個別代理人與閱讀唯讀紀錄。在 Focus 專注檢視中，工具呼叫群組下方新增了執行中子代理人的即時進度列。排程任務等純文字提示觸發的新回合，先前在專注檢視被誤歸入上一回合的問題已經修復。計畫預覽方面，較晚載入完成時隱藏評論框或顯示舊計畫的狀況已獲排除，分頁關閉後也不再接受無處送出的留言。此外，當 Claude 撰寫給非使用者本人的文件時，會針對該受眾撰寫並於回覆頂部指名。
body.en: ⟦This is like dynamic work-assignment boards on a construction site, listing each foreman's area of responsibility and progress on individual cards, where supervisors can review work logs or stop specific crews at any time.⟧ The VSCode extension brings visual tools for multi-agent collaboration. Clicking the agent pill in the footer opens an agent map with dedicated cards for all subagents in the current session, supporting stopping individual agents and reading read-only transcripts. In Focus view, live progress rows for running subagents have been added beneath tool-call groups. An issue where new turns triggered by plain-text prompts (such as scheduled tasks) were mistakenly grouped into the previous turn in Focus view has been fixed. For plan previews, issues where late-loading previews hid comment boxes or displayed older plans have been eliminated, and closed tabs no longer accept orphaned comments. Additionally, when Claude writes documents or messages for someone other than the user, it addresses that audience and names it at the top of the reply.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added an agent map: an "N agents" footer pill opens a map of the session's sub-agents with per-agent cards, Stop agent, and read-only transcripts
[VSCode] Added live progress rows for running subagents under the tool-call groups in Focus view
[VSCode] Fixed Focus view showing a turn started by a delivered plain-text prompt, such as a scheduled task's, as part of the previous turn
[VSCode] Fixed a plan preview that finished loading late sometimes hiding its comment box or showing an older plan
[VSCode] Fixed a plan preview accepting comments that went nowhere after its Claude tab closed
[VSCode] Improved documents and messages written for someone other than the user: Claude now writes them for that audience and names it at the top of its reply

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 掛鉤與權限規則對話框上線，無障礙導覽全面強化
title.en: [VSCode] Hooks and permission rules dialogs launched, accessibility navigation fully enhanced

body.zh-TW: VSCode 指令選單新增了掛鉤（特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）與權限規則兩組全新對話框。使用者能在視覺面板中瀏覽使用者、專案與本機設定中的規則。掛鉤可新增、編輯或移除；權限規則可新增或移除。掛鉤的受管、外掛與工作階段（session）規則唯讀；權限規則的 startup-option、session-only 與受管規則唯讀。輸入框的目前檔案標籤改由叉叉圖示直接移除，取代先前的隱藏開關。右鍵選單與編輯器頂部無法對所選分頁生效的項目已全數清理移除。此外，斜線指令選單、標註選單、樣式選擇器、傳送停止按鈕、問題卡片與入門清單的螢幕閱讀器與鍵盤無障礙支援均全面升級，新聊天視窗啟動時按快捷鍵插入標註也不再延遲滯後。⟦整套操作宛如為機械控制台換上標準安全閥選單與防呆護蓋，維修人員能直覺開關閥門，輔助視障提示與按鍵導引也處處到位。⟧
body.en: The VSCode command menu adds two new dialogs: Hooks and Permission rules. Users can browse rules across user, project, and local settings in visual panels. Hooks can be added, edited, or removed; permission rules can be added or removed. Managed, plugin, and session hooks remain read-only; startup-option, session-only, and managed permission rules remain read-only. The current-file chip in the input box is now removed directly via an X icon, replacing the previous Hide toggle. Context menu and editor title bar items that could not act on the selected tab have been cleaned up and removed. Additionally, screen reader and keyboard accessibility have been upgraded across slash-command menus, @-mention menus, output-style pickers, Send/Stop buttons, permission and question cards, and onboarding checklists, while inserting @-mentions via shortcuts when starting new chat views no longer experiences lag. ⟦The entire operation is like outfitting machinery consoles with standardized safety valve menus and mistake-proofing covers, where maintenance staff can intuitively open or close valves while assistive prompts and key guides are thoroughly in place.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a Hooks dialog to the command menu for viewing hooks and adding, editing, or removing them in user, project, and local settings; managed, plugin, and session hooks stay read-only
[VSCode] Added a Permission rules dialog that lists permission rules and adds or removes them in user, project, and local settings; startup-option, session-only, and managed rules stay read-only
[VSCode] Fixed a rare case where an @-mention sent with the keyboard shortcut while a new chat view was still starting could be inserted into the input long after the keystroke
[VSCode] Improved screen reader and keyboard accessibility in the slash-command menu, @-mention menu, output-style picker, Send/Stop button, permission and question cards, and onboarding checklist
[VSCode] Changed the current-file chip in the message box: an X now removes it, replacing the Hide toggle
[VSCode] Removed the Claude Code items from a session tab's right-click menu and the editor title bar's "..." menu; they could not act on the tab the menu was opened on

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 工作階段清單狀態同步，修正遠端重新命名與視窗重載
title.en: [VSCode] Session list state syncs, fixing remote renames and window reloads

body.zh-TW: ⟦這套連動猶如商務飯店的前台房務看板，即使整棟大樓重新送電，已登記入住的房卡與重新登記的住客姓名都不會被系統洗掉，遠端房態也即時同步更新。⟧工作階段清單修復了多項設定與視窗重載後的狀態不同步。在設定檔配置 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 時，清單不再錯誤殘留預設目錄的工作階段（session）。開啟遠端控制時在擴充套件重新命名，新名稱現在會正確同步至網頁端，長回合中重新命名在視窗重載後也不會被自動產生的名稱覆蓋。在終端機將遠端控制重置為預設後，全域開關按鈕不再停留在舊狀態。視窗重載後還原的分頁不再被清單視為未開啟而重複打開第二個分頁。此外，側邊欄帳號標頭出現時工作階段清單瞬間下跳的跳動問題也已解決。
body.en: ⟦This coordination is like a front-desk housekeeping board at a business hotel: even if power resets across the entire building, checked-in keycards and newly registered guest names are never wiped by the system, and remote room statuses update simultaneously in real time.⟧ The session list resolves multiple state synchronization issues after configuration changes and window reloads. When `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is set in settings, the list no longer incorrectly retains sessions from the default folder. Renaming a session in the extension while Remote Control is active now properly syncs the new name to the web interface, and renames during long turns are no longer overwritten by generated names after window reloads. Resetting Remote Control to default from a terminal no longer leaves the global toggle stuck in its previous state. Restored tabs after window reloads are no longer treated as closed by the list to open duplicate tabs. Additionally, an issue where the session list jumped downward when the account header appeared in the sidebar has been resolved.

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the session list keeping sessions from the default folder when `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is set in a settings file or the `environmentVariables` setting
[VSCode] Fixed a session renamed in the extension while Remote Control is on keeping its old name on claude.ai/code
[VSCode] Fixed the "Enable Remote Control for all sessions" toggle keeping its last position after the setting was reset to default from a terminal
[VSCode] Fixed restored Claude tabs not counting as open in the session list after a window reload until clicked, and their row opening a second tab
[VSCode] Fixed a session rename being replaced by the generated name after a window reload when the session was renamed during a long turn
[VSCode] Fixed the session list jumping down when the Account & usage header appeared a moment after opening the Claude side bar

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 帳號切換畫面支援取消，精準校正快取時鐘與用量表
title.en: [VSCode] Switch account screen supports cancellation, accurately calibrating cache clocks and usage meters

body.zh-TW: 帳號管理與用量資訊的介面交互更加貼心。在切換帳號畫面新增了「取消」按鈕，點擊即可直接返回原帳號的進行中工作階段（session）。當你重新登入相同帳號時，分頁不會再忘記你先前已經關閉的用量上限警告。側邊欄用量計量表在帳號失去特定模型的每週配額限制後，不會再錯誤保留過期的每週限制列。頁尾的提示快取（把算過結果暫存起來直接用）時鐘在面板較窄時不再隱藏分鐘數字。此外，在最後一次回覆後壓縮並關閉的工作階段，重新打開時的重開通知與快取時鐘現在會正確標示為冷啟動。⟦體驗改善好似百貨專櫃的會員服務台，取消換卡能立刻取回原卡繼續結帳，冷卻計時器在小螢幕上完整顯示分鐘數，過期的限額告示也會及時撤下。⟧
body.en: Interface interactions for account management and usage tracking are now smoother. A Cancel button on the Switch account screen returns directly to your active session under the current account. Signing back in to the same account no longer causes tabs to forget previously dismissed usage-limit warnings. The sidebar usage meter no longer retains stale weekly limit rows after an account loses per-model weekly limits. The footer's prompt cache clock no longer hides minute digits when panels are narrow. Additionally, sessions compacted after their last reply and then closed now correctly display cold states in reopen notices and cache clocks upon reopening. ⟦These experience improvements are like a department store membership service counter, where canceling a card swap immediately retrieves the original card to continue checkout, cooldown timers show full minutes on narrow screens, and expired quota notices are promptly taken down.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Added a Cancel button to the Switch account screen that returns to your session as the current account
[VSCode] Fixed the footer's prompt cache clock hiding its minutes when the panel is narrow
[VSCode] Fixed the prompt cache clock and reopen notice for a session compacted after its last reply and then closed, which now reads as cold when reopened
[VSCode] Fixed Switch account making a tab forget its dismissed usage-limit warnings when you sign back in as the same account
[VSCode] Fixed the sidebar usage meter keeping a stale per-model weekly limit row after the account loses that limit

title.zh-TW: [Claude Code on the web] 雲端佇列支援抽回訊息，修復例行排程重複執行
title.en: [Claude Code on the web] Cloud queues allow retracting messages, fixing duplicate routine executions

body.zh-TW: 在網頁版雲端工作階段（session）中送出訊息後，只要 Claude 尚未讀取，你現在隨時能反悔抽回。你可以直接從排隊佇列中移除它，或是按下 Esc 或向上方向鍵 ↑，未送出的文字就會完整返回輸入框讓你重新編輯。自動化例行排程的執行邏輯也經過修復。單次排程的定時例行任務，修復了在伺服器遭遇短暫錯誤後偶爾重複執行第二次的問題。此外，使用子代理人的例行排程任務過去偶爾會被過早判定為已完成，進而導致真實失敗時跳過重試或意外啟動重複執行，這項狀態判定漏洞現在已經完全修好。⟦這就像郵筒投遞口的防卡安全擋片，信件剛投進去在郵差取件前隨時能抽回重寫，郵務專車也不會因為短暫訊號異常而對同一份包裹白跑兩趟。⟧
body.en: After sending messages in web cloud sessions, queued messages can now be taken back at any time before Claude reads them. You can remove them directly from the queue, or press Esc or Up arrow ↑ to return unsent text to the input box for editing. Execution logic for automated routines has also been fixed. One-off scheduled routines resolve issues where runs occasionally executed a second time after transient server errors. Additionally, routine runs using subagents that were previously treated as finished too early—which could skip retries after real failures or trigger duplicate runs—now have their status determination fully fixed. ⟦This is like anti-jam security flaps on mailbox drop slots, allowing mail to be pulled back and rewritten before postal carriers collect it, while delivery vans never make duplicate trips for the same package due to brief signal glitches.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Code on the web] Added taking back a queued message in a cloud session before Claude reads it: remove it from the queue, or press Esc or Up, and the text returns to the message box
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed one-off scheduled routines occasionally running a second time after a transient server error
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed routine runs that use subagents sometimes being treated as finished too early, which could skip the retry after a real failure or start a duplicate run

title.zh-TW: [Claude Code on the web] 雲端環境完整條列，修正未授權模型與子目錄連結
title.en: [Claude Code on the web] Cloud environments list fully, fixing unauthorized models and subfolder links

body.zh-TW: 網頁版管理介面與存取指引迎來友善改動。雲端環境管理頁面現在會直接列出所有環境，不再把表格限制在五列並隱藏於可能無法點擊的展開按鈕後面。針對免費方案使用者，前往 `claude.ai/code` 時改為開啟方案頁面並提供升級路徑，取代先前無路可走的「已被組織管理員停用」畫面。在限制可用模型的組織中，於雲端工作階段（session）執行 `/model default` 導致後續每則訊息皆發送失敗的問題已經排除。此外，當 Claude 在程式碼庫的子資料夾中作業時，對話紀錄中的檔案連結在 GitHub 上開出 404 找不到網頁的錯誤也已修復。⟦這如同租賃公寓的公共設施佈告欄，所有可用空間一目了然不再折疊遮蔽，面對訪客也清楚提供導引路線而非緊閉大門。⟧
body.en: The web management interface and access guidance receive welcoming improvements. The Cloud environments admin page now lists every environment directly, no longer capping tables at five rows behind potentially unreachable Show more controls. For Free-plan users, navigating to `claude.ai/code` now opens the plans page with upgrade paths instead of a dead-end "Disabled by org admin" page. In organizations restricting available models, an issue where running `/model default` in cloud sessions caused all subsequent messages to fail has been eliminated. Additionally, when Claude works from repository subfolders, file links in transcripts opening GitHub 404 errors have been fixed. ⟦This is like public amenities noticeboards in rental apartments, where all available spaces are clear at a glance rather than folded away, offering clear guidance routes to visitors instead of locked doors.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed `/model default` in a cloud session leaving every later message failing in organizations that restrict which models Claude Code can use
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed file links in cloud session transcripts opening a GitHub 404 when Claude was working from a subfolder of the repository
[Claude Code on the web] Changed the Cloud environments admin page to list every environment instead of capping each table at five rows behind a Show more control that could be unreachable
[Claude Code on the web] Changed claude.ai/code for Free-plan users to open the plans page with a path to upgrade, instead of a "Disabled by org admin" page with no way forward

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] 管理設定新增確認視窗，阻擋未授權模型靜默備援
title.en: [Claude Tag] Admin settings add confirmation dialogs, blocking quiet fallbacks for unauthorized models

body.zh-TW: ⟦這套安全機制有如商業銀行的金庫門禁協議，重大權限異動在執行前必須再次核對印鑑，遇上未經授權的業務申請時斷然拒絕並指明授權主管，外包通行證也清楚印上管理單位。⟧管理後台的防護與效能獲得顯著強化。在管理設定中針對 GitHub 安裝點擊全部連線或中斷連線時，現在會先跳出確認對話框以防止組織層級的誤觸。當使用者嘗試切換至組織尚未啟用的模型時，Claude 不再默默接受並以備援（fallback）模型私下回答，而是會直接拒絕並提示可由管理員啟用。Slack 存取設定中的外掛橫列不再只顯示未標籤的原始 ID，改為顯示外掛名稱並連結至管理套件。此外，從 Slack 啟動的工作階段（session），共享工作階段橫幅與分享對話框都會指名 Slack 頻道受眾，管理頁面與頻道選擇器的載入速度也獲得改善。
body.en: ⟦This security mechanism is like vault access protocols at a commercial bank, where major permission changes require seal verification before execution, unauthorized business applications are firmly declined with designated authorizing managers, and contractor passes clearly stamp the managing unit.⟧ Admin console protection and performance have been significantly reinforced. Clicking Connect all or Disconnect on GitHub installations in admin settings now prompts a confirmation dialog to guard against accidental organization-wide changes. When attempting to switch to a model not enabled by the organization, Claude no longer quietly accepts and answers with a fallback model, but instead declines and indicates an admin can enable it. Plugin rows in Slack access settings no longer show only unlabeled raw IDs, but now display plugin names and link to the managing bundle. Additionally, for sessions started from Slack, shared session banners and Share dialogs name the Slack channel audience, while load times for admin settings and the channel picker have improved.

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Added a confirmation dialog before Connect all or Disconnect on a GitHub installation in admin settings, to guard against accidental organization-wide changes
[Claude Tag] Fixed Claude accepting a switch to a model your organization hasn't enabled and then quietly answering with a fallback model; it now declines and says an admin can enable it
[Claude Tag] Fixed plugin rows in Slack access settings showing an unlabeled raw ID with no way to turn the plugin off; they now show its name and link to the bundle that manages it
[Claude Tag] Fixed the shared-session banner and Share dialog on sessions started from Slack claiming the whole organization could open the link; they now name the Slack channel's audience
[Claude Tag] Improved load time of the admin settings page and its Slack channel picker, most noticeably for organizations with many channels or several connected workspaces

title.zh-TW: [Claude Tag] 對話串自動重試失敗通知，表格附件與例行排程修復
title.en: [Claude Tag] Threads automatically retry failure notices, fixing table attachments and routine runs

body.zh-TW: 在 Slack 頻道中與 Claude 協同作業時，通知與排版呈現更加穩定。當回合失敗遇到 Slack 短暫限流時，失敗通知不再被遺棄而導致討論串陷入沉默，現在會自動重試發送。當同一則訊息中包含附件檔案時，表格不再被降級為未排版的直槓原始文字，改為正常渲染表格並將附加檔案以簡明說明接續呈現。在未啟動 Claude 的頻道頂層輸入 `@Claude !restart` 時，不再開啟無關對話，而是以私人訊息回覆目前沒有可重啟的工作。此外，頻道中的定時例行任務現在能直接回覆在既有的討論串內，避免在頂層不斷發布新訊息洗版；即時進度檢查清單的時間戳記也改為顯示讀者本機時間與更新距今時間，取代原本固定的 UTC 時間。⟦這好似辦公室公佈欄的便條紙維護，逾期通知會主動重貼，討論串維持在原討論版夾而不任意張貼，所有公告日期也自動換算成各地辦公室的當地時間。⟧
body.en: When collaborating with Claude in Slack channels, notifications and formatting render more reliably. When a failed turn hits brief Slack rate limits, failure notices are no longer dropped to leave threads silent, but are now automatically retried. When tables are posted alongside attached files in the same message, tables are no longer downgraded to raw pipe text, instead posting as normally rendered tables followed by plain file captions. Entering `@Claude !restart` at the top level of a channel where Claude is not active no longer starts unrelated conversations, replying privately instead that there is nothing to restart. Additionally, scheduled routines in channels can now reply directly in existing threads rather than spamming new top-level messages; timestamps on live progress checklists now display each reader's local time and relative update elapsed time instead of fixed UTC times. ⟦This is like maintaining sticky notes on an office bulletin board, where overdue notices are proactively reposted, threads stay within designated clipboards rather than cluttering boards, and announcement dates automatically convert to each branch office's local time.⟧

items.original:
[Claude Tag] Fixed threads occasionally going silent after a failed turn because the failure notice was dropped when Slack briefly rate-limited it; the notice is now retried
[Claude Tag] Fixed a table posting as raw pipe text when Claude attached files to the same message; the table now posts as a normal reply and the files follow with a plain caption
[Claude Tag] Fixed `@Claude !restart` at the top level of a channel where Claude isn't active starting an unrelated conversation; it now privately says there is nothing to restart
[Claude Tag] Improved scheduled routines in Slack channels: a routine run can now reply in an existing thread instead of always posting a new top-level channel message
[Claude Tag] Improved the timestamp on Claude's live progress checklists to show each reader's local time and how long ago it was updated, instead of a fixed UTC time

entries: Added to the Claude apps gateway: with `pricing:` set in `gateway.yaml`, signed-in Claude Code clients receive the same rates through managed settings, so `/cost` and telemetry match the spend meter
Added a startup warning for gateways when `access_control.allow_cidrs` is empty, and a one-time warning the first time a request arrives from a public address
Added the `gatewayInternalNetworks` managed setting, letting administrators allow `/login` to a Claude apps gateway on their organization's own public IPv4 block
Added `claude self-hosted-runner --remove-session-state` (default off): delete each session's per-session directories under `<base-dir>/_sessions/` when the session ends
Added `configDirectory` to the output of `claude auth status --json`
Added `--json` to `claude plugin install`, `uninstall`, `update`, `enable` and `disable`, and `errorDetails`/`noteDetails` to each row of `claude plugin list --json`
Added browser-tab icons for published artifacts, chosen by Claude to match each page
Fixed every turn failing with HTTP 400 on third-party Anthropic-compatible endpoints (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`) since 2.1.265: a regex in the Artifact tool's input schema that those endpoints reject

Fixed WebFetch hanging indefinitely on a server that keeps the response open without finishing; a fetch now fails after 300 seconds. Set `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_DEADLINE_MS` to override the deadline (0 turns it off)
Fixed a respawned in-process teammate picking up tools or a system prompt from a same-named agent file in a folder you have not trusted
Fixed sustained high CPU usage: a busy loop in long-running idle sessions no longer pins a CPU core, and rapid terminal focus reports during a session recap no longer keep the CPU high
Fixed Claude sometimes replying "your message came through empty" after an MCP tool call

Fixed deny and ask permission rules on symlinked directories (`/etc`, `/tmp`, `/var` on macOS; `/bin` on Linux) not applying when a path was given by its real location, and Bash commands ignoring deny rules written on a symlinked path spelling
Fixed a case where a Read or Edit deny rule did not apply when an `env -C`, `eval` or similar command the permission checker cannot analyze was on the same line
Fixed plugin and marketplace errors showing a token or password from a git source URL
Fixed `/mcp` and `/plugin` server details, `claude mcp list`/`get`, and MCP login errors showing secrets resolved from `${VAR}` placeholders in MCP configs
Fixed prompt caching and extended thinking breaking mid-session for SDK sessions using `excludeDynamicSections`: the first message is no longer re-rendered each request
Fixed entitled users being told a model is restricted after restart or in the Desktop Code tab when a cached model-access denial was stale
Fixed a running session silently switching to the organization's default model when another Claude Code process refreshed a stale model-access entry
Fixed long-context 429s on Fable models showing the usage-credits consent prompt instead of the 1M-context message on Pro and Team plans
Fixed workload identity federation via a profile (as claude-code-action configures it): processes sharing the profile could fail mid-run with `401 … jti reused`
Fixed MCP server OAuth sign-in failing with "No available ports for OAuth redirect" when the local callback port range can't be bound
Fixed the conversation summary produced by `/compact` and auto-compact mangling text that contained `$` sequences
Fixed resuming a conversation that ended with `/compact`: its restored-file notes now load in the same order on every resume
Fixed SDK prompt suggestions, side questions and `/rename` sending the conversation from before a compaction
Fixed `@` file and `/` command suggestions not appearing after recalling a previous prompt with the up arrow and editing it
Fixed `claude agents`: pressing ← again at a natural pace to go back to the agent list no longer gets ignored until you pause for over a second
Fixed `claude agents` session delete getting stuck when a worktree can't be removed: the message names the cause and next step, and for a git worktree ctrl+x again deletes the directory anyway
Fixed background agent and workflow rows in the agents panel expanding to many lines when their text contained line breaks
Fixed Claude in Slack sessions losing their Slack tools when org managed settings set an MCP allowlist
Fixed Claude in Chrome asking to allow the host "https" when a navigation URL had a scheme but a host that could not be parsed
Fixed the spinner wrapping onto several lines when the current task's label is long; the label and the "Next:" task line now stay within one terminal row
Fixed the `/bug` and `/feedback` description field showing no cursor when the terminal's native cursor is enabled
Fixed Remote Control sessions served by `claude remote-control` showing a generated name instead of their session title in `ListAgents`
Fixed `claude plugin validate` rejecting plugin paths whose directory name begins with two dots, which the plugin loader accepts
Fixed plugins silently skipping a default monitors file or root SKILL.md that could not be checked
Fixed WebFetch's error for localhost and other dotless hostnames to explain why the URL is refused and suggest curl
Fixed PermissionRequest hooks not firing in `--print` mode
Fixed policy-helper warnings not printing on headless (`-p`) runs
Fixed `/resume` listing a `/fork` background session under its parent's name instead of its own `⑂` fork name
Fixed `/remote-control` and other claude.ai-gated commands to suggest `/login` when signed out instead of showing a Claude for Enterprise migration message
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS` not extending SessionEnd hooks that have no per-hook `timeout` (they were still cancelled after 1.5 seconds)
Fixed `/autofix-pr` and other cloud-session commands saying to retry or install the Claude GitHub App when no GitHub account is connected; they now point to `/web-setup` or the web connect page
Fixed cloud-session commands such as `/teleport` and `/remote-env` to explain when an organization policy turns them off, instead of answering "Unknown command"
Fixed Bash sandbox instructions over-stating confinement: no unenforced path lists when filesystem isolation is off, and strict mode no longer claims commands can never run unsandboxed
Improved fullscreen mode: adding or removing a prompt line (Shift+Enter) now repaints as fast as typing a character instead of re-rendering the visible transcript
Improved `--continue` / `--resume`: the conversation appears immediately instead of waiting for SessionStart hooks, and the first message no longer re-reads the whole transcript
Improved responsiveness during tool-heavy turns by no longer redrawing the transcript for a hidden per-tool-batch reminder
Improved startup time in projects with `.claude/workflows/` scripts: listing them no longer parses each script
Improved auto mode denials: the message Claude receives now names the rule that blocked the action and asks Claude to try a safer method and finish unrelated work before stopping to ask you
Improved Claude in Chrome: long page reads now stay inline instead of being saved to a file and read back
Improved the MEMORY.md truncation warning to say how many lines were cut and where the cut starts
Improved the terminal permission prompt for artifacts: it now leads with the ask's question
Improved the prompt footer: an editor or `/diff` selection now shows inside the prompt input, and fullscreen mode shows Remote Control status in the header instead of the footer
Improved the "Usage credits required for 1M context" message to say that usage credits turned on mid-session take effect after restarting Claude Code
Improved `/plugin`: installing, enabling or disabling a plugin now takes effect when you close the menu; `/reload-plugins` is no longer needed afterwards
Changed the system prompt on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry to deliver environment, model and settings details as attachments, matching first-party sessions
Changed Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry sessions to keep the tool list byte-stable across a conversation (late-connecting tools load deferred instead of rewriting it), matching first-party sessions
Changed the task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) to be offered only on Claude 3.x, Opus 4.0–4.7, Sonnet 4.0–4.6, Haiku 4.5; set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` elsewhere
Changed the artifact data-edit permission prompt in the terminal to a card that shows the document count and who can open the artifact
Changed local Cowork sessions set to skip all approvals: the Artifact tool now refuses a local file outside the session's folders, or behind a symlink, instead of reading it without asking
Changed plain `WebFetch` deny and ask rules to no longer apply to Artifact tool reads and updates; use an `Artifact` rule (or `WebFetch(domain:claude.ai)`) to block or gate them
Changed the "N MCP servers need authentication" startup notice to announce each server once instead of at every launch
[VSCode] Fixed the session list, settings toggles, and chat tabs when `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is set in a settings file or the `environmentVariables` setting
[VSCode] Fixed the model pill, model picker and command menu going blank in open tabs for a few seconds after a login, logout or account switch
[VSCode] Fixed Auto disappearing from the mode picker in new-tab or just-reloaded conversations when a project or local setting overrides the model named in `~/.claude/settings.json`
[VSCode] Fixed session names reverting to the last prompt after a window reload when a SessionStart hook is configured
[VSCode] Fixed the footer's model pill and Remote Control pill waiting for the new tab's Claude process to start when another tab in the window is already up
[VSCode] Fixed a second Claude process running through its full startup when a session tab's launch arrived more than half a second after its config read
[VSCode] Fixed resuming a session from the session list ignoring `claudeCode.preferredLocation: "sidebar"` (it always opened a panel), and programmatic opens resetting that setting to "panel"
[VSCode] Fixed Windows issues: the WSL install prompt no longer appears on machines without WSL installed, and IDE diagnostics are now returned correctly for Windows files when WSL is installed
[VSCode] Fixed the custom style builder saving a User level style in a folder the CLI does not read when `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is set through settings
[VSCode] Added Left and Right arrow keys to change where an always-allow permission rule is saved, for keyboard and screen reader users
[VSCode] Added a "Claude Code: Focus last message" command that moves keyboard focus to the newest message in the conversation, for keyboard and screen reader users
[VSCode] Changed the Manage plugins dialog to apply installs, enables, disables and uninstalls to open sessions without a restart
[VSCode] Changed some artifact permission prompts to omit the "don't ask again" choice, matching the terminal
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed cloud sessions running longer than about six hours silently losing files saved to persisted session folders; saves now persist for up to a day
[Claude Code on the web] Fixed "Invalid effort level" errors when a routine resumes a session, or a session starts with no set effort, in orgs where an admin caps a model's effort
[Claude Code on the web] Improved routine creation from a conversation: when the new routine has no connectors, Claude now says so and how to add them instead of only confirming it
[Claude Tag] Fixed the admin settings page hanging on a loading skeleton or going blank after a transient load failure; a section that fails to load now shows a Retry button
[Claude Tag] Added a link from a Slack channel's configure page back to the organization's Claude in Slack admin settings
[Claude Tag] Fixed a Slack Enterprise Grid channel losing its Claude settings (repository, environment, access) after a Slack admin moved it to another workspace
[Claude Tag] Improved how Claude explains a blocked action: it now says whether a permission check, its own decision to confirm first, or missing access stopped it
[Claude Tag] Improved reply speed: Claude now runs several read-only lookups (searching Slack, reading a thread, finding people) at once instead of one after another
[Claude Tag] Improved formatting of comparisons: sentence-length comparisons now come as lists instead of wide tables that scroll sideways, and long table cells wrap
[Claude Tag] Fixed `@Claude !restart` in a thread with its own session sometimes also posting a contradictory "this thread is handled by the channel session" notice
[Claude Tag] Improved the message shown when your Claude account is in a different organization than the Slack workspace: it now explains how to connect the workspace to your org
[Claude Tag] Fixed Markdown links whose URL is wrapped in angle brackets showing as literal bracket text in Slack instead of a clickable link
[Claude Tag] Fixed a workspace guest's top-level @mention in a channel where guests may use Claude sometimes getting a "your Slack account isn't connected" reply instead of an answer
[Claude Tag] Fixed a channel's long-running session being replaced with a fresh one mid-conversation; the scheduled refresh now waits until the channel and its threads are quiet
[Claude Tag] Fixed channel-settings cards clicked more than once telling the proposing session the change was refused after it had already applied; the outcome is now sent once
[Claude Tag] Changed memory in public channels: each channel now keeps its own notes, and Claude no longer recalls notes it saved in other public channels; workspace notes stay shared
[Code Review] Added a note under the still-open findings list in follow-up reviews: resolving a finding's thread, not just replying to it, stops later reviews from counting it as open
[Code Review] Fixed reviews sometimes ending as incomplete when one of the agents verifying a finding failed midway; the review now replaces that agent and reaches a verdict
[Code Review] Fixed a push-triggered review that was queued behind a running review still posting after the pull request had been converted to draft
[Code Review] Fixed reviews ignoring a directory's CLAUDE.md conventions when the PR edited a root file (e.g. README.md) that only shares a name with a file that CLAUDE.md lists

title.zh-TW: 企業閘道費率同步計費，啟動警告與內部網段登入
title.en: Enterprise Gateway Pricing Sync, Startup Warnings, and Internal Network Sign-In

body.zh-TW: 企業為團隊架設 Claude 應用程式閘道器（gateway）時，現在能享有更一致的計費與安全管控。⟦這宛如在企業園區設立專屬接駁總站，發車計費全由站內統一公告，遇到外部陌生旅客上車時主動鳴笛警示，並只認可公司名下的專屬通勤路線。⟧只要在 `gateway.yaml` 設定 `pricing:`，已登入的 Claude Code 用戶端就會透過受管設定接收相同費率，使 `/cost` 指令與遙測數據精準對齊支出計量表。當 `access_control.allow_cidrs` 保持空白時，閘道器在啟動時會主動發出警告，且首次有請求從公開位址抵達時也會發出一次性警告。此外，管理員可配置 `gatewayInternalNetworks` 受管設定，允許使用者在組織自有的公開 IPv4 網段向閘道器執行 `/login` 登入。
body.en: When enterprises deploy a Claude apps gateway for their teams, they now get more consistent billing and security controls. ⟦This is like setting up a dedicated shuttle terminal on a corporate campus, where dispatch fares are posted centrally, horns sound whenever unfamiliar outside passengers board, and only the company's designated commuter routes are approved.⟧ By setting `pricing:` in `gateway.yaml`, signed-in Claude Code clients receive the same rates through managed settings, keeping the `/cost` command and telemetry accurately matched to the spend meter. When `access_control.allow_cidrs` is empty, the gateway now issues a warning at startup and a one-time warning the first time a request arrives from a public address. In addition, administrators can configure the `gatewayInternalNetworks` managed setting to allow users to `/login` to the gateway on their organization's own public IPv4 block.

items.original:
Added to the Claude apps gateway: with `pricing:` set in `gateway.yaml`, signed-in Claude Code clients receive the same rates through managed settings, so `/cost` and telemetry match the spend meter
Added a startup warning for gateways when `access_control.allow_cidrs` is empty, and a one-time warning the first time a request arrives from a public address
Added the `gatewayInternalNetworks` managed setting, letting administrators allow `/login` to a Claude apps gateway on their organization's own public IPv4 block

title.zh-TW: 工件分頁專屬圖示，資料編輯卡片與存取審核加固
title.en: Dedicated Artifact Tab Icons, Data-Edit Cards, and Hardened Access Checks

body.zh-TW:
工件（artifact，在獨立視窗展示的成果文件）迎來視覺與權限更新。發布時瀏覽器分頁會由 Claude 挑選符合頁面的專屬圖示。終端機權限提示改以提問開頭，資料編輯審核改用卡片顯示文件數與可開啟對象。在跳過核准的本機協同工作階段（session）中，安全防護進一步加固。工件工具遇到資料夾外或符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔）後的檔案會直接拒絕讀取。一般的 `WebFetch` 規則不再套用至工件讀寫，需改用專屬規則把關：
```
# 阻擋或把關工件讀寫
Artifact
WebFetch(domain:claude.ai)
```
自 2.1.265 版起第三方相容端點因結構中的正規表達式（用符號匹配字串的語法）導致回傳 HTTP 400 的問題也已修復。⟦整體防護好似博物館的玻璃陳列櫃，外側貼上清晰的展品圖示與參觀說明，櫃內展品不允許任意越界調換，非專屬通道也不再隨意連通外部參觀動線。⟧
body.en:
Artifacts receive visual and permission updates. When published, browser tabs now display a dedicated icon chosen by Claude to match each page. The terminal permission prompt now leads with the ask's question, and data-edit permission prompts switch to a card showing the document count and who can open the artifact. In local Cowork sessions configured to skip all approvals, security protections are further hardened. The Artifact tool now directly refuses to read local files outside session folders or behind symlinks. Plain `WebFetch` rules no longer apply to Artifact tool reads and updates, requiring dedicated rules to gate them:
```
# Block or gate Artifact reads and updates
Artifact
WebFetch(domain:claude.ai)
```
An issue since version 2.1.265 where third-party compatible endpoints returned HTTP 400 due to a regex in the schema has also been fixed. ⟦The overall protection is like a museum glass display case, where clear exhibit icons and visitor guides are posted outside, items inside cannot be swapped across boundaries, and non-dedicated corridors no longer connect freely to external tour routes.⟧

items.original:
Added browser-tab icons for published artifacts, chosen by Claude to match each page
Fixed every turn failing with HTTP 400 on third-party Anthropic-compatible endpoints (`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL`) since 2.1.265: a regex in the Artifact tool's input schema that those endpoints reject
Improved the terminal permission prompt for artifacts: it now leads with the ask's question
Changed the artifact data-edit permission prompt in the terminal to a card that shows the document count and who can open the artifact
Changed local Cowork sessions set to skip all approvals: the Artifact tool now refuses a local file outside the session's folders, or behind a symlink, instead of reading it without asking
Changed plain `WebFetch` deny and ask rules to no longer apply to Artifact tool reads and updates; use an `Artifact` rule (or `WebFetch(domain:claude.ai)`) to block or gate them

title.zh-TW: 外掛管理支援結構化輸出，選單改動即時生效
title.en: Plugin Management Structured Output and Instant Menu Updates

body.zh-TW:
想要透過腳本自動化管理工具，外掛指令現在全面補齊了結構化輸出，清單各列也補上錯誤與備註細節：
```
claude auth status --json             # 輸出包含 configDirectory
claude plugin install --json          # 安裝外掛
claude plugin uninstall --json        # 解除安裝
claude plugin update --json           # 更新外掛
claude plugin enable --json           # 啟用外掛
claude plugin disable --json          # 停用外掛
claude plugin list --json             # 每列含 errorDetails 與 noteDetails
```
在終端機操作 `/plugin` 選單進行安裝、啟用或停用時，只要關閉選單就會直接生效，不必手動輸入 `/reload-plugins`。此外，`claude plugin validate` 先前誤拒以兩個點開頭的外掛路徑，以及外掛檢查時靜默略過預設 monitors 檔案或根目錄 `SKILL.md` 的問題均已修復。⟦這套流程宛若將工具箱換上標準卡榫與透明標籤，抽換刀頭當場卡緊即用，規格清單與錯誤代碼也能讓自動化輸送帶即時讀取。⟧
body.en:
For automating tool management via scripts, plugin commands now provide full structured output support, with error and note details added to list rows:
```
claude auth status --json             # Output includes configDirectory
claude plugin install --json          # Install plugin
claude plugin uninstall --json        # Uninstall plugin
claude plugin update --json           # Update plugin
claude plugin enable --json           # Enable plugin
claude plugin disable --json          # Disable plugin
claude plugin list --json             # Each row includes errorDetails and noteDetails
```
When installing, enabling, or disabling plugins through the `/plugin` terminal menu, changes take effect immediately upon closing the menu without running `/reload-plugins`. Additionally, fixes resolve `claude plugin validate` mistakenly rejecting plugin paths beginning with two dots, as well as plugin checks silently skipping default monitors files or root `SKILL.md` files. ⟦This workflow is like upgrading a toolbox with standardized latches and clear labels, where swapped bits lock in instantly for immediate use, while spec sheets and error codes are cleanly read by automated conveyor belts.⟧

items.original:
Added `configDirectory` to the output of `claude auth status --json`
Added `--json` to `claude plugin install`, `uninstall`, `update`, `enable` and `disable`, and `errorDetails`/`noteDetails` to each row of `claude plugin list --json`
Fixed `claude plugin validate` rejecting plugin paths whose directory name begins with two dots, which the plugin loader accepts
Fixed plugins silently skipping a default monitors file or root SKILL.md that could not be checked
Improved `/plugin`: installing, enabling or disabling a plugin now takes effect when you close the menu; `/reload-plugins` is no longer needed afterwards

title.zh-TW: 符號連結權限嚴格比對，遮蔽連線機密與未信任代理
title.en: Strict Symlink Permission Checks, Masked Connection Secrets, and Untrusted Agent Isolation

body.zh-TW: 終端機安全防護更周全。⟦這套防線好似園區的多重身分核驗閘門，訪客走正門或側門得比對指紋，私密證件封入暗袋，不因呼叫口令改變就放行。⟧針對 macOS 的 `/etc`、`/tmp`、`/var` 或 Linux 的 `/bin`，無論真實路徑或符號連結（指向另一個位置的捷徑檔），拒絕與詢問規則皆能套用，Bash 指令不再忽視捷徑拼法。同列含 `env -C` 或 `eval` 等無法分析的指令時，讀取與編輯拒絕規則依然生效。外掛與市集報錯不再洩漏 Git 網址內的 token（授權令牌）或密碼。在 `/mcp`、`/plugin` 詳情、`claude mcp list`/`get` 或登入錯誤中，`${VAR}` 解析出的機密不再曝光，涵蓋 MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）配置。重啟的行程內隊友不再取用未信任目錄的工具或提示詞；Bash 沙箱指示也不再過度宣稱限制。
body.en: Terminal security protections are now more thorough. ⟦This defense is like a multi-stage identity verification gate across a campus, verifying fingerprints whether visitors arrive at the main entrance or side doors, keeping confidential credentials in sealed pouches, and never letting anyone through merely because invocation phrases change.⟧ Deny and ask rules now apply to `/etc`, `/tmp`, and `/var` on macOS or `/bin` on Linux whether specified by their real location or a symlink, and Bash commands no longer ignore symlink spellings. Read and Edit deny rules remain effective even when unanalyzable commands such as `env -C` or `eval` appear on the same line. Plugin and marketplace errors no longer leak tokens or passwords from Git URLs. Resolved secrets from `${VAR}` placeholders in configs no longer appear in `/mcp` or `/plugin` details, `claude mcp list`/`get`, or MCP login errors. Respawned in-process teammates no longer pick up tools or prompts from untrusted directories, and Bash sandbox instructions no longer overstate confinement restrictions.

items.original:
Fixed a respawned in-process teammate picking up tools or a system prompt from a same-named agent file in a folder you have not trusted
Fixed deny and ask permission rules on symlinked directories (`/etc`, `/tmp`, `/var` on macOS; `/bin` on Linux) not applying when a path was given by its real location, and Bash commands ignoring deny rules written on a symlinked path spelling
Fixed a case where a Read or Edit deny rule did not apply when an `env -C`, `eval` or similar command the permission checker cannot analyze was on the same line
Fixed plugin and marketplace errors showing a token or password from a git source URL
Fixed `/mcp` and `/plugin` server details, `claude mcp list`/`get`, and MCP login errors showing secrets resolved from `${VAR}` placeholders in MCP configs
Fixed Bash sandbox instructions over-stating confinement: no unenforced path lists when filesystem isolation is off, and strict mode no longer claims commands can never run unsandboxed

title.zh-TW: 雲端推論保持工具穩定，分級開放任務追蹤功能
title.en: Stable Cloud Inference Tools and Tiered Task-Tracking Rollout

body.zh-TW:
透過各大雲端平台租用 Claude 進行開發，推論環境與工具載入機制變得更加標準化。在 Bedrock、Vertex 與 Foundry 上的工作階段（session）中，環境、模型與設定改以附件形式送達，與原生對話一致。這些平台上的工具清單在對話中保持位元組層級穩定，較晚連線的工具改以延遲載入而非重寫清單。任務追蹤工具現在預設僅提供給指定模型族系：
```
# 僅支援 Claude 3.x、Opus 4.0 至 4.7、Sonnet 4.0 至 4.6 與 Haiku 4.5
# 其餘模型需在環境變數開啟：
CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1
```
包含 TaskCreate、TaskGet、TaskUpdate、TaskList 與 TodoWrite 工具。此外，使用 `excludeDynamicSections` 的 SDK 工作階段首則訊息不再於每次請求重新渲染，修復了提示快取（把算過結果暫存起來直接用）與延伸思考中途斷裂的問題。⟦整體架構猶如為各家分校實驗室配發標準封裝箱，儀器按既定清單就位而不中途翻箱，只有具備對應資格的專業技工才配發專案工作單。⟧
body.en:
When developing with Claude through major cloud platforms, inference environments and tool-loading mechanisms are now more standardized. In Bedrock, Vertex, and Foundry sessions, environment, model, and settings details are delivered as attachments, matching first-party sessions. Tool lists on these platforms remain byte-stable across conversations, with late-connecting tools loading deferred instead of rewriting the list. Task-tracking tools are now offered by default only on designated model families:
```
# Only Claude 3.x, Opus 4.0 to 4.7, Sonnet 4.0 to 4.6, and Haiku 4.5
# Enable for other models via environment variable:
CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1
```
This includes TaskCreate, TaskGet, TaskUpdate, TaskList, and TodoWrite tools. Furthermore, for SDK sessions using `excludeDynamicSections`, the first message is no longer re-rendered on each request, fixing prompt caching and extended thinking breaking mid-session. ⟦The overall architecture is like distributing standardized equipment crates to branch laboratories, where instruments stay in place according to fixed manifests without mid-way reshuffling, and only qualified technicians receive project work orders.⟧

items.original:
Fixed prompt caching and extended thinking breaking mid-session for SDK sessions using `excludeDynamicSections`: the first message is no longer re-rendered each request
Changed the system prompt on Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry to deliver environment, model and settings details as attachments, matching first-party sessions
Changed Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry sessions to keep the tool list byte-stable across a conversation (late-connecting tools load deferred instead of rewriting it), matching first-party sessions
Changed the task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) to be offered only on Claude 3.x, Opus 4.0–4.7, Sonnet 4.0–4.6, Haiku 4.5; set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` elsewhere

title.zh-TW: 模型快取存取修正，長對話精準提示百萬上下文
title.en: Model Cache Access Fixes and Accurate 1M-Context Prompts for Long Sessions

body.zh-TW: 經常在對話中切換模型或送出長篇文字的讀者，存取權限與錯誤提示現在更準確。⟦這恰似高級圖書館的貴賓通行證，會員資格即使重新進出也不會因舊記錄而被擋在門外，桌位更不會在看書途中被擅自降等。⟧擁有合法授權的使用者，在重啟後或於桌面端 Code 分頁中，不再因過期的快取（把算過結果暫存起來直接用）而誤收到模型存取受限的阻擋訊息。當其他 Claude Code 行程重新整理過期的存取記錄時，進行中的工作階段（session）也不會再默默切換回組織預設模型。針對 Pro 與 Team 方案的使用者，在 Fable 模型上觸發長上下文 429 限流時，不再誤顯示用量額度同意提示，而是正確顯示 1M 上下文說明。相關訊息也經過改善，明確提醒使用者在中途開啟的額度需在重啟 Claude Code 後正式生效。
body.en: For users frequently switching models or sending lengthy prompts in conversations, access permissions and error notices are now more accurate. ⟦This is like a VIP library pass where membership access is never blocked upon re-entry due to outdated records, and desks are never silently downgraded while reading.⟧ Entitled users no longer receive false model restriction messages after restart or in the Desktop Code tab due to stale cached access denials. When another Claude Code process refreshes a stale model-access entry, running sessions no longer silently switch back to the organization's default model. For Pro and Team plan users triggering long-context 429 rate limits on Fable models, the prompt now correctly shows the 1M-context message instead of the usage-credits consent dialog. Related messaging has also been improved to clearly remind users that usage credits enabled mid-session take effect after restarting Claude Code.

items.original:
Fixed entitled users being told a model is restricted after restart or in the Desktop Code tab when a cached model-access denial was stale
Fixed a running session silently switching to the organization's default model when another Claude Code process refreshed a stale model-access entry
Fixed long-context 429s on Fable models showing the usage-credits consent prompt instead of the 1M-context message on Pro and Team plans
Improved the "Usage credits required for 1M context" message to say that usage credits turned on mid-session take effect after restarting Claude Code

title.zh-TW: 對話壓縮保留特殊符號，記憶截斷標明行數與起點
title.en: Preserved Special Characters in Compaction and Line-Marked Memory Truncation

body.zh-TW: 長時間對話後的歷史摘要與專案記憶，不再因為特殊符號而產生文字損毀。在終端機執行 `/compact` 指令或觸發自動壓縮時，產生的對話摘要不再損毀包含 `$` 字元序列的文字。以 `/compact` 結尾的對話在恢復時，還原檔案的註記現在於每次恢復時都能維持相同載入順序。SDK 的提示建議、旁支提問與 `/rename` 指令，修復了在壓縮後仍送出壓縮前舊對話的問題。當專案內的 `MEMORY.md` 記憶檔案因篇幅超標遭到截斷時，警告訊息現在會清楚說明切除了多少行，以及裁切是從檔案的何處開始。⟦這如同文卷室的檔案裝訂程序，厚重卷宗提煉精要時符號與段落井然有序，若紙頁過長而修剪邊緣，也會蓋章註明起點與裁切頁數。⟧
body.en: History summaries and project memory after lengthy conversations no longer suffer text corruption from special characters. When executing the `/compact` command in the terminal or triggering auto-compact, generated summaries no longer mangle text containing `$` character sequences. When resuming conversations that ended with `/compact`, restored-file notes now maintain the exact same loading order on every resume. For SDK prompt suggestions, side questions, and `/rename`, fixes ensure they no longer send the pre-compaction transcript. When a project's `MEMORY.md` file is truncated due to length limits, the warning message now explicitly states how many lines were cut and where the truncation begins. ⟦This is like an archival binding process where condensing thick dossiers preserves symbols and paragraphs orderly, and trimming oversized sheets stamps the starting position and total cut pages.⟧

items.original:
Fixed the conversation summary produced by `/compact` and auto-compact mangling text that contained `$` sequences
Fixed resuming a conversation that ended with `/compact`: its restored-file notes now load in the same order on every resume
Fixed SDK prompt suggestions, side questions and `/rename` sending the conversation from before a compaction
Improved the MEMORY.md truncation warning to say how many lines were cut and where the cut starts

title.zh-TW: 代理人面板快速導覽，修復工作樹卡死與腳本解析
title.en: Faster Agents Panel Navigation, Worktree Stuck Fixes, and Script Parsing Optimizations

body.zh-TW: 管理背景代理人與工作流程的介面操作，變得更加俐落敏捷。在 `claude agents` 介面中，按向左鍵 ← 返回清單不再被忽略，不必停頓超過 1 秒。刪除代理人的工作階段（session）卡死問題已獲改善。若因工作樹（Git 讓同一專案平行開多份副本的功能）無法移除而停滯，訊息會指明原因與處置，再次按下 Ctrl+X 仍可強制刪除目錄。面板中的背景代理與工作流程橫列，遇到換行符號不再異常撐開成多行。由 `claude remote-control` 服務的遠端工作階段，在 `ListAgents` 中會顯示工作階段標題而非隨機名稱。此外，啟動時列出 `.claude/workflows/` 流程不再逐一解析每份腳本，加快了啟動速度。⟦這般運作好似機場調度中心的航班看板，切換螢幕隨按隨翻，清除停機位遇到障礙能強制拖吊，即使機組腳本再多也能瞬間列出班表。⟧
body.en: Interface operations for managing background agents and workflows are now snappier. In the `claude agents` UI, pressing the left arrow key ← to return to the agent list is no longer ignored, eliminating the need to pause for over a second. Fixes improve issues where deleting an agent session got stuck. If removal halts because a worktree cannot be removed, the message specifies the cause and next steps, and pressing Ctrl+X again still force-deletes the directory. Background agent and workflow rows in the panel no longer stretch into multiple lines when text contains line breaks. Remote Control sessions served by `claude remote-control` now display session titles instead of generated names in `ListAgents`. Furthermore, listing `.claude/workflows/` scripts at startup no longer parses each script individually, speeding up launch times. ⟦This workflow operates like an airport flight status board, switching screens instantly on demand, force-towing obstacles when clearing gates, and displaying schedules immediately even with numerous crew scripts.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `claude agents`: pressing ← again at a natural pace to go back to the agent list no longer gets ignored until you pause for over a second
Fixed `claude agents` session delete getting stuck when a worktree can't be removed: the message names the cause and next step, and for a git worktree ctrl+x again deletes the directory anyway
Fixed background agent and workflow rows in the agents panel expanding to many lines when their text contained line breaks
Fixed Remote Control sessions served by `claude remote-control` showing a generated name instead of their session title in `ListAgents`
Improved startup time in projects with `.claude/workflows/` scripts: listing them no longer parses each script

title.zh-TW: 外部工具協定登入修復，通知精簡且白名單不漏接
title.en: MCP Sign-In Fixes, Streamlined Notices, and Intact Tool Allowlists

body.zh-TW: 串接外部工具的協定連線與登入流程，修復了多處意外中斷的隱蔽錯誤。⟦這好似大型機構的委外專家接待窗口，每一位外聘顧問進駐時只審核一次證件，通訊埠隨時保持暢通，絕不因總公司更新名冊就把重要工具沒收。⟧過去在呼叫外部工具後，Claude 有時會異常回覆「你的訊息內容為空」，這項問題已經修好。當本機重新導向通訊埠範圍無法綁定時，MCP（讓 AI 連接外部工具的協定）伺服器進行 OAuth 登入不再拋出無可用通訊埠的錯誤。當組織受管設定啟用了 MCP 白名單時，Claude in Slack 的工作階段（session）不會再丟失原本自帶的 Slack 工具。此外，啟動時提示「N 個 MCP 伺服器需要驗證」的通知，現在改為每部伺服器僅公告一次，不再於每次啟動時重複跳出。
body.en: Connection and sign-in workflows for external tool integrations fix multiple subtle disruption bugs. ⟦This is like an external specialist reception desk at a major institution, verifying credentials only once upon arrival, keeping access ports open, and never confiscating vital tools just because headquarters updates a roster.⟧ A bug where Claude occasionally replied "your message came through empty" after an MCP tool call is now fixed. When local redirect port ranges cannot be bound, MCP server OAuth sign-in no longer throws errors claiming no ports are available. When organization managed settings enable an MCP allowlist, Claude in Slack sessions no longer lose their built-in Slack tools. In addition, the startup notice announcing "N MCP servers need authentication" now broadcasts only once per server instead of appearing on every launch.

items.original:
Fixed Claude sometimes replying "your message came through empty" after an MCP tool call
Fixed MCP server OAuth sign-in failing with "No available ports for OAuth redirect" when the local callback port range can't be bound
Fixed Claude in Slack sessions losing their Slack tools when org managed settings set an MCP allowlist
Changed the "N MCP servers need authentication" startup notice to announce each server once instead of at every launch

title.zh-TW: 網頁擷取限制等候逾時，無點主機導引替代指令
title.en: WebFetch Timeout Limits and Alternative Command Guidance for Dotless Hosts

body.zh-TW: 讓 AI 抓取線上網頁不再陷入無止境的乾等，網路擷取工具正式迎來明確的連線時限。`WebFetch` 工具遇到伺服器維持連線不結束傳輸時，現在會在 300 秒後逾時判定失敗；你可設定環境變數 `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_DEADLINE_MS` 自訂時限，設為 0 則關閉上限。讀取 localhost 或其他無小數點的主機名稱時，`WebFetch` 報錯會主動說明遭拒原因並建議改用 curl 指令。在 Claude in Chrome 瀏覽器擴充套件中，導覽網址帶有協定但主機名稱無法解析時，不再詢問是否允許主機「https」。閱讀長篇網頁時內容會直接在對話呈現，不再儲存至本機檔案後再讀回。⟦整套抓取機制宛如貨運碼頭的卸貨管制，靠岸船隻若長時間卡住泊位便會強制離港，非標準航道清楚指引替代陸運，隨船文件也能直接在碼頭拆閱。⟧
body.en: Fetching web pages with AI no longer hangs indefinitely, as web scraping tools now enforce explicit connection deadlines. When a server holds a connection open without finishing transmission, the `WebFetch` tool now times out and fails after 300 seconds; you can set the `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_DEADLINE_MS` environment variable to customize this deadline, or set it to 0 to disable the limit. When accessing localhost or other dotless hostnames, `WebFetch` errors now explain why the URL was refused and suggest using curl instead. In the Claude in Chrome extension, navigation URLs with a scheme but unparseable hostnames no longer prompt to allow the host "https". When reading lengthy web pages, content is now presented directly inline rather than being saved to a local file and read back. ⟦The entire scraping mechanism is like cargo dock unloading controls, where berthed vessels blocking slips for too long are ordered to depart, non-standard waterways direct traffic to alternative overland routes, and accompanying documents are inspected directly on the pier.⟧

items.original:
Fixed WebFetch hanging indefinitely on a server that keeps the response open without finishing; a fetch now fails after 300 seconds. Set `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_DEADLINE_MS` to override the deadline (0 turns it off)
Fixed Claude in Chrome asking to allow the host "https" when a navigation URL had a scheme but a host that could not be parsed
Fixed WebFetch's error for localhost and other dotless hostnames to explain why the URL is refused and suggest curl
Improved Claude in Chrome: long page reads now stay inline instead of being saved to a file and read back

title.zh-TW: 雲端連線引導登入網址，工作負載身分同盟不中斷
title.en: Cloud Command Sign-In URL Guidance and Uninterrupted Workload Identity Federation

body.zh-TW: 執行雲端遠端指令與跨平台驗證，提示訊息現在更加切合情境。⟦這有如跨國企業的差旅通行手冊，員工跨區出差時通行證不再被誤判重複使用，未登入時明確導引至打卡機，遇到權限封閉也清楚告知政策規定。⟧透過設定檔使用工作負載身分識別同盟時（如 claude-code-action 的配置），共用設定檔的多行程不再中途出現 `401 … jti reused` 錯誤。未登入時執行 `/remote-control` 等指令，系統主動建議輸入 `/login`，不再顯示企業遷移訊息。未連接 GitHub 帳號時輸入 `/autofix-pr` 等雲端工作階段（session）指令，畫面指引前往 `/web-setup` 或網頁連線頁，不再要求重試或安裝應用程式。組織政策停用 `/teleport` 或 `/remote-env` 時，終端機會具體說明禁用原因，不再只回覆未知指令。
body.en: Prompt messages are now more context-aware when executing cloud remote commands and cross-platform authentication. ⟦This is like a corporate travel handbook for a multinational enterprise, preventing travel passes from being mistakenly flagged as reused during regional trips, guiding signed-out staff clearly to time clocks, and explaining policies when permissions are closed.⟧ When using workload identity federation via a profile (such as configurations by claude-code-action), multiple processes sharing a profile no longer fail mid-run with `401 … jti reused` errors. Running commands like `/remote-control` while signed out now actively suggests `/login` instead of displaying Claude for Enterprise migration messages. Entering cloud-session commands like `/autofix-pr` without a connected GitHub account directs users to `/web-setup` or the web connect page rather than asking to retry or install the app. When organization policies disable `/teleport` or `/remote-env`, the terminal explains the specific reason instead of simply responding with an unknown command.

items.original:
Fixed workload identity federation via a profile (as claude-code-action configures it): processes sharing the profile could fail mid-run with `401 … jti reused`
Fixed `/remote-control` and other claude.ai-gated commands to suggest `/login` when signed out instead of showing a Claude for Enterprise migration message
Fixed `/autofix-pr` and other cloud-session commands saying to retry or install the Claude GitHub App when no GitHub account is connected; they now point to `/web-setup` or the web connect page
Fixed cloud-session commands such as `/teleport` and `/remote-env` to explain when an organization policy turns them off, instead of answering "Unknown command"

title.zh-TW: 執行器可選清理暫存，無頭模式警告與掛鉤逾時放寬
title.en: Optional Runner State Cleanup, Headless Warnings, and Extended Hook Timeouts

body.zh-TW: 自託管執行器的清理預設關閉；只有加上 `claude self-hosted-runner --remove-session-state`，才會在工作階段結束時刪除 `<base-dir>/_sessions/` 下的專屬目錄。權限請求掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）修復了在 `--print` 模式下未被觸發的問題。政策協助工具警告也能在無頭模式（headless，沒有終端機視窗的執行模式，即 `-p`）下印出。`/resume` 會把 `/fork` 產生的背景工作階段標成專屬 `⑂` 分岔名稱，不再誤列為父層名稱。未單獨設定超時的 SessionEnd 掛鉤不再強制於 1.5 秒後取消，能依 `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS` 延長。⟦像共享工作室退租，申請後才銷毀置物盒，門禁鈴聲照響，加班交件也能延長。⟧
body.en: Cleanup for self-hosted runners is disabled by default; only when passing `claude self-hosted-runner --remove-session-state` will dedicated directories under `<base-dir>/_sessions/` be deleted upon session completion. PermissionRequest hooks fix an issue where they failed to fire in `--print` mode. Policy-helper warnings now also print during headless (`-p`) runs. The `/resume` command now labels background sessions created by `/fork` with their dedicated `⑂` fork name instead of incorrectly listing them under their parent's name. SessionEnd hooks without a per-hook timeout are no longer forcibly cancelled after 1.5 seconds, allowing extensions via `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS`. ⟦Like ending a coworking lease, lockers are destroyed only upon request, access chimes ring as usual, and overtime submissions can be extended.⟧

items.original:
Added `claude self-hosted-runner --remove-session-state` (default off): delete each session's per-session directories under `<base-dir>/_sessions/` when the session ends
Fixed PermissionRequest hooks not firing in `--print` mode
Fixed policy-helper warnings not printing on headless (`-p`) runs
Fixed `/resume` listing a `/fork` background session under its parent's name instead of its own `⑂` fork name
Fixed `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSIONEND_HOOKS_TIMEOUT_MS` not extending SessionEnd hooks that have no per-hook `timeout` (they were still cancelled after 1.5 seconds)

title.zh-TW: 閒置工作階段修復高耗能，自動模式拒絕引導替代做法
title.en: Idle Session CPU Fixes and Safer Alternative Guidance on Auto Mode Denials

body.zh-TW: 終端機的日常反應速度迎來全面提升，有效降低資源浪費。⟦這如同為車輛加裝高速感應閘道與智慧導航，車流不再於入口處空踩油門乾等，遇到施工路段會明確引導替代小路，繼續完成其餘平順路程。⟧長時間閒置的工作階段（session）修復了迴圈空轉鎖死 CPU 核心的問題，對話摘要時密集的視窗焦點回報也不再維持高負載。全螢幕模式下按 Shift+Enter 增減換行時，重繪速度與打字一樣迅捷，不再重新渲染整個對話紀錄。使用 `--continue` 或 `--resume` 恢復對話時，畫面立即呈現，不必等候 SessionStart 掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式），首則訊息也不再重讀完整歷史。執行工具時不再因隱藏提醒重繪對話；自動模式被拒絕時，Claude 收到的訊息會具體標明被哪條規則阻擋，並指示嘗試更安全的做法以先完成其他不相關工作，而非貿然中斷停下詢問。
body.en: Daily terminal responsiveness receives a major boost, effectively reducing wasted resources. ⟦This is like equipping vehicles with high-speed sensor tolls and smart navigation, eliminating engine idling at entrances, clearly routing traffic around construction via side streets, and smoothly completing the remaining trip.⟧ Long-running idle sessions fix a busy-loop issue that pinned CPU cores, and rapid window focus reports during session recaps no longer maintain high loads. In fullscreen mode, adding or removing lines with Shift+Enter repaints as fast as typing without re-rendering the visible transcript. Resuming conversations via `--continue` or `--resume` renders the screen immediately without waiting for SessionStart hooks, and the first message no longer re-reads the full transcript. Tool execution turns no longer redraw transcripts for hidden reminders; when actions are blocked in auto mode, Claude receives messages identifying the blocking rule and instructing it to try safer methods to finish unrelated work first rather than abruptly stopping to ask.

items.original:
Fixed sustained high CPU usage: a busy loop in long-running idle sessions no longer pins a CPU core, and rapid terminal focus reports during a session recap no longer keep the CPU high
Improved fullscreen mode: adding or removing a prompt line (Shift+Enter) now repaints as fast as typing a character instead of re-rendering the visible transcript
Improved `--continue` / `--resume`: the conversation appears immediately instead of waiting for SessionStart hooks, and the first message no longer re-reads the whole transcript
Improved responsiveness during tool-heavy turns by no longer redrawing the transcript for a hidden per-tool-batch reminder
Improved auto mode denials: the message Claude receives now names the rule that blocked the action and asks Claude to try a safer method and finish unrelated work before stopping to ask you

title.zh-TW: 輸入列提示建議修復，進度指示保持單行與游標重現
title.en: Prompt Suggestion Fixes, Single-Row Spinners, and Restored Cursor Visibility

body.zh-TW: 終端機輸入框與排版細節修復了多處顯示瑕疵。在提示詞輸入列中，使用方向鍵向上鍵 ↑ 召回前一次提問並進行修改後，輸入 `@` 檔案與 `/` 指令的自動建議選單現在能穩定彈出。當目前任務的標籤名稱較長時，進度旋轉動畫不再折行換列，任務標籤與「Next:」提示列現在能整齊維持在單一終端機列內。在開啟終端機原生游標的環境下，輸入 `/bug` 與 `/feedback` 指令的描述文字欄位修復了游標隱形的問題。輸入列底部的資訊呈現也獲得重新調整，編輯器或 `/diff` 的選取範圍現在直接展示於提問輸入框內，而在全螢幕模式下，遠端控制的連線狀態改於頂端標頭顯示，不再佔用底部空間。⟦整體介面猶如重新校正的精準打字機，字軌與自動補字齒輪隨撥即動，進度指示燈維持水平不偏位，指標刻度隨時清晰可見。⟧
body.en: Terminal prompt boxes and layout details resolve several visual flaws. In the prompt input line, auto-suggestions for `@` files and `/` commands now reliably pop up after recalling a previous prompt with the up arrow ↑ and editing it. When a current task label is long, the spinner no longer wraps across multiple lines, keeping task labels and "Next:" lines neatly contained within a single terminal row. In environments with native terminal cursors enabled, description fields for `/bug` and `/feedback` commands fix invisible cursor issues. Prompt footer presentation is also reorganized: editor or `/diff` selections now appear directly inside the prompt input box, and in fullscreen mode, Remote Control status is displayed in the top header instead of taking up footer space. ⟦The overall interface is like a recalibrated precision typewriter, where carriage tracks and auto-completion gears move smoothly on demand, progress indicators stay aligned horizontally, and pointer scales remain clearly visible at all times.⟧

items.original:
Fixed `@` file and `/` command suggestions not appearing after recalling a previous prompt with the up arrow and editing it
Fixed the spinner wrapping onto several lines when the current task's label is long; the label and the "Next:" task line now stay within one terminal row
Fixed the `/bug` and `/feedback` description field showing no cursor when the terminal's native cursor is enabled
Improved the prompt footer: an editor or `/diff` selection now shows inside the prompt input, and fullscreen mode shows Remote Control status in the header instead of the footer

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 輔助使用按鍵支援，外掛異動免重啟即時生效
title.en: [VSCode] Accessibility Key Navigation and Instant Plugin Updates Without Restart

body.zh-TW: VS Code 擴充套件為習慣鍵盤操作與螢幕報讀工具的使用者，帶來了更順手的新導覽鍵。⟦這好似為混音控制台換上點字琴鍵與快速推桿，調音師能單靠按鍵隨意切換聲道並跳至最新音軌，外接效果器插拔時也不必將全場設備關機重開。⟧在權限詢問畫面中現在能使用方向鍵向左鍵與向右鍵 ← →，切換「一律允許」規則的儲存層級。同時新增了「Claude Code: Focus last message」指令，能隨時將鍵盤焦點快速移回對話中的最新訊息。在外掛管理對話框中進行安裝、啟用、停用或解除安裝時，變更會立即套用至已開啟的工作階段（session），完全無須重新啟動編輯器。此外，部分工件（artifact）權限提示比照命令列終端機規範，移除了「不再詢問」選項以確保每次操作安全。
body.en: The VS Code extension introduces smoother navigation keys for keyboard and screen reader users. ⟦This is like equipping an audio mixing console with Braille keys and quick faders, allowing audio engineers to switch channels and jump to the newest track solely with keystrokes, while swapping external effect pedals without powering down the entire setup.⟧ In permission prompts, Left and Right arrow keys ← → can now switch where an always-allow rule is saved. A new "Claude Code: Focus last message" command quickly shifts keyboard focus back to the newest message in the conversation. When installing, enabling, disabling, or uninstalling in the Manage plugins dialog, changes apply immediately to open sessions without requiring an editor restart. Additionally, some artifact permission prompts omit the "don't ask again" choice to match terminal security standards.

items.original:
[VSCode] Added Left and Right arrow keys to change where an always-allow permission rule is saved, for keyboard and screen reader users
[VSCode] Added a "Claude Code: Focus last message" command that moves keyboard focus to the newest message in the conversation, for keyboard and screen reader users
[VSCode] Changed the Manage plugins dialog to apply installs, enables, disables and uninstalls to open sessions without a restart
[VSCode] Changed some artifact permission prompts to omit the "don't ask again" choice, matching the terminal

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 多分頁模型選單不閃爍，啟動排程消除多餘行程
title.en: [VSCode] Stable Multi-Tab Model Pickers and Optimized Process Startup Scheduling

body.zh-TW: 在編輯器中開啟多個對話分頁或切換帳戶，選單與模型狀態不再莫名閃爍留白。登入、登出或切換帳號後，已開啟分頁的模型標籤、模型選取器與指令選單，修復了在數秒間呈現空白的問題。當專案或本機設定覆蓋全域設定中的模型時，新分頁或重新整理的對話中「Auto」選項不再無故消失。配置了 SessionStart 掛鉤（hook，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）時，視窗重載後的命名問題已獲修正。工作階段（session）名稱重載後不再退回最後一次提問。視窗內已有其他分頁運行時，底部狀態列的模型與遠端控制狀態燈不再空等新行程啟動。若分頁啟動在讀取設定後超過半秒抵達，第二個 Claude 行程也不再重複完整啟動流程。⟦這項排程安排宛若舞台燈光控制矩陣，主控機台啟動後各燈組隨即跟進同步，換場或換幕時號碼燈不暗滅，備用迴路也不再盲目重複預熱。⟧
body.en: When opening multiple chat tabs or switching accounts in the editor, menus and model states no longer flicker or go blank. After logging in, logging out, or switching accounts, model pills, model pickers, and command menus in open tabs resolve an issue where they went blank for several seconds. When project or local settings override the model named in global settings, the "Auto" option no longer disappears in new tabs or reloaded conversations. When a SessionStart hook is configured, naming issues after window reloads are resolved. Session names no longer revert to the last prompt after a reload. When another tab is already running in the window, footer model and Remote Control pills no longer wait needlessly for a new process to launch. If a session tab's launch arrives more than half a second after reading configuration, a second Claude process no longer runs through the full startup cycle. ⟦This scheduling setup is like a stage lighting control matrix, where lighting fixtures sync immediately after the master console powers up, cue lights stay illuminated across scene changes, and backup circuits no longer blindly repeat preheating routines.⟧

items.original:
[VSCode] Fixed the model pill, model picker and command menu going blank in open tabs for a few seconds after a login, logout or account switch
[VSCode] Fixed Auto disappearing from the mode picker in new-tab or just-reloaded conversations when a project or local setting overrides the model named in `~/.claude/settings.json`
[VSCode] Fixed session names reverting to the last prompt after a window reload when a SessionStart hook is configured
[VSCode] Fixed the footer's model pill and Remote Control pill waiting for the new tab's Claude process to start when another tab in the window is already up
[VSCode] Fixed a second Claude process running through its full startup when a session tab's launch arrived more than half a second after its config read

title.zh-TW: [VSCode] 自訂設定目錄正常讀取，視窗診斷精準回傳
title.en: [VSCode] Custom Config Directory Support and Accurate Windows Diagnostics

body.zh-TW: 自訂目錄與 Windows 診斷，現在能切合實際開發環境。⟦這好似建築師調整個人繪圖桌的收納櫃與抽屜配置，自訂工具箱無論擺在側邊欄還是主桌面都確實定位，跨平台描圖時標尺刻度也分毫不差。⟧當透過設定檔或 `environmentVariables` 指定自訂目錄 `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` 時，工作階段（session）清單、設定開關與分頁能正確讀取目錄，樣式工具不再把使用者樣式存入命令列讀不到的位置。從清單恢復對話時，系統不再忽視 `claudeCode.preferredLocation: "sidebar"` 而強制開啟面板，程式化開啟也不會重設為「panel」。未安裝 WSL 的 Windows 電腦不再誤跳安裝提示，安裝了 WSL 也能正確回傳本機檔案診斷。
body.en: Custom directories and Windows diagnostics now properly match real development setups. ⟦This is like an architect organizing drafting table cabinets and drawers, ensuring custom toolboxes are firmly positioned whether on sidebars or main desktops, while scale markings remain perfectly accurate during cross-platform drafting.⟧ When `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR` is set in settings files or via the `environmentVariables` setting, session lists, settings toggles, and chat tabs read the directory correctly, and style builders no longer save user styles into paths unreadable by the CLI.
